cards.old_note: *And thus Yahuah (God) of Spirits named the Elect One, And seated him on the throne of His glory.* The Messianic enthronement of the Elect One — the same Son of Adam / Elect One the Hebrew library knew before the Greek Septuagint translators worked, and the same figure Matt 1:23 names *Immanuel — Elohim (God) with us.*
cards.new_note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). The Father seats the Elect One on the throne of glory to judge. *They shall call his name Immanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us* (Matthew 1:23) — the enthroned one is the one who came in flesh.

cards.old_note: *And there was great joy amongst them, And they blessed and glorified and exalted, Because the name of that Son of Adam had been revealed unto them.* The revelation of the Son of Adam's name to the holy ones — the Hebrew library's witness that the name itself is the gospel. Matt 1:21's *thou shalt call his name Yahusha (Jesus): for he shall save his people from their sins* is the same name finally given to the people on earth.
cards.new_note: *And there was great joy amongst them, And they blessed and glorified and extolled Because the name of that Son of Adam had been revealed unto them.* (1 Enoch 69:26). *Thou shalt call his name Yahusha (Jesus): for he shall save his people from their sins* (Matthew 1:21). The name revealed to the holy ones in heaven, to their joy, is the name given on earth to the child. The name is the gospel.

cards.old_note: *And I saw till a white bull was born, with large horns, and all the beasts of the field and all the birds of the air feared him and made petition to him all the time.* The Animal Apocalypse Messianic vision in 1 Enoch — the white bull born at the end of the prophetic timeline is the Messianic figure Yoshi's framework treats as the Messianic-Adam-recapitulation. The Magi who knew the Hebrew prophetic tradition were watching for this figure.
cards.new_note: *And I saw that a white bull was born, with large horns, and all the beasts of the field and all the birds of the air feared him and made petition to him all the time.* (1 Enoch 90:37). The Animal Apocalypse ends where the Magi's watch ends: a white bull born at the close of the vision, large-horned, feared and petitioned by every beast and bird — the seed of Adam restored in one figure. *Where is he that is born King of the Yahudim (Jews)? for we have seen his star in the east* (Matthew 2:2). The men who read the heavens were looking for the one this vision had already shown.

cards.old_note: *And I saw till all their generations were transformed, and they all became white bulls; and the first among them became a lamb, and that lamb became a great animal and had great black horns on its head.* The Messianic-Lamb who is also the great-horned one — the Hebrew library's anticipation of the same figure Matt 2:2's star announces.
cards.new_note: *And I saw till all their generations were transformed, and they all became white bulls; and the first among them became a lamb, and that lamb became a great animal and had great black horns on its head; and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced over it and over all the oxen.* (1 Enoch 90:38). The lamb that becomes the great horned one — the Lamb who is also the King. The star of Matthew 2:2 announced a child; the vision had already shown what the child would be: the lamb grown into the one the Lord of the sheep rejoices over.

cards.old_note: *But the middle one reached to heaven, like the throne of Yahuah (God), of stibium, and the top of the throne was of sapphire.* 1 Enoch 14's Throne vision opens with Enoch ascending into the heavens and standing before the throne of Yahuah. The Hebrew library's heavens-opening register at the Throne — sapphire, fire, the holy ones surrounding — names the cosmological room into which Matt 3:16's opened heaven gives access. The Formless Father is on the Throne; the Formed has come into flesh; the heavens open for the announcement.
cards.new_note: *And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.* (1 Enoch 14:18). This is the room the open heaven of Matthew 3:16 gives onto — the lofty throne, the cherubim, the fire streaming from beneath it (1 Enoch 14:18–22). The heavens do not open onto emptiness; they open onto the throne of the Great Glory, and from that throne the voice of the next verse speaks.

cards.old_note: *And it came to pass after this that my spirit was carried off and it ascended into the heavens: And I saw the holy sons of Elohim (God). They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white, and their raiment, And their faces shone like snow.* 1 Enoch 71 — Enoch's exaltation and the revelation of the Son of Adam — is the Hebrew library's most extensive heavens-opening vision. The Throne-room that opens to Enoch is the same room the Father's voice speaks from at Matt 3:17.
cards.new_note: *And it came to pass after this that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heavens: And I saw the holy sons of Elohim (God). They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white [and their raiment], And their faces shone like snow.* (1 Enoch 71:1). The ascent that ends in the Head of Days naming the Son of Adam (1 Enoch 71:14) begins here, with the heavens opened to Enoch. At the Yarden (Jordan) the same heavens open and the same Father speaks over the same Son.

cards.old_note: *And in those days the voice of the Holy One shall be heard in the heaven, and the voice of the Elect One shall be heard from the throne of glory.* 1 Enoch 39:5 names the doubled voice — the Father's voice from heaven and the voice of the Elect One — in one breath. Matt 3:17's *voice from heaven* is the Father's voice the Hebrew library had been promising; Yahusha (Jesus) is the Elect One the same library named.
cards.new_note: *And the second voice I heard blessing the Elect One and the elect ones who hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:5). *And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son* (Matthew 3:17). Enoch heard two voices in the throne room: the first blessing Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits (1 Enoch 40:4), the second blessing the Elect One. The Father's voice at the river and the heaven's blessing of the Elect One speak of the same Son.

cards.old_note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: 'This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.'* 1 Enoch 62:7 is the Hebrew library's direct Father-voice naming of the Son of Adam — the same construction Matt 3:17's *This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased* enacts at the Yarden (Jordan). The Father in 1 Enoch names the Son of Adam at the cosmic throne; the same Father at Matt 3:17 names the Son in the water. Same voice, same Son, the public moment finally arrived.
cards.new_note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased* (Matthew 3:17). Enoch had already heard the Father name him: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* The voice at the river is the voice from the throne; the Son it names is the one righteousness never leaves.

cards.old_note: *But to the righteous and holy He will grant peace, and He will protect the elect, and compassion shall be upon them; and they shall all belong to Elohim (God), and they shall be prospered, and they shall all be blessed.* 1 Enoch 5:7 names the Hebrew library's righteous-elect blessing register the Beatitudes inherit. Matt 5:3's *blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven* is not the entry-condition into the kingdom; it is the Father's own witness to the citizens he has already drawn. The Hebrew library carries the same register: blessing pronounced on the righteous and elect who are already such.
cards.new_note: *But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.* (1 Enoch 1:8). *Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 5:3). The blessing is not an entry fee; it is the Father's own word over those who are already his. Enoch heard the same word before the Beatitudes were spoken: peace, protection, mercy, belonging — pronounced over the elect, not offered to applicants.

cards.old_note: *And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy and elect shall be without number.* 1 Enoch 58:3 names the light-of-the-elect register — the righteous in the light of the sun, the elect in the light of eternal life. Matt 5:14's *ye are the light of the world* (Greek *este,* indicative not imperative — *you ARE*) is the gospel-form of the same Hebrew library declaration: the elect are named as the light they already are because the Father has drawn them into the light of the eternal age.
cards.new_note: *And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy without number.* (1 Enoch 58:3). *Ye are the light of the world* (Matthew 5:14) — not *become*; *are.* Enoch says why: the righteous are set in the light of the sun and the elect in the light of eternal life. The light the disciples carry is the light they were placed in.

cards.old_note: *And from henceforth they that possess the earth shall no longer be strong and exalted, nor shall they be able to look with contempt on the face of the holy, for Yahuah (God) of Spirits has appeared upon the throne of His glory, and all evil shall depart from before His face.* 1 Enoch 38:4 names the throne-of-glory architecture — the appearing of Yahuah (God) of Spirits at which the strong of the earth lose their exaltation and the holy stand revealed. Matt 5:14's *a city that is set on an hill cannot be hid* names the present-age visibility of the gathered remnant in the same architecture: the disciples on the second-Sinai mountain are the foreshadowing of the throne-of-glory city the consummation will set on the height of the mountains.
cards.new_note: *From that time those that possess the earth shall no longer be powerful and exalted: And they shall not be able to behold the face of the holy, For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has caused His light to appear On the face of the holy, righteous, and elect.* (1 Enoch 38:4). *A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid* (Matthew 5:14). Enoch saw the day the light appears on the face of the holy, righteous and elect, and the powerful can no longer behold it. The disciples on the mountain are the first sight of that city; the light that makes it visible is the Lord of Spirits' own.

cards.old_note: *And the righteous shall be victorious in the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and He will cause the sinners and the godless to be destroyed from the face of the earth, and those who have led the world astray shall be bound with chains, and in their assembling-place of destruction shall they be imprisoned.* 1 Enoch 38:2 names the righteous-shall-be-victorious-in-the-name architecture — the elect's visible vindication in the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, with the glory ascending to Him. Matt 5:16's *let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven* walks the same name-glorifying architecture at the present-age level: the visible covenant-walk of the gathered draws the glory to the Father.
cards.new_note: *And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.* (1 Enoch 38:2). *Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 5:16). Enoch saw the day the light appears on the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth — and the question that day asks of the sinners. The shining is the Father's doing; the glory goes to him.

cards.old_note: *And woe to those who alter these things, And lead the sons of men astray, And cause them to transgress the commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* 1 Enoch 82:13 names the two-clause diagnostic explicitly: *alter* + *lead the sons of men astray* + *cause them to transgress the commandments.* This is the direct architectural parallel to Matt 5:19's *break* + *teach men so* — the Hebrew library carries the exact dual-clause diagnostic the gospel inherits. The institutional pulpit that voids the commandments and teaches the congregation to do the same is named by both registers: woe-form in the Hebrew library, least-in-the-kingdom in the gospel.
cards.new_note: *Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.* (1 Enoch 104:9). Enoch's charge to his children is the charge Matthew 5:19 makes to every teacher: do not alter the words of uprightness. *Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven.* To alter the words and to teach men so are one act; both are named here before the gospel names them.

cards.old_note: *Woe to you who alter the words of uprightness, And who write the words of unrighteousness and lying: They write their own judgment; For they shall suddenly be slain, And they shall have no peace.* 1 Enoch 95:2 carries the alter-the-words-of-uprightness woe in its sharpest form — *they write their own judgment.* Matt 5:19's kingdom-status diagnostic walks the same architecture in gospel-grammar: the pulpit that teaches the breaking of the commandments writes its own kingdom-status by the teaching.
cards.new_note: *And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.* (1 Enoch 104:10). Enoch knew the mystery before the pulpit practised it: sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness, and write books about it. *Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so* (Matthew 5:19) — the teaching is the perverting; the books are the sermons. The kingdom-status of such teachers was fixed long before the sermon was preached.

cards.old_note: *Yahuah (Lord) of lords, Elohim (God) of elohiym, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory standeth unto all the generations of the world, and Thy Name is holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!* 1 Enoch 9:4 names the holy-name + throne-of-glory + king-of-kings architecture in the angelic prayer-form. Matt 6:9-10's *Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come* walks the same Hebrew library prayer-architecture at the kingdom-citizens level: the holy and blessed Name, the eternal throne of glory, the King of kings whose kingdom the citizens pray come.
cards.new_note: *And they said to Yahuah (Lord) of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim (God) of gods, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!* (1 Enoch 9:4). Enoch's angels pray what the disciples are taught to pray: the holy and blessed name, the throne of glory that stands to all generations, the King of kings. *Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come* (Matthew 6:9–10) is the same prayer in the mouth of the children.

cards.old_note: *Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (God), King, Great and mighty in Thy greatness, Elyon in Thy dominion, And Thy throne is for ever and ever, And Thy name is holy and great for ever and ever, And blessed be Thou for ever.* 1 Enoch 84:2 carries Enoch's own prayer in the same architecture: blessed-be-the-King-whose-throne-is-forever, whose Name is holy. Matt 6:9's *hallowed be thy name* is the gospel-form of the same Hebrew library prayer the patriarch already prayed.
cards.new_note: *‘Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (Lord), King, Great and mighty in Thy greatness, Yahuah (Lord) of the whole creation of the heaven, King of kings and Elohim (God) of the whole world. And Thy power and kingship and greatness abide for ever and ever, And throughout all generations Thy dominion; And all the heavens are Thy throne for ever, And the whole earth Thy footstool for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 84:2). *Hallowed be thy name* (Matthew 6:9). Enoch's own prayer blesses the King whose dominion is through all generations and whose throne is the heavens. The disciples are taught to pray what the patriarch prayed.

cards.old_note: *Thou hast made all things, And Thou hast power over all things: And all things are naked and open in Thy sight, And Thou seest all things, And nothing can hide itself from Thee.* 1 Enoch 84:3 names the *Thou hast made all things, And Thou hast power over all things* architecture — kingdom-and-power-as-the-Father's pattern. Matt 6:10's *thy kingdom come, thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven* walks the same architecture: the Father who has made all things and has power over all things is the one whose kingdom the citizens pray to see consummated and whose will they pray to see done in earth.
cards.new_note: *Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.* (1 Enoch 9:5). The One whose kingdom the disciples pray to come is the One who made all things and holds power over all things, from whom nothing hides. *Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven* (Matthew 6:10) asks nothing new; it asks that what is already true in heaven be seen on earth.

cards.old_note: *And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptance, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.* 1 Enoch 94:1 names the Two-Ways architecture explicitly in the Hebrew library's apocalyptic register — paths of righteousness vs paths of unrighteousness, the second leading to destruction. Matt 7:13's wide gate / broad way leading to destruction walks the same architecture; the patriarch Enoch was already teaching the two-ways covenant-decision before the Mosaic Torah's own formulation at Deuteronomy 30.
cards.new_note: *And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptation, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.* (1 Enoch 94:1). Two ways, and only two. Enoch sets them before his sons — the paths of righteousness worthy of acceptance, the paths of unrighteousness that vanish — long before Matthew 7:13's *wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction.* The choice at Deuteronomy 30:19 was already old when Enoch taught it.

cards.old_note: *And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves aloof from the paths of righteousness, And they shall not find mercy.* 1 Enoch 94:2 names the few-who-find architecture inversely — the few of a generation see the paths of death and hold themselves aloof from the paths of righteousness. Matt 7:14's *few there be that find it* walks the same remnant-architecture in positive direction: the few who find the narrow way, while the many enter the wide. The Hebrew library's wisdom-stream had been naming the asymmetric Two-Ways outcome long before the Sermon.
cards.new_note: *And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves afar from them, And shall not follow them.* (1 Enoch 94:2). Enoch sees it from the other side: the paths of violence and death are shown to certain men of a generation, and they keep far from them. *Strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it* (Matthew 7:14). The few who hold themselves afar are the few who find.

cards.old_note: *And I saw till all the beasts and the birds and the wild animals were gathered, and they all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to praise Him.* 1 Enoch 90:18 (within the Animal Apocalypse) names the gathering-at-the-end of all the dispersed back to the Lord of the sheep. The framework reads the Animal Apocalypse's symbolic shepherding architecture in the gathering-register: the sheep gathered, the beasts and birds gathered, all returned to the Lord. Matt 8:11's *many from east and west* walks the same Hebrew library gathering-architecture at the King's own articulation. The vision Enoch saw is what the King is inaugurating.
cards.new_note: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *Many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Avraham (Abraham), and Yitschaq (Isaac), and Ya'aqov (Jacob), in the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 8:11). Enoch saw the sitting-down: all that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in the house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoicing because they had returned. The many from east and west are the dispersed of the house coming home — the scattered sheep, not a new flock.

cards.old_note: *And I asked the angel who went with me, who showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* 1 Enoch 46:2 names the figure directly — *that Son of Adam.* This is title-naming, not kaph-comparative description (distinct from Daniel 7:13's *kbar enash* / Revelation 1:13 / Revelation 14:14 where the comparative is preserved as *like the Son of Adam*). Matt 8:20 walks the same named-title architecture: Yahusha (Jesus) names himself as *the Son of Adam* with the lineage-weight and the Messianic-title both intact. Red Line #12 governs the rendering — *Son of Adam* capitalized as the title.
cards.new_note: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). Enoch asks who *that Son of Adam* is — a figure named by title, standing beside the Head of Days. When Yahusha (Jesus) says *the Son of Adam hath not where to lay his head* (Matthew 8:20) he takes that title for himself: the named one of the Parables, now with no bed on the earth he came to.

cards.old_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* 1 Enoch 15:9 names the spirits-from-the-giants demon-origin architecture in the Hebrew library's apocalyptic register. The demons of the Matt 8:28 narrative are the spirits that proceeded from the slain bodies of the giants — the offspring of the watchers' Genesis-6 rebellion. The Hebrew library had been carrying the demon-origin diagnostic for centuries; the gospel's exorcism-ministry walks the same architecture at the King's casting-out.
cards.new_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The spirits that met him among the tombs are named here by origin and by work: the spirits of the giants, afflicting and destroying, hungering and thirsting without food. The two possessed men of Matthew 8:28, *exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way,* were under exactly this.

cards.reason: duplicate — card 121872 (Matt 8:29 -> 1 Enoch 16:1) carries the same thought on the true verse

cards.old_note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.* 1 Enoch 62:7 names the Son of Adam's righteousness-abides-over-him architecture — the Son of Adam IS the righteous one over whom righteousness abides. Matt 9:6's authority to forgive sins is the present-tense exercise of the righteousness 1 Enoch 62 had named as eternally-abiding. The Father's forgiveness-prerogative is exercised in flesh by the Son of Adam whose righteousness is the architecture of the forgiveness-flow.
cards.new_note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *The Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins* (Matthew 9:6). The Parables had already named him the one born unto righteousness, over whom righteousness abides; the forgiveness he speaks on earth is that abiding righteousness exercised in flesh.

cards.old_note: *And the shepherds (corrupt leaders) who had not fed the sheep were judged, and cast into the same fiery abyss with the beasts.* 1 Enoch 90:16 (within the Animal Apocalypse) names the shepherds-who-had-not-fed-the-sheep judgment explicitly — the false-shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) cast into the fiery abyss for failing the flock. Matt 9:36's *sheep having no shepherd* multitudes is the same diagnostic operative at the King's arrival: the contemporary-Pharisaic-Sadducean-leadership is the same architecture 1 Enoch 90 names as appointed-for-judgment. The Yechezk'el-34 anchor (canon-tier, S110) and the 1 Enoch 90:16 apocalyptic-witness both name the shepherds-who-failed the flock.
cards.new_note: *And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). The shepherds who were set over the sheep and destroyed more than they were bidden end here, judged and cast into the fiery abyss. When Yahusha (Jesus) saw the multitudes *as sheep having no shepherd* (Matthew 9:36), he was looking at the flock those shepherds had left; the vision had already recorded their sentence.

cards.old_note: *And a new house was built greater and loftier than the first, and the Lord of the sheep brought all the sheep into that new house.* 1 Enoch 90:17 names the restoration-architecture immediately after the shepherds-judgment — the Lord of the sheep builds a new house greater than the first and brings all the sheep into it. Matt 9:36's scattered-shepherdless multitudes are the sheep the Lord of the sheep is in the process of gathering into the new-house-substance Yahusha (Jesus) is inaugurating. The wisdom-stream had named the gather-into-the-new-house architecture; the King at Matt 9:36 sees the multitudes in the present-tense fulfillment.
cards.new_note: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.* (1 Enoch 90:29). The shepherdless sheep of Matthew 9:36 are not left shepherdless. Enoch saw the Lord of the sheep bring a new house, greater and loftier than the first, with all the sheep within it. The compassion that moved him at the sight of the scattered flock is the compassion that builds the house.

cards.old_note: *And I saw till all the beasts and the birds and the wild animals were gathered, and they all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to praise Him.* 1 Enoch 90:18 names the full-gathering-and-fear-of-the-Lord-of-the-sheep architecture — at the end of the restoration-arc, all the sheep are gathered into the new house and fear the Lord of the sheep. Matt 9:36's present-tense seeing of the scattered multitudes is the Shepherd's arrival at the moment the gathering 1 Enoch 90 had named begins to be enacted in flesh.
cards.new_note: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *When he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad* (Matthew 9:36). Enoch saw where the scattering ends: all that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in the house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoicing because they had returned.

cards.old_note: *And your spirits have been found worthy of the lot of the righteous, And your names are written in the books of life before the Most High.* 1 Enoch 103:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct architecture: the names of the righteous are written in the books of life before the Most High. The framework's Red Line #11 reading of the names-written-before-the-foundation-of-the-world / names-can-only-be-blotted-out (Exodus 32:33; Psalm 69:28; Revelation 3:5) — names are not added after the foundation; they are written before and can be blotted out for unfaithfulness — is anchored at this wisdom-stream witness. Matt 10:32's confession-credentialing walks the same architecture: the King confesses the lived-confessor before the Father because the confessor's name was already written; the verbal-confession-without-Torah-walking is the failure-to-bear-fruit that risks blotting-out.
cards.new_note: *I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.* (1 Enoch 104:1). *Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 10:32). Enoch swears to the righteous that their names are already written before the glory of the Great One. The Son confesses before the Father the ones whose names were written before they ever confessed.

cards.old_note: *And their memorial shall be before the Most High, And their name shall not be blotted out.* 1 Enoch 103:8 names the inverse of the blotting-out architecture: the righteous-who-endure have their memorial preserved before the Most High; their name shall not be blotted out. The framework reads Matt 10:33's *whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven* against the same Red Line #11 architecture: the denial-under-pressure is the failure-to-endure that risks the blotting-out. The names of the lived-confessors are preserved (1 Enoch 103:8); the names of the deniers are subject to the Matthew 7:23 *depart from me, ye that work iniquity* dismissal-from-the-Father's-presence. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King at Matt 10:32-33 names the operative-mechanism at the apostolic-mission level.
cards.new_note: *And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.* (1 Enoch 103:4). *But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 10:33). Enoch's word to the righteous who die in righteousness is that their memorial does not perish before the Great One. The warning of Matthew 10:33 is the other side of that promise: a memorial can be kept, and a name can be blotted out (1 Enoch 108:3). The denier is not a tare who never had a name; he is wheat that did not endure.

cards.old_note: *But to the righteous and holy He will grant peace, and He will protect the elect, and compassion shall be upon them; and they shall all belong to Elohim (God), and they shall be prospered, and they shall be blessed, and the light of Elohim (God) shall shine unto them.* 1 Enoch 5:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Messianic-age-blessing-architecture: peace to the righteous, protection of the elect, compassion, belonging-to-Elohim (God), prosperity, blessing, the light shining. Matt 11:5's Messianic-credential answer (*the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them*) names the operative-fact of the Messianic-age-blessing now-operating in the King's-ministry. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King at Matt 11:5 names the architecture-coming-to-pass.
cards.new_note: *But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.* (1 Enoch 1:8). The answer sent to Yochanan (John) — *the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them* (Matthew 11:5) — is the peace, protection, mercy, and light Enoch saw promised to the righteous, now arriving in flesh.

cards.old_note: *And then shall all the righteous escape, and shall live until they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.* 1 Enoch 10:17-22 names the wisdom-stream's latter-day-restoration architecture explicitly: the righteous escape, beget thousands of children, complete their days in peace; the earth is tilled in righteousness, planted with trees and vines, cleansed from oppression and unrighteousness and sin; all the children of men become righteous and all nations offer adoration. Matt 11:5's Messianic-credential answer cites the same Tanakh-prophet-cluster (Isaiah 35, 29, 26, 61) that the wisdom-stream had been carrying at the Messianic-age-restoration register. The first-coming credentialing-signs are the inaugurated-foretaste of the full latter-day restoration the wisdom-stream had named.
cards.new_note: *And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.* (1 Enoch 10:17). Enoch saw the days when the righteous escape and complete their years in peace, the earth tilled in righteousness and cleansed of oppression (1 Enoch 10:17–22). The works Yahusha (Jesus) lists for Yochanan (John) at Matthew 11:5 are the first fruits of those days — the age Enoch saw, beginning.

cards.old_note: *Woe to you, sinners, who persecute the righteous; For you will be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy will be its yoke upon you.* 1 Enoch 95:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct woe-against-the-persecutors-of-the-righteous architecture: the same architecture Matt 23 will name in extended form. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:14: the Pharisaic-system's plot-to-destroy is the operative-action that brings the woe 1 Enoch 95 had named at the wisdom-stream register. The yoke-of-injustice will be heavy upon the persecutors; the kingdom-citizens carry the King's easy-yoke (Matt 11:30) by contrast. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture's eschatological-end-point; Matt 12:14 names the inaugural-step that triggers it.
cards.new_note: *Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.* (1 Enoch 95:7). *Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him* (Matthew 12:14). Enoch's woe already names them: sinners who persecute the righteous, and the heavy yoke that waits for them. The council against the Righteous One is the act the woe was written for.

cards.old_note: *And the Lord of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* 1 Enoch 62:2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Elect-One enthroned with the spirit-of-righteousness poured out upon him and the word-of-his-mouth as the operative-instrument at the day-of-judgment. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:18-21's servant-citation read in light of Matt 12:20c (*till he send forth judgment unto victory*): the present-age ministry stages the credentialing-in-mercy-substance; the eschatological-consummation lands the judgment-unto-victory at the second coming. The wisdom-stream knew the Elect-One's enthronement and the word-as-judgment-instrument; Matt 12:18-21 names the inaugural-credentialing in the meek-King-disposition that precedes the enthronement.
cards.new_note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). *Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles* (Matthew 12:18). Enoch saw the same: the spirit of righteousness poured out on the Elect One seated on the throne, and the word of his mouth bringing judgment. The servant of Isaiah and the Elect One of the Parables are one figure, and the Spirit upon him is the same Spirit.

cards.old_note: *And he answered and said unto me: They have witnessed those that have been guilty of the offence of their sin, and they have rejected its sentence: and they have practised the works which the watchers of heaven have taught — and they have no honour before Yahuah (the Lord); and they shall not have any rest: that is the appointed time for them and there is no place of repentance for them.* 1 Enoch 65:11 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the no-place-of-repentance architecture: those who have witnessed-the-sin and rejected-the-sentence and practiced-the-works-of-the-watchers have no-place-of-repentance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:32: the deliberate-attribution of the Ruach's-work to demonic-agency is the witnessing-and-rejecting-the-sentence pattern the wisdom-stream had named — the disposition hardened against correction with no repentance remaining. The Pharisaic-attribution Yahusha (Jesus) is responding to IS the diagnostic-instance of the architecture 1 Enoch 65:11 had named at its terminus.
cards.new_note: *And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.* (1 Enoch 65:11). *But the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Ghost) shall not be forgiven unto men* (Matthew 12:32). Enoch heard the sentence on those who showed what was hidden and became the damned: no place of repentance for ever. There is a sin that closes the door from the inside; the Pharisees who called the Spirit's work the work of Beelzebub stood at that door.

cards.old_note: *And the wisdom of the Lord of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; for he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, and have hated all its works and ways in the name of the Lord of Spirits: for in his name they are saved, and he is the avenger of their life.* 1 Enoch 48:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wisdom-revealed-to-the-holy-and-righteous architecture: the Lord of Spirits reveals the Elect-One AND the wisdom-of-the-Lord-of-Spirits to those-who-hate-the-world-of-unrighteousness. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:11's *because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.* The Greek *dedotai* (passive-perfect-tense, *it has been given*) names a giving-that-precedes-the-hearing; the wisdom-stream had named the architecture at the elect-receiving register. The disciples-hear because they have-been-given-to-hear; the multitudes-do-not-hear because they have-not-been-given. The giving precedes; the response reveals. Election-precedes-hearing per Red Line #11.
cards.new_note: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). *Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given* (Matthew 13:11). Enoch says who the *you* are: the holy and righteous to whom the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits reveals him, who have hated this world of unrighteousness. The revealing follows the belonging; it does not create it.

cards.old_note: *And Uri'el said to me: "Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgment in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* 1 Enoch 19:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the spirits-of-the-watchers leading-mankind-astray architecture. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:19's *when any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart.* The wicked-one Yahusha (Jesus) names is operationally the same actor the wisdom-stream had named — the spirits-of-the-watchers who lead-mankind-astray into sacrificing-to-demons-as-gods. The wicked-one snatches the seed by leading-the-hearer-astray; the wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King names the operative-form at the parable-of-the-sower register. The disposition-to-be-led-astray (the not-understanding of v.19) is what the wicked-one exploits.
cards.new_note: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). *Then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart* (Matthew 13:19). Enoch names the spirits of the Watchers assuming many forms, leading mankind astray — the actor behind the catching-away. He is not a figure of speech; the restored library records his origin and his end.

cards.old_note: *And to Gavri'el (Gabriel) said Yahuah (the Lord): "Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men: and cause them to go forth: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have."* 1 Enoch 10:9 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the children-of-the-watchers as the bastards-and-reprobates-and-children-of-fornication architecture: a specific-people-with-specific-paternal-source distinguished from the line-of-Adam. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:38's *the tares are the children of the wicked one.* The wisdom-stream had named the children-of-the-watchers as a paternal-source-distinguishable-people; the King at Matt 13:38 names the operative-architecture of the children-of-the-wicked-one as a paternal-source-distinguishable-people-within-the-field-of-the-world. The framework reads the architecture in continuity: the watchers' incursion at Bereshit (Genesis) 6:1-4 produces a corrupted-line that operates-within-the-field-of-the-world as the seed-of-the-wicked-one alongside the seed-of-Adam.
cards.new_note: *And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.* (1 Enoch 10:9). *The tares are the children of the wicked one* (Matthew 13:38). Enoch names them before the parable does: the children of the Watchers, a seed with a father of its own, distinguished from the line of Adam and marked for destruction. The tares are not bad wheat; they are another seed.

cards.old_note: *And in those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever. And whosoever shall be condemned and destroyed will from thenceforth be bound together with them to the end of all generations.* 1 Enoch 10:13-14 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the watchers' eschatological-judgment: led-off-to-the-abyss-of-fire at the day-of-judgment with-the-torment-and-prison-everlasting. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:42's *and shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* The wisdom-stream had named the architecture-of-the-abyss-of-fire-at-the-day-of-judgment; the King at Matt 13:42 names the operative-form of the architecture the wisdom-stream had named. The framework reads the architecture in continuity with the S142 thread (binding-the-watchers-typological-anchor-for-binding-the-strong-man) — the inaugurated-binding at the King's present-age-ministry leads to the eschatological-final-binding-and-burning at the harvest the present chapter names.
cards.new_note: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth* (Matthew 13:42). Enoch saw the abyss of fire and the prison appointed for the Watchers — the furnace the parable names, already mapped.

cards.old_note: *And Mikha'el (Michael), and Gavri'el (Gabriel), and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.* 1 Enoch 54:6 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for Matt 13:42's *furnace of fire* substance: the four-archangels (Mikha'el and Gavri'el and Raphael and Phanuel) cast-the-hosts-of-Azazel into-the-burning-furnace on-the-great-day. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:42 and the *reapers are the angels* identification of v.39: the wisdom-stream knew the angelic-architecture of the eschatological-binding-and-burning; the King names the operative-form at the parable-of-the-wheat-and-tares-interpretation register. The angels-as-reapers + the burning-furnace + the day-of-judgment + the cause-of-judgment (subject-to-Satan-and-leading-astray-the-earth-dwellers) all align across the wisdom-stream and the gospel.
cards.new_note: *And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’* (1 Enoch 54:6). *The reapers are the angels* (Matthew 13:39), and here they are by name: Michael, Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, casting the hosts of Azazel into the burning furnace on the great day. The furnace of Matthew 13:42 has its angels, its day, and its reason — vengeance for leading astray those who dwell on the earth.

cards.old_note: *And he answered and said unto me: "This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden, because the Lord of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before the Lord of Spirits in uprightness for ever."* 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-reveals-the-treasures-of-that-which-is-hidden architecture: the Son-of-Adam is the One-who-reveals-the-hidden-treasures-of-righteousness; the Lord-of-Spirits chose him for this office. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:34-35's parables-method: the King teaches in parables AS the Son-of-Adam revealing-the-treasures-of-that-which-is-hidden the wisdom-stream had named. The Sower-of-the-good-seed of v.37 IS the same Son-of-Adam the wisdom-stream had named as the Revealer-of-the-hidden-treasures. The parables-method is the operative-form of the office the wisdom-stream had named.
cards.new_note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *All these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables* (Matthew 13:34). Enoch had named the Son of Adam as the one who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden. The parables are that revealing — hidden things opened, by the one chosen to open them.

cards.old_note: *Then I asked regarding it, and regarding all the hollow places: "Why is one separated from the other?" And he answered me and said unto me: "These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And such a division has been made (for) the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright spring of water. And such an one has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgement has not been executed on them in their lifetime. Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever. And such a division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners. Such has been made for the spirits of men who were not righteous but sinners, who were completely transgressors, and of the transgressors they shall be companions: but their spirits shall not be slain in the day of judgement nor shall they be raised from thence."* 1 Enoch 22:5-7 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the spirits-of-the-dead separated-into-four-divisions architecture, with the spirit-of-Hevel (Abel) crying-out-against-Qayin (Cain) as the seed-war's first-victim-crying-for-vindication (1 Enoch 22:7 names the spirits-who-make-disclosures-concerning-their-destruction-when-slain-in-the-days-of-the-sinners). The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:38's *the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one.* The wisdom-stream knew the architecture-of-the-seed-war-from-Bereshit-4 with the first-righteous-victim crying-out-against-the-wicked; the King names the operative-form of the wheat-and-tares architecture at the gospel-register. The first-tare (Qayin) and the first-wheat (Hevel) inaugurate the architecture the King's parable names.
cards.new_note: *And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’* (1 Enoch 22:7). *The good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one* (Matthew 13:38). The seed war is older than the parable. Enoch is shown the spirit of Hevel (Abel), the first righteous blood, making its suit against the seed of Qayin (Cain) until that seed is gone from among the seed of men. Two seeds, from Genesis 4 to the harvest.

cards.old_note: *And I asked the angel who went with me, who showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, and why he went with the Head of Days.* 1 Enoch 46:2 names THE wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *Son of Adam* title the King uses of himself at Matt 16:13 (*whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?*). The Parables-of-Enoch (1 Enoch 37-71) had carried the Son-of-Adam title as a heavenly-figure-named-beside-the-Head-of-Days centuries before the King's-incarnation; the King takes-up-the-title at the credentialing-question at Caesarea Philippi in continuity with the wisdom-stream's articulation. The framework reads the substance carefully: the Son-of-Adam title carries the lineage-weight of the seed-of-Adam-line-of-promise per Red Line #12 the gospels restore from the translators'-flattening; 1 Enoch had named the title for the heavenly Christ at the Father's right hand; the King names-himself by the same title at the gospel-pivot. The wisdom-stream and the gospel-substance cohere at the seed-of-Adam-line-of-promise architecture.
cards.new_note: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). *Whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?* (Matthew 16:13). The question uses the title Enoch asked about — *that Son of Adam,* the one who went with the Head of Days. The King asks whether men have recognized the figure the Parables named.

cards.old_note: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Son-of-Adam's identity at the depth the King carries at Matt 16:16. Kefa's (Peter's)-confession — *thou art the Messiah, the Son of the living Elohim (God)* — articulates at the gospel-pivot what the Parables-of-Enoch had named at the wisdom-stream-level: the Son-of-Adam is the Chosen-One in-whom-righteousness-dwells, the one-with-pre-eminence-before-Yahuah-of-Spirits. The framework reads the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operating across the gospel-pivot: Kefa (Peter) confesses because the Father has-revealed-the-substance (Matt 16:17's *flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven*); the substance the Father reveals is the substance the wisdom-stream had named in the Parables-of-Enoch centuries before; the wisdom-stream and the gospel-confession cohere at the Son-of-Adam-as-the-Chosen-One-of-Yahuah-of-Spirits architecture.
cards.new_note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *Thou art the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God)* (Matthew 16:16). Kefa (Peter) confesses what Enoch was told: the Son of Adam who has righteousness, whom Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has chosen, whose lot has the pre-eminence for ever. The confession at Caesarea Philippi is the angel's answer at 1 Enoch 46:3, spoken on earth.

cards.old_note: *For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, and unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, and have no continuance; because the Elect One stands before Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits.* 1 Enoch 49:2 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Elect-One-as-the-Standing-One-before-Yahuah-of-Spirits substance — the Christ-figure to-whom-the-secrets-of-righteousness-are-committed. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:19's keys-of-the-kingdom delegated to the apostolic-stewardship. The Elect-One holds-the-secrets-of-righteousness at the wisdom-stream's articulation; the King-as-the-Elect-One delegates the keys-of-the-kingdom-of-heaven (the binding-and-loosing-substance of vv.19) to the apostolic-stewardship at the gospel-pivot. The delegated-stewardship operates downstream-of-the-Elect-One's-own-position-before-the-Father; the wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the Christ-as-the-Holder-of-the-Secrets; the King's-delegation at Matt 16:19 operates within the Elect-One's-own-master-authority.
cards.new_note: *For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.* (1 Enoch 49:2). *I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 16:19). The secrets of righteousness belong to the Elect One who stands before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits; the keys Kefa (Peter) receives are stewardship of what is his. The one who holds the secrets delegates their opening.

cards.old_note: *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, and his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: for Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits hath given them to him and hath glorified him.* 1 Enoch 51:3 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Elect-One-on-the-throne substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:19's keys-of-the-kingdom-of-heaven committed to the apostolic-stewardship and against the Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 22:22 *I will lay the key of the house of David upon his shoulder* the short.md walks at the Shevna-and-Elyakim succession depth. The Elect-One sits on Yahuah-of-Spirits'-throne; the keys-of-the-house-of-David belong to the Elect-One; the King delegates the keys-of-the-kingdom-of-heaven to the apostolic-stewardship from the throne-position 1 Enoch 51:3 had named the wisdom-stream-substance for. The framework reads this as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the apostolic-stewardship's derivation from the King's-own-throne-position.
cards.new_note: *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3). *I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 16:19). Enoch saw the Elect One seated on the Father's throne, his mouth pouring out the secrets of wisdom and counsel. The keys are given by the one who sits on that throne; the house of David's key (Isaiah 22:22) is on his shoulder before it is in Kefa's (Peter's) hand.

cards.old_note: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, and righteousness abides over him, and the righteousness of the Elect One of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and elect.* 1 Enoch 62:7 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Son-of-Adam revealed-to-the-holy-and-elect substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:17-19's sequence: the Father reveals the Son-of-Adam to Kefa (Peter) (the just-blessed disciple is one of the holy-and-elect to whom the revelation comes); the revelation is followed by the King's-delegation of the keys to the apostolic-stewardship. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the revelation-of-the-Son-of-Adam-to-the-elect; the gospel-pivot at Caesarea Philippi enacts the architecture in the historical-disciples' confession.
cards.new_note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *Flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 16:17). The Father's naming of the Son of Adam at 1 Enoch 71:14 is the same revealing — the Head of Days declaring who he is. Kefa (Peter) receives on earth what Enoch heard in heaven, and the keys follow the revealing.

cards.old_note: *And he sat on the throne of his glory, and the sum of judgment was given unto the Son of Adam, and he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth.* 1 Enoch 69:27 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the sum-of-judgment-given-unto-the-Son-of-Adam substance — the binding-and-loosing-and-judgment-authority committed-unto-the-Christ-on-the-throne-of-his-glory. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:19's binding-and-loosing-authority delegated to the apostolic-stewardship. The sum-of-judgment belongs to the Son-of-Adam at the wisdom-stream's articulation; the apostolic-stewardship's binding-and-loosing operates downstream-of-and-in-accountability-to the Son-of-Adam's-own-sum-of-judgment. The framework reads the binding-and-loosing-substance in continuity with the Tanakh-rabbinic *asar* (bind) and *hattir* (loose) — the apostolic-authority to declare-the-Torah's-substance against-the-Pharisaic-tradition's-corruption operates downstream-of-the-King's-own-sum-of-judgment, NOT as a magisterial-authority-to-define-doctrine-against-scripture.
cards.new_note: *And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.* (1 Enoch 69:27). *Whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven* (Matthew 16:19). The sum of judgement was given to the Son of Adam on the throne of his glory; what the apostles bind and loose is bound and loosed under that judgement, not beside it.

cards.old_note: *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates ... and the metals of the earth and the art of working them ... and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* 1 Enoch 8:1 names THE architectural-root of the *skandalon* (stumbling-block) substance the King's millstone-warning at Matt 18:6 lands-on. The framework reads the verse as the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substance behind the seed-war: the watchers taught-the-children-of-men the substance that placed-the-stumbling-blocks across the way of the walker. The framework reads this in continuity with the Tanakh-*mikshol* of Vayikra (Leviticus) 19:14 (*thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind*) and Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 57:14 (*take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people*); the architecture behind those Tanakh-commands is the architecture 1 Enoch names the source of. The little-ones-who-believe whom the King protects with the millstone-warning are the same vulnerable-walkers the Torah-and-prophets named the protection-substance for. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* (1 Enoch 8:1). *Whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck* (Matthew 18:6). The stumbling-blocks laid across the way of the little ones have a history: Azazel taught men the arts that became the snares. The millstone is the King's answer to the teacher of the snare.

cards.old_note: *And these places have been made for them until the day of their judgement and until their consummation, till the consummation of their judgement is consummated for ever and ever upon the sinners.* 1 Enoch 22:11 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the place-of-the-eternal-judgment-substance — the architecture-of-judgment the King names is *better* than the substance the millstone-and-the-sea would produce. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:6's *it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck.* The wisdom-stream had named the day-of-the-judgment-and-the-consummation as the substance-the-sinners-against-the-righteous-walk-toward; the King names the millstone-and-the-sea as the lesser-mercy compared with that judgment-substance. The framework reads the *consummation of their judgement* in continuity with the gehenna-substance of the Tanakh-*gei-Hinnom* (Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 7:32-33's *valley of slaughter*; Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 66:24's *worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched*) — the destruction the King names against the systems-causing-the-stumble, NOT the inherited-Christian-eternal-conscious-torment doctrine read-back into the substance.
cards.new_note: *Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.* (1 Enoch 22:11). *It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea* (Matthew 18:6). Better than what? Than the place Enoch was shown — spirits set apart in great pain until the great day of judgement, and bound there. The sea is the lesser end.

cards.old_note: *And the Lord of the sheep took the staff of His wrath, and cast it upon the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth, and it covered them.* 1 Enoch 89:42 names the wisdom-stream's Animal-Apocalypse articulation of the Lord-of-the-sheep's-substance — the One who-acts-to-deliver his sheep from the beasts-and-birds-that-devour. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:11's *the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost.* The Lord-of-the-sheep substance of 1 Enoch 89-90 is the wisdom-stream's carrying-forward of the Tanakh-Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34 shepherd-substance into apocalyptic-vision-form; the King is the same Lord-of-the-sheep at the historical-pivot, walking-in-flesh to gather-the-scattered-sheep per Red Line #7's reading of the lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) mission-scope at Matt 10:6 and Matt 15:24. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.* (1 Enoch 90:18). *For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost* (Matthew 18:11). The Lord of the sheep comes to the flock in person, staff in hand, and the beasts and birds that devoured them are swallowed by the earth. The saving of the lost is the Lord of the sheep arriving.

cards.old_note: *And Enoch blessed the Lord of the sheep and said: "Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (God), Yahuah (the Lord) of the sheep."* 1 Enoch 89:54 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Lord-of-the-sheep-title substance — the wisdom-stream identifies the Lord-of-the-sheep with Yahuah by name. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:12's shepherd-parable. The King's *if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?* is the same Lord-of-the-sheep-substance the wisdom-stream had named the substance of — the One who-acts-personally to seek-the-one-strayed. The Tanakh-and-wisdom-stream had named the substance; the King-in-flesh enacts the substance; the substance is the same shepherd at every register.
cards.new_note: *And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.* (1 Enoch 89:54). *If a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?* (Matthew 18:12). Enoch's vision names the owner of the flock: Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, whose house and tower the sheep forsook. The shepherd of the parable is not a hired man; he is the Lord of the sheep seeking his own.

cards.old_note: *And I saw till all the beasts and the birds and the wild animals were gathered, and they all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to fall down upon his face and to worship him.* 1 Enoch 90:18 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the consummation-rejoicing the Lord-of-the-sheep walks-toward. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:13's *if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.* The Lord-of-the-sheep's-rejoicing-over-the-found-one is the substance the wisdom-stream had named at the eschatological-consummation register — the gathering-of-the-sheep at the consummation is the same shepherd-substance the King names at the assembly-internal-level. The two-levels of the shepherd-substance — the assembly's-internal-little-ones AND the canon-wide lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) mission-scope — both derive from the same Lord-of-the-sheep architecture 1 Enoch had carried-forward from Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34.
cards.new_note: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *He rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray* (Matthew 18:13). Enoch saw that joy at the end: the Lord of the sheep rejoicing with great joy because all that had been dispersed had returned to his house. The parable's one sheep is the vision's whole flock.

cards.old_note: *And he said unto me: "This first is Michael, the merciful and long-suffering: and the second, who is set over all sickness and all wounds, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is Phanuel."* 1 Enoch 40:9 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the four-presences-before-the-Father substance — the messengers who-have-direct-access-to-the-throne, whose-substance is mercy and long-suffering and healing and repentance-unto-hope. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:10's *I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.* The little-ones' guardian-messengers operating in the Tanakh-and-Second-Temple guardian-messenger pattern (Shemot (Exodus) 23:20, Tehillim (Psalm) 91:11, Daniel 10:13, Acts 12:15, Hebrews 1:14) are the same architectural-substance 1 Enoch names for the chief-presences; the disciples' disposition-toward-the-little-ones is bounded by the architectural-substance of the messengers' direct-throne-access on behalf of those little-ones.
cards.new_note: *And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’* (1 Enoch 40:9). *In heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 18:10). Enoch is given the names of the four who stand before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits — mercy, healing, power, and repentance unto hope. The little ones are watched over from the throne itself.

cards.old_note: *Woe to you who are rich! For you have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall you depart, Because you have not remembered Yahuah (God) of Spirits in the days of your riches.* 1 Enoch 94:3 names THE direct Enochic wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the woe-against-trust-in-riches substance — the same substance the King names at Matt 19:23's *verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.* The framework reads the verse against the King's-warning. The Enochic-substance had named the architecture-directly: the rich-man's-substance of trusting-in-riches operates against-the-remembering-Yahuah (God)-of-Spirits substance the kingdom-citizen-substance walks. The substance is heart-substance — *where your treasure is, there will your heart be also* per Matt 6:21's Sermon-substance. The Enochic-woes-against-the-rich extended-corpus across 1 Enoch 94-100 unfolds the substance the King-summarizes at Matt 19:23-24. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture-in-extended-form; the King applies the substance at the camel-eye-of-needle-pivot.
cards.new_note: *Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.* (1 Enoch 94:8). *A rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 19:23). Enoch's woe says why: those who trust in riches depart from them, having not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of their wealth. The difficulty is not the money; it is the trust.

cards.old_note: *Woe to you who acquire gold and silver in unrighteousness And say: "We have become rich with riches and have possessions; And we have acquired everything that we have desired."* 1 Enoch 97:7 names the Enochic wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substance-of-the-rich-man's-self-congratulation — the substance the rich-young-ruler's *all these things have I kept from my youth up* at Matt 19:20 carries-by-implication-of-the-young-man's-claim-to-have-acquired-everything-the-young-man-has-desired. The framework reads the verse against Matt 19:23's warning about the rich man's difficulty-entering-the-kingdom. The Enochic-substance names the architecture-of-the-acquired-everything-we-have-desired substance the rich-man-walks-in — the substance the rich-young-ruler had-walked-out at v.22 (the *went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions* substance reveals the heart-the-possessions-hold). The wisdom-stream had named the substance the kingdom-citizens' substance contrasts with — the substance of the Father-as-the-treasure (Mishlei (Proverbs) 30:8-9, Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 9:23-24).
cards.new_note: *Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.* (1 Enoch 97:7). *A rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 19:23). The young ruler's confidence — *all these things have I kept from my youth up* — is the sinner's confidence Enoch names: a remembrance that is evil against him, however secure the holdings look.

cards.old_note: *And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.* 1 Enoch 94:8 names the Enochic wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the rich-man's-internal-monologue — the *let us do what we purposed* substance that-presupposes the gathered-silver and the many-husbandmen as-the-foundation-for-doing-what-the-rich-man-has-purposed. The framework reads the verse against Matt 19:24's camel-through-the-eye-of-a-needle hyperbole — the impossibility-deliberately-stated. The Enochic-substance names the substance directly — the rich-man-presumes-on-his-resources to-do-what-he-has-purposed (the substance the King-will-name explicitly in the rich-fool parable at Luke 12:16-21's *I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods*). The substance the rich-man-presumes-on is the substance-that-cannot-fit through-the-eye-of-the-needle. The wisdom-stream and the gospel cohere at the architecture — the substance-the-rich-man-presumes-on against-the-substance-the-Father-actually-provides.
cards.new_note: *And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,* (1 Enoch 97:9). *It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God)* (Matthew 19:24). Enoch gives the rich man's own speech — silver gathered, granaries full, *let us do what we purposed.* That speech is the needle's eye closing.

cards.old_note: *And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their unrighteousness.* 1 Enoch 100:6 names THE direct Enochic wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *riches shall not be able to save them* substance — the substance the King names at Matt 19:26's *with men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible.* The framework reads the verse against the King's-statement. The Enochic-substance names the architecture directly: the rich-substance cannot-save; the natural-substance cannot-accomplish the kingdom-entry-substance. The King's-substance at v.26 lands the substance the Father makes-possible — the new-heart-substance of Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27's *a new heart also will I give you... I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes.* The Father's-substance is the substance that-softens-the-heart-the-possessions-hold and-enables-the-substance the natural-substance-cannot-walk.
