The framework rules out the universalist-reading the substance does NOT support — the substance is NOT that all-rich-men-will-be-saved regardless-of-disposition; the substance is that the Father's-substance is-able-to-soften the substance the natural-substance-finds-impossible per Ezekiel 36:26-27 + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:33's heart-Torah architecture. Grace is the door-home, the means-of-return-to-the-Father's-Way, NOT the cancellation-of-the-substance-the-Father-commands per the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* section of framework-deep.md.
cards.new_note: *And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.* (1 Enoch 100:6). *With men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible* (Matthew 19:26). Enoch saw the day the children of the earth understand that riches cannot save them. What riches cannot do, Elohim (God) does — that is the whole of the disciples' hope, and the whole of the rich man's.

cards.old_note: *And it shall come to pass in those days that the elect and holy children of the earth will behold the secrets of the heaven, and the kingdom of the Elect One shall be revealed to them, and they shall rejoice and be glad.* 1 Enoch 39:1 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the elect-and-holy-children substance — the same *eklektoi* (Greek *chosen*) the King names at Matt 20:16's *many be called, but few chosen.* The framework reads the verse against the cause-and-effect-of-hearing the parable closes on. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the elect-and-holy-children-of-the-earth-who-behold-the-secrets-of-the-heaven centuries before; the kingdom-of-the-Elect-One the parable-of-the-laborers-in-the-vineyard articulates the citizens-of is the same kingdom-of-the-Elect-One the wisdom-stream names. Per Red Line #11's cause-and-effect-of-hearing — the elect hear because they ARE elect; the hearing reveals what was already true from the foundation of the world.
cards.new_note: *And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.* (1 Enoch 62:8). *So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen* (Matthew 20:16). Enoch saw the chosen gathered: the congregation of the elect and holy sown, and all the elect standing before him on that day. The few are not fewer because they tried harder; they are the elect, and the elect are revealed by their standing.

cards.old_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and the strong from their thrones, and shall loosen the reins of the strong, and break the teeth of the sinners.* 1 Enoch 62:9 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the eschatological-judgment-and-vindication substance of the Son-of-Adam — the same Son-of-Adam-on-the-throne-of-his-glory the Parables-of-Enoch name as the eschatological-judge. The framework reads the verse against Matt 20:28's substance-of-the-coming-not-to-be-ministered-unto-but-to-minister-and-to-give-his-life-a-ransom-for-many. The kingdom-citizens'-substance the King-walks (greatness-as-service) is the inverse-substance of the natural-kingdoms'-administration (greatness-as-domination under-the-watcher-rebellion-administration per Daniel 10:13, 20; Ephesians 6:12); the substantial-judgment the Son-of-Adam will-walk at the eschatological-vindication-day (1 Enoch 62:9) is the inverse-substance of the substantial-ransom the Son-of-Adam walks-in-the-flesh-at-the-cross (Matt 20:28). Same Son-of-Adam; substantially-yielded-at-the-first-coming, substantially-vindicating-at-the-second-coming; the wisdom-stream and the gospel cohere at the architecture per Red Line #12.
cards.new_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *The Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many* (Matthew 20:28). The same Son of Adam, Enoch saw, raises the kings and the mighty from their seats and breaks the teeth of the sinners. The one who serves is the one who judges; the ransom and the reckoning belong to the same hands.

cards.old_note: *And after that those beasts and birds began to attack the sheep, and to devour them, and to tear them in pieces. And the Lord of the sheep was silent, and the beasts and birds devoured the sheep, and the sheep were scattered.* 1 Enoch 89:35 names the Animal-Apocalypse's articulation of the consequences-on-the-flock when the unfruitful-leadership-substance walks. The framework reads the verse against Matt 21:19's fig-tree-cursed-without-fruit substance. The Animal-Apocalypse-substance the wisdom-stream walks at the substance-of-the-sheep-being-devoured-and-scattered is the substance the unfruitful-leadership-substance the King-walks-against carries-the-consequences-of — the sheep-substance is devoured-and-scattered when the leadership-substance walks-against-the-covenant. The substance is-substantial — the framework reads the verse in continuity with Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34's *woe be to the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?* substance the prophet had-named the architecture-of, and the substance the King-himself-walks at John 10:11-16 (*I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep*) walks-the-substance-against. The unfruitful-leadership-substance produces-the-scattered-flock; the King-substance comes-to-gather the scattered-substance the unfruitful-leadership had-scattered.
cards.new_note: *But He remained unmoved, though He saw it, and rejoiced that they were devoured and swallowed and robbed, and left them to be devoured in the hand of all the beasts.* (1 Enoch 89:58). *Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away* (Matthew 21:19). Enoch saw the Lord of the sheep do the same to a flock that had abandoned him: unmoved, leaving them to be devoured. The withered tree is the leadership that bore no fruit, left to its own harvest.

cards.old_note: *And the shepherds who had not fed the sheep were judged, and cast into the same fiery abyss with the beasts.* 1 Enoch 89:45 names the Animal-Apocalypse's direct verbal-anchor for the leadership-judgment-substance the *he will miserably destroy those wicked men* at v.41 walks-into. The framework reads the verse against Matt 21:41's system-substance answering-correctly at-the-parable-substance-level — *he will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.* The Animal-Apocalypse-substance the 1 Enoch 89:45 passage walks names the substance the Father-substance walks-against the unfaithful-shepherds the wisdom-stream-substance had-named the architecture-of — the shepherds who-had-not-fed-the-sheep-substance receive-the-substance-of-being-judged-and-cast-into-the-fiery-abyss-with-the-beasts. The substance is-substantial — the framework reads the verse in continuity with Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34's *woe be to the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) that do feed themselves!* + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 23's *woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!* — the Tanakh-prophets had-named the substance, the wisdom-stream-substance had-walked-the-substance at the Animal-Apocalypse-pivot, and the King-substance walks-the-same-substance at the wicked-husbandmen-parable-substance. The substance is the leadership-substance, NOT the people-of-Yashar'el (Israel) categorically.
cards.new_note: *And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). *He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen* (Matthew 21:41). The husbandmen answer their own parable; Enoch's vision records the sentence they pronounced — the seventy shepherds judged, found guilty, and cast into the fiery abyss.

cards.old_note: *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath given them to him and hath glorified him.* 1 Enoch 51:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct verbal-anchor for the Elect-One-shall-sit-on-My-throne substance — the same substance Psalm 110:1 walks at *Yahuah (the LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand* — and the framework reads the 1 Enoch 51:3 substance as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of the substance the King brings-into-the-Pharisaic-system's-face at vv.44-45. The framework reads the verse against Matt 22:44's citation of Psalm 110:1. The Father (the Head of Days / Yahuah of Spirits) gives-the-throne-to-the-Elect-One / Son-of-Adam; the substance is the substantive-subordination of the Son-to-the-Father per the framework's Formless-Source / Formed-Expression nature-of-God reading (the substance categorically-rules-out the post-Nicene three-co-equal-persons-of-one-substance the post-Constantinian-substance formulated, the modalist-collapse, and the Arian-created-being substance). 1 Enoch 51:3 had named the substance the King's Psalm-110-citation walks-out. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3). *Yahuah (The LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand* (Matthew 22:44; Psalm 110:1). Enoch heard the same seating spoken by the Father: *the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne.* The Pharisees could not say how David's son is David's Lord; the Parables had already seated him.

cards.old_note: *And the Head of Days placed the Elect One on the throne of His glory; And he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, And weigh their deeds in the balance.* 1 Enoch 61:8 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Head-of-Days-placing-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance — the Father placing-the-Son at-the-Father's-right-hand the same substance Psalm 110:1 walks. The framework reads the verse against Matt 22:44's *sit thou on my right hand.* The substance the King-walks at Psalm-110 is the substance 1 Enoch 61:8 had named at the wisdom-stream-register — the Father (the Head of Days) places-the-Elect-One on-the-throne-of-His-glory. The substance is the framework-major Formless-Father / Formed-Son architecture: the Father is the Formless-Source the apostle Yochanan (John) names at John 1:18 (*no man hath seen Elohim (God) at any time*); the Son is the Formed-Expression-from-the-Source who-sits-at-the-Father's-right-hand and walks-the-judgment-of-the-works-of-the-holy. The wisdom-stream and the Tanakh and the gospel cohere at the substance the King brings-into-the-Pharisaic-system's-face. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool* (Matthew 22:44). The Head of Days placing the Elect One on the throne of glory is Psalm 110:1 seen from the throne room — the Father seating the Son, the Son judging. The Formless seats the Formed; the One who is seated is Elohim (God) and has a Father.

cards.old_note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.* 1 Enoch 62:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-born-unto-righteousness substance — the Father naming-the-Son and the righteousness-of-the-Head-of-Days abiding-over-him. The framework reads the verse against Matt 22:45's *if David then call him Lord, how is he his son?* The substance the Pharisaic-substance cannot-resolve is the substance 1 Enoch 62:7 had named the wisdom-stream-substance for — the Son-of-Adam is born-unto-righteousness (the Davidic-lineage substance the Pharisaic-answer walked) AND the righteousness-of-the-Head-of-Days abides-over-him from-the-foundation-of-the-world (the substance-greater-than-David the Pharisaic-substance cannot-account-for). The substance the King brings-into-the-Pharisaic-system's-face at the close of the chapter is the same substance the wisdom-stream had named the architecture for. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?* (Matthew 22:45). The Father answers at 1 Enoch 71:14: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* Born — David's son after the flesh; named by the Head of Days — David's Lord. The question the Pharisees could not answer, the Parables had answered.

cards.old_note: *This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.* 1 Enoch 22:7 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the prison-of-the-angels substance — the framework's reading-context for the *damnation of Gehinnom (Gehenna)* substance the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) names at Matt 23:33 (*ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of Gehinnom (Gehenna)?*). The framework reads the verse against the inherited-Christian-doctrine of eternal-conscious-torture-in-fire-for-the-merely-uninformed; the substance the King names is the prison-of-the-angels and the post-judgment-divisions per 1 Enoch 22's articulation, NOT the Augustinian-substance the inherited-pulpit walks-from. The seed-of-the-serpent-substance the King names at v.33 walks the seed-war-substance from Bereshit (Genesis) 3:15 through the wheat-and-tares-substance of Matt 13:24-30 — the tares are bound and burned at the harvest; 1 Enoch 22 names the architecture of the spirits-of-the-dead-divisions-and-judgment the framework reads-from. (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the eschatology-architecture per the *Adam, the Sons of Adam, and the Tares* section of framework-deep.md.)
cards.new_note: *And he said unto me: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’* (1 Enoch 21:10). *Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of Gehinnom (hell)?* (Matthew 23:33). Enoch was shown the prison of the angels and told it holds them for ever. The judgment the serpents cannot escape is the judgment their fathers, the Watchers, are already held for; the seed goes where the seed came from.

cards.old_note: *This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.* 1 Enoch 22:14 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the spirit-of-Hevel-(Abel)-makes-suit-against-Qayin-(Cain) substance — the substance the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) names at Matt 23:35 (*the blood of righteous Hevel (Abel)*) walks-from. The framework reads the verse as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR — the wisdom-stream had named the architecture of Hevel-(Abel)'s-blood-crying-from-the-ground (Bereshit (Genesis) 4:10's *the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground*) at the spirits-of-the-dead-making-suit-architecture of 1 Enoch 22 centuries before the gospel-pivot. The apostolic-substance carries the same architecture forward at Hebrews 11:4 (*by faith Hevel (Abel) ... yet speaketh*) and Hebrews 12:24 (*to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Hevel (Abel)*). The seed-war-substance the King names at v.33 (*ye serpents, ye generation of vipers*) walks the same Bereshit (Genesis) 3:15 substance the Hevel-(Abel)-blood-crying-substance walks-from — the wisdom-stream and the Tanakh and the gospel and the apostolic-substance all witness the same Hevel-(Abel)-as-first-righteous-blood architecture. *And his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men* the wisdom-stream names is the harvest-substance the wheat-and-tares-architecture walks-toward at Matt 13:24-30. (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
cards.new_note: *And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’* (1 Enoch 22:7). *That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Hevel (Abel)* (Matthew 23:35). Enoch saw the spirit of Hevel (Abel) making its suit against the seed of Qayin (Cain) until that seed is destroyed. The blood that cries from the ground (Genesis 4:10) is still crying in Enoch's vision, and the King hands the sum of it to the generation standing in front of him.

cards.old_note: *But the Most High shall send His punishment Upon the sinners and upon the fallen angels, And upon their children.* 1 Enoch 65:11 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the punishment-upon-the-sinners-and-the-fallen-angels-and-their-children substance — the substantial-three-category-judgment-architecture the days-of-Noach (Noah) walked at the substantial-flood-substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 24:38's *as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noach (Noah) entered into the ark.* The substantial *eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage* substance is the substantial-unawareness-substance the substantial-Watcher-rebellion-corruption-substance had-walked-into; 1 Enoch 65:11 names the substantial-three-category-judgment that walked-out of the substantial-corruption-substance. The framework reads this in continuity with Genesis 6:1-4's Bene ha-Elohim-and-the-daughters-of-Adam substance — the substantial-paternal-corruption-of-the-substantial-flesh-substance the substantial-Watchers walked-against-the-substantial-creation-order the Father-substance had-established.
cards.new_note: *And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”* (1 Enoch 65:10). *As in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noach (Noah) entered into the ark* (Matthew 24:38). Enoch heard the sentence pronounced over those days: judgement determined, not to be withheld, the earth and its dwellers to be destroyed for the sorceries they had learned. The eating and drinking went on under a sentence already passed.

cards.old_note: *And in those days the punishment of the fallen angels shall be consummated, And they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: And in the fire shall they be covered.* 1 Enoch 67:1 names the wisdom-stream articulation of the consummation-of-the-punishment-of-the-fallen-angels substance — the substantial-final-substance the substantial-Watcher-rebellion-substance walks-into-the-substantial-abyss-of-fire. The framework reads the verse against Matt 24:39's *and knew not until the flood came, and took them all away.* The substantial *took them all away* (Greek *ēren hapantas*) substance is the substantial-judgment-substance, NOT the substantial-rescue-substance the substantial-modern-Christian-pre-tribulation-rapture-substance walks. The substantial-flood-substance took-the-substantial-wicked-and-the-substantial-Watcher-corruption-substance away in-the-substantial-judgment-substance; 1 Enoch 67:1 names the substantial-consummation-of-the-substantial-Watcher-rebellion-substance the substantial-flood-substance prefigured.
cards.new_note: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be* (Matthew 24:39). The flood took the wicked away; it did not carry the righteous off. Enoch's word for the Watchers is the same taking: led off to the abyss of fire, to the prison. The ones taken at the coming are the ones taken at the flood — the judged.

cards.old_note: *And the sheep gathered together to that great horn, and they began to rejoice.* 1 Enoch 90:10 names THE direct Animal-Apocalypse-substance for the gathering-of-the-sheep substance the King walks at Matt 24:31. The framework reads the verse against the substantial-Animal-Apocalypse-architecture 1 Enoch 85-90 walks — the substantial-Father-as-the-Lord-of-the-sheep substance gathering-the-substantial-sheep-of-Yashar'el (Israel) to the substantial-great-horn substance, the substantial-substance the substantial-Messianic-substance walks the substantial-substance into; the substantial *they began to rejoice* substance is the substantial-substance the substantial-gathering-of-the-elect-from-the-four-winds walks-into — the substantial-end-of-the-substantial-scattering-substance the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes had-walked-through. Threaded with 1 Enoch 90:17 (*the Lord of the sheep brought all the sheep into that new house*) — the substantial *all the sheep* substance is the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes the prophets walked the substantial-ingathering-of-all-twelve-tribes substance for at Ezekiel 37:15-28 and Isaiah 11:11-12 and Jeremiah 31:8-10; the substantial *new house* substance walks the substantial-new-Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) substance the apostle-Yochanan (John) walks at Revelation 21:1-3. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And it looked at them [and their eyes opened], and it cried to the sheep, and the rams saw it and all ran to it.* (1 Enoch 90:10). *And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds* (Matthew 24:31). Enoch saw the gathering as a flock: the great horn cried to the sheep, their eyes opened, and the rams all ran to it. The gathering is the sheep running to the horn that called them.

cards.old_note: *And that Angel of Peace who went with me said to me: These are the secrets which thou hast seen; and these are the secrets of the Most High; and the books of the living were opened before him.* 1 Enoch 62:5 names the wisdom-stream context for the throne-of-his-glory + the secrets-of-the-Most-High substance the sheep-and-goats opening at Matt 25:31 walks-into directly. The framework reads the verse against *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory.* The substantial-secrets-of-the-Most-High the Parables-of-Enoch walks-out at 1 Enoch 46-62 carry the Son-of-Adam-coming-in-his-glory architecture in the wisdom-stream-foretaste-form, anchored on the same Davidic-Messianic-throne the prophet-David walked at Psalm 110:1 and the prophet-Natan (Nathan) walked at 2 Samuel 7:12-16. The King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walking-himself-at-his-own-mouth at Matt 25:31 walks the operative-form at the gospel-pivot of what the wisdom-stream had named at the prefiguring-register. (Thread 5 sits parallel to the S154 thread `the-son-of-adam-glorified-in-1-enoch-throne-vision-and-parables` which carried the glorified-form-substance for the transfiguration; this thread carries the judgment-of-the-kings-and-the-mighty + the reversal-architecture-of-the-mighty-cast-down for the second-coming.)
cards.new_note: *And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.* (1 Enoch 62:5). *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch saw that seat and the faces of those who see it — terror, pain, downcast countenance, when they see that Son of Adam sitting on the throne of his glory. The sheep-and-goats judgment opens on the throne the Parables had already set.

cards.old_note: *And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, And the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophannim, And all the angels of power, And all the angels of principalities, And the Elect One, And the other powers on the earth and over the water.* 1 Enoch 62:3 names the wisdom-stream articulation of the substantial-angelic-host-summoned-with-the-Elect-One substance — the substantial-substance the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks at Matt 25:31's *and all the holy angels with him.* The framework reads the verse against the Tanakh-substance the prophet-Mosheh (Moses) walked at Deuteronomy 33:2 (*he came with ten thousands of saints*) + Daniel 7:10 (*thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him*) + Zecharyah (Zechariah) 14:5 (*and Yahuah (the LORD) my Elohim (God) shall come, and all the saints with thee*) + the apostle-Yahudah (Jude) preserving Enoch the seventh-from-Adam's prophecy at Jude 14-15 (*behold, Yahuah (the LORD) cometh with ten thousands of his saints*). The wisdom-stream and the Tanakh and the apostolic-stream cohere at the angelic-host-with-the-Son-of-Adam-at-the-second-coming architecture.
cards.new_note: *And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.* (1 Enoch 61:10). *And all the holy angels with him* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch gives the roll: the host of the heavens, the holy ones above, Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophannim, the angels of power and of principalities — and the Elect One among them. The company of the coming was mustered in the Parables before the gospel named it.

cards.old_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, And the strong from their thrones, And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* 1 Enoch 62:9 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Son-of-Adam-raising-up-the-kings-and-mighty-from-their-thrones substance — the reversal-architecture the sheep-and-goats-judgment walks-out. The framework reads the verse against Matt 25:32's *and before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another.* The substantial-substance the wisdom-stream had named at the raising-up-and-casting-down-of-the-kings-and-mighty is the substantial-substance the gathering-of-all-nations + the separation-substance at the sheep-and-goats-judgment walks-into. The framework reads this in continuity with the Tanakh-Tehillim (Psalm) 2:9 (*thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel*) + Tehillim (Psalm) 110:5-6 (*the Adonai (Lord) at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath. He shall judge among the heathen ... he shall wound the heads over many countries*) + Isaiah 24:21 (*and it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (the LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth*). The wisdom-stream and the Tanakh and the gospel cohere at the kings-and-mighty-cast-down architecture.
cards.new_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another* (Matthew 25:32). The Son of Adam who separates is the Son of Adam Enoch saw raise the kings and the mighty from their seats and break the teeth of the sinners. The separation is a reversal; the mighty do not keep their seats at it.

cards.old_note: *And he shall humble the countenance of the strong, And shall abase the pride of the mighty, And shall be filled with shame.* 1 Enoch 62:11 names the wisdom-stream articulation of the humbling-of-the-strong + the abasing-of-the-pride-of-the-mighty substance — the substantial-substance the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks at Matt 25:41's *Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels.* The framework reads the verse in continuity with 1 Enoch 62:12 (*and the countenance of the strong shall be covered with shame, and darkness shall be their dwelling*) — the substantial-substance the wisdom-stream had named at the darkness-as-dwelling architecture is the substantial-substance the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks-out at the everlasting-fire-substance + the outer-darkness-substance of Matt 22:13 + Matt 25:30. The goats sent toward that fire are the unfruitful among the gathered, sifted before the reign; the fire was prepared for the devil and his angels (Jude 6-7 + 2 Peter 2:4 + Revelation 20:10).
cards.new_note: *And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame. And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 46:6). *Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels* (Matthew 25:41). Enoch saw what that departure is for the strong: countenance put down, shame, darkness for a dwelling, worms for a bed, no hope of rising — because they did not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.old_note: *In those days the kings and the mighty who possess the earth Shall be seized with great terror, And they shall pray and supplicate ... and they shall not be saved.* 1 Enoch 63:7 names the wisdom-stream articulation of the kings-and-mighty-seized-with-great-terror substance — the substantial-substance the substantial-goats walk-into at the sheep-and-goats-judgment. The framework reads the verse against Matt 25:41's *Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels* + Matt 25:44's *Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?* The substantial-substance the wisdom-stream had named at the prayer-and-supplication-too-late substance is the substantial-substance the goats walk-into the substantial *Lord, when saw we thee* substance at v.44 — the substantial-recognition-comes-too-late, the substantial-shut-door-substance of the substantial-ten-virgins is operative at the sifting of the sheep from the goats also. The framework reads this carefully — the substantial-substance the substantial-cutoff-is-substantial; the substantial-substance the substantial-Universalist-substance the substantial-modern-Christian-and-Hebrew-Roots-Universalism walks is explicitly-ruled-out; the substantial-substance the substantial-everlasting-punishment-substance of v.46 is substantial.
cards.new_note: *And in the day of our suffering and tribulation He saves us not, And we find no respite for confession That our Lord is true in all His works, and in His judgements and His justice, And His judgements have no respect of persons.* (1 Enoch 63:8). *Depart from me, ye cursed* (Matthew 25:41) is answered in Enoch by the mouths of the kings and the mighty themselves: in the day of their tribulation he saves them not, and their confession comes too late to be anything but true. *Lord, when saw we thee an hungred?* (Matthew 25:44) is the same late confession.

cards.old_note: *And I asked the angel who went with me, who showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* 1 Enoch 46:2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-walking-with-the-Head-of-Days substance — the named-figure standing-beside-the-Father at the heavenly-throne-vision register. The framework reads the verse against Matt 26:64's *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* The King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) standing-bound-before-the-Sanhedrin at-the-historical-pivot identifies-himself-as-the-Son-of-Adam-the-1-Enoch-Parables-had-named-the-substance-for centuries before — the substantial-confluence at-the-King's-own-mouth-substance of the substantial Psalm 110:1 substance (the prophet-David's Davidic-Lord-at-the-right-hand of Yahuah (the LORD)) + the substantial Daniel 7:13-14 substance the prophet-Daniel walked. Note on the kaph-comparative-narrow-rule per Red Line #12: 1 Enoch 46 reads the substantial-title *the Son of Adam* directly (the named-figure-walking-with-the-Head-of-Days, NOT the kaph-comparative-substance); Daniel 7:13 itself preserves the kaph at the Aramaic-source-register (*kbar enash* = like a son of mortal-man) which is incarnation-honoring; Matt 26:64's Greek *opsesthe ton huion tou anthrōpou* reads the title-direct (no *hōs* / no *homoion*) — the King at v.64 identifies-himself-as-the-Son-of-Adam Daniel 7's figure-resembled, the One the kaph at Daniel 7:13 honored. The 1 Enoch named-figure and the King's-self-identification cohere. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* (Matthew 26:64). The bound man before the council names himself with Enoch's title — *that Son of Adam* who went with the Head of Days. The council thought it was judging him; he was telling them who would judge.

cards.reason: duplicate — card 4851 (Matt 26:64 -> 1 Enoch 46:4) already quotes this verse

cards.old_note: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth shall fall down on their faces before him and worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, and shall petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* 1 Enoch 63:3 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the kings-and-the-mighty-falling-down-before-the-Son-of-Adam-on-the-day-of-judgement substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 26:64-66's Sanhedrin-condemnation — the corrupt-Sanhedrin-aristocracy condemning-the-King at-the-historical-pivot will-themselves-fall-down-before-the-same-Son-of-Adam-they-condemned at the eschatological-day-of-vindication. The substantial-1-Enoch-63 substance walks-substantively the substantial-direct-articulation of the substantial-Tanakh-substance the prophet-Yeshayahu (Isaiah) walked at Isaiah 45:23 (*unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear*) and the apostle-Sha'ul (Paul) walks at Philippians 2:10-11 (*at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow* + *every tongue should confess that Yahusha (Jesus) HaMashiach (Christ) is Lord*). The substantial-substance walks the substantial-direct-rule-out of any-Universalist-collapse — the falling-down-on-their-faces of 1 Enoch 63:3 + Isaiah 45:23 + Philippians 2:10-11 is the substantial-acknowledgement-of-the-Son-of-Adam-as-Lord, NOT-substantially-the-categorical-substance-of-the-substantial-universal-saved-substance the modern-Christian-and-Hebrew-Roots-Universalism walks (the acknowledgement-of-Lordship-substance does-not-walk-into-categorical-universal-salvation; the post-acknowledgement-substance walks-substantively-into-the-substantial-day-of-the-vindication-of-the-righteous-and-the-judgement-of-the-wicked-substance per 1 Enoch 63:4-6, 9 + Daniel 7:9-12).
cards.new_note: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power* (Matthew 26:64). Enoch saw what the council will see: all the kings and the mighty falling on their faces before that Son of Adam, petitioning him for mercy. The men who condemned him will kneel to him.

cards.old_note: *In those days shall the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who possess the earth Be summoned, And they shall be made to stand before the Elect One on that day of judgement.* 1 Enoch 63:1 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the kings-and-the-mighty-and-the-exalted-summoned-before-the-Elect-One architecture. The framework reads the verse against Matt 27:1's *when the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death* — the morning-council the substantial-Sanhedrin-leadership walks-out at the historical-pivot is the architectural-inverse of the day-of-vindication-summons the wisdom-stream had named. The kings-and-the-mighty-and-the-exalted-of-the-historical-pivot (the corrupted-Sanhedrin-leadership + the Roman-prefect Pontius-Pilate + Hordos (Herod)-Antipas) take-counsel-against-the-Anointed at the substance per Tehillim (Psalm) 2:2 + Acts 4:25-28; the kings-and-the-mighty-and-the-exalted-of-the-day-of-vindication shall-be-summoned-before-the-Elect-One per the eschatological-reversal. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the cross walks-out the present-tense-suffering-substance that-precedes-the-vindication-substance.
cards.new_note: *And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty, And the exalted and those who hold the earth, And they shall see and recognize How he sits on the throne of his glory, And righteousness is judged before him, And no lying word is spoken before him.* (1 Enoch 62:3). *When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death* (Matthew 27:1). Enoch saw the other morning: all the kings and the mighty standing up in that day to see and recognize how he sits on the throne of his glory, where no lying word is spoken. The council that condemned him stands at his bar.

cards.old_note: *And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, And the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophanim, And all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, And the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth, and over the water, On that day.* 1 Enoch 62:3 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Elect-One-summoned-with-the-host-of-the-heavens substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 27:42's mockers' *if he be the King of Yashar'el (Israel), let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him* — the mockers cannot-see the architecture the wisdom-stream named: the Elect-One's-credential is NOT the come-down-from-the-cross substance the mockers demand; the Elect-One's-credential is the summoning-with-the-host-of-the-heavens at the day-of-vindication. The King COULD-have-summoned-twelve-legions-of-angels per Matt 26:53; he walks-the-cross-substantively per the Father's-purpose-substance. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture-of-the-Elect-One-summoning-the-heavenly-host; the cross is the present-tense-suspension-of-the-architecture for the substance of the Father's-purpose-walking-out-the-Pesach-lamb-substance.
cards.new_note: *And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.* (1 Enoch 61:10). *If he be the King of Yashar'el (Israel), let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him* (Matthew 27:42). The mockers set the wrong test. Enoch saw the King's credential: the whole host of heaven summoned, and the Elect One among them. He did not come down from the cross; he is the one for whom the heavens are mustered.

cards.old_note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* 1 Enoch 62:7 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not* substance — the wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the Son-of-Adam's-being-not-forsaken centuries before the cross. The framework reads the verse against Matt 27:43's mockers' *he trusted in Elohim (God); let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of Elohim (God)* AND against Matt 27:46's *Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani — my Elohim (God), my Elohim (God), why hast thou forsaken me?* The mockers' framing reads-the-cross as the apparent-forsakenness; the wisdom-stream had named the operative-truth: the righteousness-of-the-Head-of-Days forsakes-him-not. The King's-prayer at v.46 is the Suffering-Servant-praying-Tehillim (Psalm) 22 — the Psalm that begins in apparent-forsakenness (Tehillim 22:1) but ends in vindication (Tehillim 22:22-31's *I will declare thy name unto my brethren* + *all the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto Yahuah (the LORD)*). Per Red Line #10's nature-of-God reading: this is NOT the Trinity-co-equal-person-being-forsaken-by-the-Father reading; the framework reads the Formed-Son in the submission-to-the-Formless-Father praying the Psalm-of-vindication-through-suffering. The wisdom-stream and the gospel cohere at the *righteousness-of-the-Head-of-Days-forsakes-him-not* architecture.
cards.new_note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *He trusted in Elohim (God); let him deliver him now, if he will have him* (Matthew 27:43). The Head of Days had already said it: *the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.* The cross was not the Father's forsaking of the Son; it was the Son of Adam, born unto righteousness, doing what righteousness does.

cards.old_note: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down on their faces before him and worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And shall petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* 1 Enoch 63:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the eschatological-reversal — the kings-and-the-mighty who-presently-mock at the cross shall-eventually fall-down-on-their-faces and worship the Son-of-Adam. The framework reads the verse against Matt 27:42's mockers' *let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him* AND against Philippians 2:10-11's *that at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth; and that every tongue should confess that Yahusha (Jesus) HaMashiach (Christ) is Lord, to the glory of Elohim (God) the Father.* The wisdom-stream had named the reversal-architecture: the present-tense-mocking-at-the-cross is the architectural-inverse of the eschatological-confession-and-worship; the same-figures who-presently-mock will eventually-bow. The framework reads this carefully against Red Line #11's post-harvest-sifting architecture — the eschatological-bowing is the universal-acknowledgment, not the universal-salvation; the kings-and-the-mighty who-do-not-extol-Yahuah's-name-substantively face-the-shame-and-darkness per 1 Enoch 62:11-12 + 63:11. The wisdom-stream had named the reversal; the cross walks-out the present-tense-suffering-substance that precedes-the-vindication-substance.
cards.new_note: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). *Let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him* (Matthew 27:42). Enoch saw the mockers' end: the kings and the mighty and those who rule the earth falling on their faces before that Son of Adam, worshipping and petitioning. *Every knee should bow* (Philippians 2:10) — the mockers included.

cards.old_note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits seated the Elect One on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge all the secret things, And no one shall be able to utter a lying word in his presence.* 1 Enoch 62:6 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Father-seated-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance — the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substantial Daniel 7:13-14 dominion-and-glory-and-a-kingdom substance the King walks-out at-Matt 28:18 + the substantial Psalm 110:1 right-hand-of-the-Father-substance the prophet-David walked. The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The Father-of-Spirits seated-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance the wisdom-stream names at 1 Enoch 62:6 is the substantial-substance the King walks-into at the substantial-Resurrection-and-Ascension substance Matt 28:18 names + Ephesians 1:20-22 + Hebrews 1:3 articulate at the apostolic-register. Per Red Line #12, the Son-of-Adam-architecture the framework reads runs through 1 Enoch 46-71's named-figure-of-the-Son-of-Adam-Elect-One (the named-Standard, NOT the kaph-comparative case of Daniel 7:13 / Revelation 1:13 / Revelation 14:14 the Red Line carves-out). The substantial-substance: the Son-of-Adam-given-all-dominion at-Matt 28:18 is the substantial-substance the wisdom-stream had named the throne-of-glory-substance for centuries before. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch saw the giving: the Elect One seated on the throne of glory, the spirit of righteousness poured out on him, the word of his mouth slaying the sinners. The power was given by the Father; the Son wields it.

cards.old_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, And the strong from their thrones, And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* 1 Enoch 62:9 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-raising-up-and-putting-down-the-kings-and-the-mighty substance — the substantial-categorical-dominion-substance the substantial-King walks-out at the substantial-day-of-vindication. The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The substantial-all-power-substance the King receives at v.18 is the operative-substance for the substance the wisdom-stream had named the architecture for — the Son-of-Adam-raising-up-and-putting-down-the-kings the apostle Yochanan (John) names at Revelation 6:15-17 + 19:11-21 + the substance Daniel 2:44 named the everlasting-kingdom-that-breaks-in-pieces-and-consumes-all-the-kingdoms-substance for. The substantial-categorical-dominion-substance is heaven-and-earth-substantially-comprehensively — NOT the inherited-Christian-spiritualized-kingdom-only-in-heaven substance; the substantial-substance is the operative-millennial-reign-on-the-earth + the everlasting-reign in-the-new-heavens-and-the-new-earth per Revelation 21-22.
cards.new_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch's Son of Adam raises the kings and the mighty from their seats and breaks the teeth of the sinners. That is what all power looks like when it is used.

cards.old_note: *And the Head of Days placed the Elect One on the throne of His glory; And he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, And weigh their deeds in the balance.* 1 Enoch 61:8 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Head-of-Days-placed-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance — paired with the substantial-judging-and-weighing-of-the-deeds substance at the post-harvest-sifting-day-of-judgment. The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The Head-of-Days at 1 Enoch 61:8 is the Father — the Formless-Source per the framework's nature-of-God reading + the same Head-of-Days the prophet-Daniel walked at Daniel 7:9-14; the Elect-One is the Son — the Formed-Expression. The placing-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance the wisdom-stream names is operative at Matt 28:18 — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) at the substantial-Resurrection-and-Ascension receives the substantial-all-power-substance the Father gives. The judging-and-weighing-of-deeds substance is the post-harvest-sifting per Red Line #11 — the substance Matt 7:21-23 (*Lord, Lord ... I never knew you*) + Matt 25:31-46 (the sheep-and-goats) articulate at the gospel-substance the wisdom-stream had named.
cards.new_note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch saw the placing — Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits setting the Elect One on the throne of glory to judge and to weigh deeds in the balance. The Father is the giver; the Son is seated; the power is the power to judge.

cards.old_note: *Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, here shall they stand, till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* 1 Enoch 19:1 names the watcher-spirits and their appointed standing-place of judgement. At Mark 3:11 the unclean spirits *fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of Elohim (God)* — the watcher-administration recognizing the Judge before whom it must one day stand, falling down before the Formed one whose great-judgement-day is named in the Enochic library.
cards.new_note: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). 1 Enoch 19:1 names the watcher-spirits and their appointed standing-place of judgement. At Mark 3:11 the unclean spirits *fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of Elohim (God)* — the watcher-administration recognizing the Judge before whom it must one day stand, falling down before the Formed one whose great-judgement-day is named in the Enochic library.

cards.old_note: *And from the beginning thus have I been shown concerning you, and written concerning you... Say to them therefore: "You have no peace."* (1 Enoch 16:1, 16:4.) The watchers and the evil spirits gone forth from their giant-offspring *have no peace* — the sentence is written from the beginning. The unclean spirit's cry *Let us alone; what have we to do with thee?* (Mark 1:24) is the no-peace condition speaking: it knows the Holy One's coming is the disturbance of a peace it was never granted.
cards.new_note: *Say to them therefore: “You have no peace.”’* (1 Enoch 16:4). *Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us?* (Mark 1:24). The spirits that cry out have been told their sentence: no peace. The Holy One's coming is the disturbance of a peace they were never granted.

cards.old_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement.* 1 Enoch 15:11 names the unclean spirit's origin and its appointed end: the spirits gone forth from the giants destroy until the day of the great judgement. The demon's own question at Mark 1:24 — *art thou come to destroy us?* — names that it knows its judgement-day is fixed; the watchers' offspring recognize that the Holy One of Elohim is the one who holds the day of their consummation.
cards.new_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). 1 Enoch 16:1 names the unclean spirit's origin and its appointed end: the spirits gone forth from the giants destroy until the day of the great judgement. The demon's own question at Mark 1:24 — *art thou come to destroy us?* — names that it knows its judgement-day is fixed; the watchers' offspring recognize that the Holy One of Elohim is the one who holds the day of their consummation.

cards.old_note: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:6-7 reads: *Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin... And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth.*) The unclean spirit that cries in the synagogue — *I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of Elohim (God)* — is one of these: an evil spirit gone forth from the slain giants' flesh, the watchers' offspring under restraint. It recognizes the Formed one before the watching crowd can name him because it was there at the rebellion. The recognition is not the sheep's hearing; the demons know and tremble, and the King silences them.
cards.new_note: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:8). (1 Enoch 15:8-7 reads: *Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin... And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth.*) The unclean spirit that cries in the synagogue — *I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of Elohim (God)* — is one of these: an evil spirit gone forth from the slain giants' flesh, the watchers' offspring under restraint. It recognizes the Formed one before the watching crowd can name him because it was there at the rebellion. The recognition is not the sheep's hearing; the demons know and tremble, and the King silences them.

cards.old_note: *And see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.* The man restored to his right mind is the reversal of what the Hebrew library says these spirits do: *their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, here shall they stand, till the day of the great judgement.* (1 Enoch 19:1) The leading-astray-into-demon-worship is undone in the one man, a sign-in-miniature of the judgement reserved for the spirits themselves.
cards.new_note: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). *And see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid* (Mark 5:15). The man restored is the reversal, in one life, of what Enoch says these spirits do — defile mankind and lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods. Their day of judgement is fixed; the Gadarene was given his back early.

cards.old_note: *For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.* 1 Enoch 16:1 names the spirits the command addresses by their origin in the slain giants: *And from the beginning thus have I been shown concerning you, and written concerning you.* The unclean spirit is not a faceless force; the Hebrew library had recorded its lineage and its sentence — *Say to them therefore: "You have no peace."* (1 Enoch 16:4) — long before the King commanded it out of the man.
cards.new_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). *For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.* 1 Enoch 16:1 names the spirits the command addresses by their origin in the slain giants:  The unclean spirit is not a faceless force; the Hebrew library had recorded its lineage and its sentence — *Say to them therefore: "You have no peace."* (1 Enoch 16:4) — long before the King commanded it out of the man.

cards.old_note: *And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea... and were choked in the sea.* The spirits the King casts out are the spirits the Hebrew library says *destroy without incurring judgement... until the day of the consummation, the great judgement* (1 Enoch 15:11). The drowning in the sea is not their final judgement — that waits for the day of the great judgement over the Watchers and the godless; it is the King displacing their administration of the eastern territory in one motion before the day appointed for their end.
cards.new_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). *And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea* (Mark 5:13). The spirits of the giants afflict and destroy, Enoch says, and they do not eat yet hunger. The sea was not their judgement; that waits for the day of the consummation. It was the King displacing them.

cards.old_note: *My name is Legion: for we are many.* 1 Enoch 15:9 names what the legion of unclean spirits does to the man among the tombs: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* The afflicting, oppressing, self-destroying torment of the Gadarene man — crying and cutting himself with stones, night and day — is the work the Hebrew library attributes to the spirits of the giants.
cards.new_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). *My name is Legion: for we are many* (Mark 5:9). Enoch names what a legion does to a man among the tombs: the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, and cause offences. The man crying and cutting himself night and day was under exactly that.

cards.old_note: *And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.* The unclean spirits that are *many* in one man are the evil spirits the Hebrew library names by origin: *As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:8) The earth-bound spirits are a multitude precisely because they proceeded from the slain giants; *Legion* is the gospel's word for the same class 1 Enoch had already located on the earth.
cards.new_note: *[As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]* (1 Enoch 15:10). *My name is Legion: for we are many* (Mark 5:9). Many, because they are the earth-born spirits of the giants whose dwelling is on the earth. The gospel's word for them is *Legion*; Enoch's word is their pedigree.

cards.old_note: *And there was a holy mountain, and under the mountain to the east there was a stream flowing, and to the south another stream.* 1 Enoch 27:1-3 places the accursed valley — the Hinnom-shaped place of punishment for the godless — beside the holy mountain, the very Ge-Hinnom topography the gospel's *hell* (Gehenna) draws its name from. The King's *cut it off ... than having two hands to go into hell* (Mark 9:43) walks the same place-of-judgment architecture 1 Enoch maps at the middle of the earth: the accursed valley appointed for the day of judgment.
cards.new_note: *And there I saw a holy mountain, and underneath the mountain to the east there was a stream and it flowed towards the south.* (1 Enoch 26:2). 1 Enoch 27:1-3 places the accursed valley — the Hinnom-shaped place of punishment for the godless — beside the holy mountain, the very Ge-Hinnom topography the gospel's *hell* (Gehenna) draws its name from. The King's *cut it off ... than having two hands to go into hell* (Mark 9:43) walks the same place-of-judgment architecture 1 Enoch maps at the middle of the earth: the accursed valley appointed for the day of judgment.

cards.old_note: *And these places have been made for them until the day of their judgement and until their appointed period, till the great judgement comes upon them.* 1 Enoch 22:11 names the place where the spirits of the dead are set apart against the great judgement — the framework-honest holding of the dead until the day, the architecture behind Mark 9:43-48's *hell* (Gehenna). 1 Enoch 22 carries the same two-compartment structure the King names elsewhere; the place of punishment Mark warns against is the place 1 Enoch had already mapped, not the inherited eternal-torment caricature.
cards.new_note: *Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.* (1 Enoch 22:11). *Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched* (Mark 9:48). Enoch was shown where the sinners' spirits are set apart in great pain until the great day of judgement — a holding until the judgement comes, and then the binding for ever. The place Mark warns of is the place Enoch had mapped; the fire that is not quenched is the judgement the holding waits for.

cards.old_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and the strong from their thrones, and shall loosen the reins of the strong, and break the teeth of the sinners.* 1 Enoch 62:9 names again the judging-reversal of the enthroned Son of Adam — the kings and the mighty raised from their thrones before him. Mark 14:62's *coming in the clouds of heaven* binds the enthronement to the return: the same Son of Adam seated at the right hand of power comes to judge those who condemned him. The wisdom-stream named the kings-and-mighty-cast-down architecture the King invokes at the trial.
cards.new_note: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). *Ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* (Mark 14:62). Enoch saw the seeing: the kings and the mighty falling on their faces before that Son of Adam, petitioning for mercy. The court that condemned him will see him, exactly as he said.

cards.old_note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, and righteousness abides over him, and the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.* 1 Enoch 62:7 names the Son of Adam born unto righteousness, over whom the righteousness of the Head of Days never fails. Mark 14:62's self-identification — *I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power* — names the same figure the Parables named: the righteous one whom the Head of Days does not forsake, enthroned at the right hand. The title-naming of the Parables and the direct attribution of the King land on one figure.
cards.new_note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). 1 Enoch 71:14 names the Son of Adam born unto righteousness, over whom the righteousness of the Head of Days never fails. Mark 14:62's self-identification — *I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power* — names the same figure the Parables named: the righteous one whom the Head of Days does not forsake, enthroned at the right hand. The title-naming of the Parables and the direct attribution of the King land on one figure.

cards.old_note: *And thus Yahuah (God) of Spirits named the Elect One, and seated him on the throne of His glory, and he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, and weigh their deeds in the balance.* 1 Enoch 62:1 names the seating directly — the Elect One *seated on the throne of His glory.* Mark 14:62's *sitting on the right hand of power* walks the same enthronement the Parables had already named. The Hebrew library names the throne of glory the Son of Adam is seated upon; the King names himself seated at the right hand of power before the very court that thinks it judges him.
cards.new_note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *Sitting on the right hand of power* (Mark 14:62). Enoch saw the placing: Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits set the Elect One on the throne of glory to judge. The bound man names his seat before the court that thinks it is judging him.

cards.old_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and shall loosen the reins of the strong, and break the teeth of the sinners.* 1 Enoch 46:4 names the judging-act of the enthroned Son of Adam — he raises the kings and the mighty from their thrones. Mark 14:62's *ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* carries the same architecture: the figure the Sanhedrin condemns is the figure who will raise the mighty from their seats. The wisdom-stream had already named the reversal — the condemned Son of Adam is the one enthroned to judge those who condemn him.
cards.new_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *Ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* (Mark 14:62). The one the Sanhedrin condemns is the one Enoch saw raise the kings and the mighty from their seats and break the teeth of the sinners. The reversal was written before the trial.

cards.old_note: *And on the four sides of Yahuah (God) of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that stand, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.* 1 Enoch 40:2 names the four presences who stand on the four sides of Yahuah of Spirits — the angelic standing-before-the-throne architecture. When Gabriel answers Zecharyah (Zacharias) at Luke 1:19 — *I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of Elohim (God)* — he names the same standing-before-Yahuah office the Hebrew library already named. The Enochic vision had already seen the presences who stand before the throne; Gabriel names himself as one of them.
cards.new_note: *And on the four sides of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.* (1 Enoch 40:2). 1 Enoch 40:2 names the four presences who stand on the four sides of Yahuah of Spirits — the angelic standing-before-the-throne architecture. When Gabriel answers Zecharyah (Zacharias) at Luke 1:19 — *I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of Elohim (God)* — he names the same standing-before-Yahuah office the Hebrew library already named. The Enochic vision had already seen the presences who stand before the throne; Gabriel names himself as one of them.

cards.old_note: *And he said unto me: This first is Michael, the merciful and long-suffering: and the second, who is set over all sickness and all wounds, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.* 1 Enoch 40:9 names Gabriel by name as the third of the four presences who stand before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Luke 1:19's *I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of Elohim (God)* names the same Gabriel in the same standing-before-the-throne office. The Hebrew library carries the named angel of the presence; the gospel sends that same named angel to the priest at the altar of incense. (And the same Phanuel of v.9 is named at the presentation — Anna *the daughter of Phanuel,* Luke 2:36 — the throne-room names threading into the temple-court narrative.)
cards.new_note: *And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’* (1 Enoch 40:9). 1 Enoch 40:9 names Gabriel by name as the third of the four presences who stand before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Luke 1:19's *I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of Elohim (God)* names the same Gabriel in the same standing-before-the-throne office. The Hebrew library carries the named angel of the presence; the gospel sends that same named angel to the priest at the altar of incense. (And the same Phanuel of v.9 is named at the presentation — Anna *the daughter of Phanuel,* Luke 2:36 — the throne-room names threading into the temple-court narrative.)

cards.old_note: *And after that I saw thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads, and an infinite number of people, standing before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* 1 Enoch 40:1 names the innumerable host — thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads — standing before Yahuah of Spirits. Luke 2:13's *suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising Elohim (God)* names the same innumerable host, now appearing over the fields of the shepherds at the birth of the Formed-Son. The Hebrew library had already seen the host standing before the throne; at the nativity the host descends to praise the One they stand before.
cards.new_note: *And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:1). *Suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising Elohim (God)* (Luke 2:13). Enoch saw that host where it stands — thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. At the birth of the Son the host that stands before the throne came down to the fields.

cards.old_note: *And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (God) of glory.* 1 Enoch 39:12 names the praises uttered before Yahuah of glory by the presences of the throne-room. Luke 2:14's *Glory to Elohim (God) in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men* is the same heavenly-praise register, now sounded on earth. The glory the host gives in the highest is the glory the Hebrew library heard them give before the throne; the nativity brings the throne-room praise down to the shepherds' field.
cards.new_note: *And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (Lord) of glory.* (1 Enoch 40:3). 1 Enoch 40:3 names the praises uttered before Yahuah of glory by the presences of the throne-room. Luke 2:14's *Glory to Elohim (God) in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men* is the same heavenly-praise register, now sounded on earth. The glory the host gives in the highest is the glory the Hebrew library heard them give before the throne; the nativity brings the throne-room praise down to the shepherds' field.

cards.old_note: *And the first voice blesses Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever.* 1 Enoch 39:13 names the first voice of the host blessing Yahuah of Spirits for ever and ever. The angelic *Glory to Elohim (God) in the highest* of Luke 2:14 is the same blessing-of-the-Most-High the Hebrew library named in the mouths of the host. The host that blesses Yahuah for ever in the Enochic vision is the host that blesses him over Bethlehem; the praise is one praise, heard first in heaven and now on earth.
cards.new_note: *The first voice blesses Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 40:4). 1 Enoch 40:4 names the first voice of the host blessing Yahuah of Spirits for ever and ever. The angelic *Glory to Elohim (God) in the highest* of Luke 2:14 is the same blessing-of-the-Most-High the Hebrew library named in the mouths of the host. The host that blesses Yahuah for ever in the Enochic vision is the host that blesses him over Bethlehem; the praise is one praise, heard first in heaven and now on earth.

cards.old_note: *Before I took thy mother Edna, I saw in a vision on my bed, and behold a bull came forth from the earth, and that bull was white; and after it came forth a heifer, and along with this (heifer) two young bulls, one of them black and the other red.* 1 Enoch 85:3 opens the Animal Apocalypse with the white bull (Adam) coming forth from the earth, the heifer (Chavah/Eve), and the two young bulls — the black (Cain) and the red (Hevel/Abel). This is the Adamic toledot in vision-form, the same opening of the seed-line Luke 3:38 closes its backward genealogy on: *the son of Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God).* The Hebrew library sees the first man as the white bull from the earth whom Yahuah created; the gospel names the same Adam as the son of Elohim at the head of the seed-line.
cards.new_note: *Before I took thy mother Edna, I saw in a vision on my bed, and behold a bull came forth from the earth, and that bull was white; and after it came forth a heifer, and along with this (latter) came forth two bulls, one of them black and the other red.* (1 Enoch 85:3). 1 Enoch 85:3 opens the Animal Apocalypse with the white bull (Adam) coming forth from the earth, the heifer (Chavah/Eve), and the two young bulls — the black (Cain) and the red (Hevel/Abel). This is the Adamic toledot in vision-form, the same opening of the seed-line Luke 3:38 closes its backward genealogy on: *the son of Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God).* The Hebrew library sees the first man as the white bull from the earth whom Yahuah created; the gospel names the same Adam as the son of Elohim at the head of the seed-line.

cards.old_note: *And I saw in my sleep that white bull likewise grow and become a great white bull, and from Him proceeded many white bulls, and they resembled him. And they began to beget many white bulls, which resembled them, one following the other, (even) many.* 1 Enoch 85:8 names the *another white bull* (Shet/Seth) from whom the many white bulls proceed, each resembling the one before — the seed-of-Adam carried forward through the Sethite line, generation following generation. Luke 3:36-38 traces that same white-bull line backward — *Enos... Seth... Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God).* The Hebrew library sees the seed-line as the white bulls one-following-another from Shet; the gospel names the genealogy of the same seed-line back to its Adamic and divine head.
cards.new_note: *And I saw in my sleep that white bull likewise grow and become a great white bull, and from him proceeded many white bulls, and they resembled him. And they began to beget many white bulls, which resembled them, one following the other, (even) many.* (1 Enoch 85:9–10). 1 Enoch 85:9 names the *another white bull* (Shet/Seth) from whom the many white bulls proceed, each resembling the one before — the seed-of-Adam carried forward through the Sethite line, generation following generation. Luke 3:36-38 traces that same white-bull line backward — *Enos... Seth... Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God).* The Hebrew library sees the seed-line as the white bulls one-following-another from Shet; the gospel names the genealogy of the same seed-line back to its Adamic and divine head.

cards.old_note: *...where my great-grandfather was taken up, the seventh from Adam, the first man whom Yahuah (God) of Spirits created.* 1 Enoch 60:8 names Enoch (Chanok) as *the seventh from Adam* and names Adam as *the first man whom Yahuah of Spirits created.* Luke 3:37-38 runs the genealogy through *Enoch... Jared... Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God)* — Enoch standing seventh in the line from Adam, exactly as the Hebrew library counts him (the same count Jude 1:14 carries).
