This is the *prison* Peter speaks of when the Messiah *went and preached unto the spirits in prison* (1 Peter 3:19): a real holding-place of bound spirits, kept against the appointed day, not annihilated but reserved.

cards.old_note: *'This place is the end of heaven and earth: this has become a prison for the stars and the host of heaven.* (1 Enoch 21:5). Enoch is brought to the place the angel names *a prison for the stars and the host of heaven* — the seven stars *which roll over the fire... which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God).* It is the prison house of the angels; *this place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever* (1 Enoch 21:11). Peter names this same prison: *the spirits in prison* (1 Peter 3:19), the bound host of the days of Noah to whom the quickened Son proclaimed.
cards.new_note: *The angel said: ‘This place is the end of heaven and earth: this has become a prison for the stars and the host of heaven.* (1 Enoch 18:14). Enoch is brought to the place the angel names *a prison for the stars and the host of heaven* — the seven stars *which roll over the fire... which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God).* It is the prison house of the angels; *this place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever* (1 Enoch 21:11). Peter names this same prison: *the spirits in prison* (1 Peter 3:19), the bound host of the days of Noah to whom the quickened Son proclaimed.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 90:17 — *And a new house was built greater and loftier than the first, and the Lord of the sheep brought all the sheep into that new house.* The house the Lord shall choose, named from the book of Enoch, is the new house Enoch saw the Lord gather His own into.
cards.new_note: 1 Enoch 90:29 — *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.* The house the Lord shall choose, named from the book of Enoch, is the new house Enoch saw the Lord gather His own into.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 91 — *And after that in the seventh week shall arise a perverse generation, And many shall be its deeds, But all its deeds shall be apostasy.* — "I have read in the writing of Enoch that ye yourselves also shall depart from Yahuah" reaches for the very book of Enoch that foretells the generation of apostasy (self-link).
cards.new_note: *And after that in the sixth week all who live in it shall be blinded, And the hearts of all of them shall godlessly forsake wisdom. And in it a man shall ascend; And at its close the house of dominion shall be burnt with fire, And the whole race of the chosen root shall be dispersed.* (1 Enoch 93:8). 1 Enoch 91 —  — "I have read in the writing of Enoch that ye yourselves also shall depart from Yahuah" reaches for the very book of Enoch that foretells the generation of apostasy (self-link).

cards.old_note: *Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said unto me: 'Enoch, why hast thou such fear and affright?' And I answered: 'Because of this fearful place, and because of the spectacle of the pain.'* (1 Enoch 21:10). Enoch is shown *the prison of the angels,* where *they will be imprisoned for ever* (1 Enoch 21:11) — a place of fire and abyss beyond measure. This is the *hell* and the *chains of darkness* into which the angels that sinned were cast (2 Peter 2:4); the apostle points to the very prison the library showed Enoch, the fearful place reserved for the Watchers unto judgment.
cards.new_note: *And he said unto me: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’* (1 Enoch 21:10). *Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness* (2 Peter 2:4). Enoch was shown the place and told what it is. The apostle points to the prison the library shows.

cards.old_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His set-apart ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). This is the very verse Jude quotes: *And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) cometh with ten thousands of his saints, To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him* (Jude 1:14-15). Word for word — *cometh with ten thousands,* *to execute judgment upon all,* *convict/convince all flesh... of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed,* *the hard things/hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* An apostle, the brother of James, names *Enoch, the seventh from Adam* a true prophet and cites his book as prophecy. The library is one; it ain't new — the apostle reads the restored writing as the word it is.
cards.new_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). This is the very verse Jude quotes: *And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) cometh with ten thousands of his saints, To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him* (Jude 1:14-15). Word for word — *cometh with ten thousands,* *to execute judgment upon all,* *convict/convince all flesh... of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed,* *the hard things/hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* An apostle, the brother of James, names *Enoch, the seventh from Adam* a true prophet and cites his book as prophecy. The library is one; it ain't new — the apostle reads the restored writing as the word it is.

cards.old_note: *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.* (1 Enoch 21:6). Enoch is shown the prison of *the stars... which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God),* bound *till the time when their guilt should be consummated* (1 Enoch 21:7). These are Jude's *wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever* (Jude 1:13) — the stars that would not keep their appointed course, the very image of the ungodly who keep not the faith once delivered.
cards.new_note: *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.* (1 Enoch 18:15). Enoch is shown the prison of *the stars... which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God),* bound *till the time when their guilt should be consummated* (1 Enoch 21:7). These are Jude's *wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever* (Jude 1:13) — the stars that would not keep their appointed course, the very image of the ungodly who keep not the faith once delivered.

cards.old_note: *And I saw a flaming fire, and beyond that fire I saw a mountain whose summit reached to heaven* (1 Enoch 14:16). The throne *high and lifted up* whose *train filled the temple* (Isaiah 6:1) is the throne of flaming fire Enoch beholds — *a flaming fire... a mountain whose summit reached to heaven*. The Glory Isaiah saw enthroned is the same fire-wrapped Presence of Enoch's vision.
cards.new_note: *And the Great Glory sat thereon, and His raiment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow.* (1 Enoch 14:20). *I saw Yahuah (the Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple* (Isaiah 6:1). Enoch saw the Great Glory seated, his raiment brighter than the sun and whiter than snow. The train that filled the temple is the raiment Enoch could not look upon.

cards.old_note: *But the middle one reached to heaven, like the throne of Yahuah (God), of stibium, and the top of the throne was of sapphire* (1 Enoch 14:15). Enoch's throne-vision frames the throne Isaiah saw *high and lifted up* (Isaiah 6:1): a throne that *reached to heaven, like the throne of Yahuah (God)*, sapphire-topped. The same exalted throne, the same Glory none could approach.
cards.new_note: *And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.* (1 Enoch 14:18). *I saw Yahuah (the Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up* (Isaiah 6:1). Enoch saw the same lofty throne — crystal, wheels like the shining sun, cherubim — and the Glory none could approach (1 Enoch 14:20–21). The prophet and the patriarch stood before one throne.

cards.old_note: *And the first voice blesses Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever* (1 Enoch 39:13). The whole earth *full of his glory* (Isaiah 6:3) is sung in heaven without ceasing — *the first voice blesses Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever*. The trisagion of the seraphim is the unending blessing the holy ones pour before the throne; one worship, in heaven and over all the earth.
cards.new_note: *The first voice blesses Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 40:4). *The whole earth is full of his glory* (Isaiah 6:3) is sung in heaven without ceasing: the first voice blesses Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever. One worship, in heaven and over all the earth.

cards.old_note: *And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (God) of glory* (1 Enoch 39:12). The seraphim who *cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy* (Isaiah 6:3) are the holy ones Enoch hears at the throne — the four presences who *uttered praises before Yahuah (God) of glory*. The restored witness shows the same ceaseless worship before the same throne of glory that filled Isaiah's temple.
cards.new_note: *And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (Lord) of glory.* (1 Enoch 40:3). The seraphim who *cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy* (Isaiah 6:3) are the holy ones Enoch hears at the throne — the four presences who *uttered praises before Yahuah (God) of glory*. The restored witness shows the same ceaseless worship before the same throne of glory that filled Isaiah's temple.

cards.old_note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not* (1 Enoch 62:7). The *righteous servant* who shall *justify many* (Isaiah 53:11) is the Son of Adam *born unto righteousness*, hidden from before the world and now revealed — the Elect One in whom righteousness dwells. The restored witness binds the suffering-and-justifying servant to the exalted Son of Adam before the Head of Days.
cards.new_note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). The *righteous servant* who shall *justify many* (Isaiah 53:11) is the Son of Adam *born unto righteousness*, hidden from before the world and now revealed — the Elect One in whom righteousness dwells. The restored witness binds the suffering-and-justifying servant to the exalted Son of Adam before the Head of Days.

cards.old_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats... And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners* (1 Enoch 62:9). The servant who was *numbered with the transgressors* (Isaiah 53:12) — humbled, despised, slain — is the same Son of Adam exalted to judge the kings and the mighty. The pattern is one: rejected and cut off, then *divide him a portion with the great* (53:12); the suffering servant and the enthroned Elect One are the same Formed Son.
cards.new_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). The servant who was *numbered with the transgressors* (Isaiah 53:12) — humbled, despised, slain — is the same Son of Adam exalted to judge the kings and the mighty. The pattern is one: rejected and cut off, then *divide him a portion with the great* (53:12); the suffering servant and the enthroned Elect One are the same Formed Son.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 20:5 — *Michael, one of the holy and honoured angels, who is set over the best part of mankind and over chaos.* Michael, named first to bury Adam, is the chief of the holy angels in the Watcher-tradition's own roster.
cards.new_note: 1 Enoch 20:5 — *Michael, one of the holy angels, to wit, he that is set over the best part of mankind and over chaos.* Michael, named first to bury Adam, is the chief of the holy angels in the Watcher-tradition's own roster.

cards.old_note: *And on that day I will cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them, and I will change the heaven and the earth and the light and the darkness, and I will make the earth a thing of light* (1 Enoch 45:4). *For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth* (Isaiah 65:17) — the restored apocalyptic witness sings the same renewal: the heaven and the earth *changed*, the earth made *a thing of light*, the Elect One dwelling among his people. The new creation of the prophet is the new age of the parables.
cards.new_note: *Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light: And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.* (1 Enoch 45:4–5). *For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth* (Isaiah 65:17). Enoch heard the same promise from the same mouth: the heaven transformed into an eternal blessing and light, the earth transformed into a blessing, the Elect One dwelling among his people. The prophet's new creation is the age of the Parables.

cards.old_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His set-apart ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness* (1 Enoch 1:9). *Yahuah (LORD) will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury* (Isaiah 66:15); *by fire and by his sword will Yahuah (LORD) plead with all flesh* (66:16). 1 Enoch sees the same coming-in-judgement to *convict all flesh* — the verse Jude later quotes by name; the library's own witness to the fiery advent.
cards.new_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). *Yahuah (LORD) will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury* (Isaiah 66:15); *by fire and by his sword will Yahuah (LORD) plead with all flesh* (66:16). 1 Enoch sees the same coming-in-judgement to *convict all flesh* — the verse Jude later quotes by name; the library's own witness to the fiery advent.

cards.old_note: *And I will make the sinners to be as straw in the fire, and they shall burn before the face of the holy, and they shall not be quenched* (1 Enoch 45:5). *By fire and by his sword will Yahuah (LORD) plead with all flesh* (Isaiah 66:16); *neither shall their fire be quenched* (66:24). 1 Enoch sees the sinners burning *and they shall not be quenched* — the same unquenchable fire of judgment that closes Isaiah's book.
cards.new_note: *And I will give them over into the hands of Mine elect: As straw in the fire so shall they burn before the face of the holy: As lead in the water shall they sink before the face of the righteous, And no trace of them shall any more be found.* (1 Enoch 48:9). *By fire and by his sword will Yahuah (the LORD) plead with all flesh* (Isaiah 66:16); *neither shall their fire be quenched* (Isaiah 66:24). Enoch sees the sinners given into the hands of the elect, burning as straw before the face of the holy, sinking as lead before the face of the righteous. The fire that closes Isaiah is the fire of the Parables.

cards.old_note: *And on that day I will cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them, and I will change the heaven and the earth and the light and the darkness, and I will make the earth a thing of light* (1 Enoch 45:4). *As the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me* (Isaiah 66:22) — 1 Enoch sees Yahuah *change the heaven and the earth* and make the earth light, the same renewal of creation in which the seed and name remain.
cards.new_note: *Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light: And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.* (1 Enoch 45:4–5). *As the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me* (Isaiah 66:22). Enoch heard Yahuah (Lord) promise to transform the heaven and the earth and set his elect upon it, the sinners shut out. The renewal in which the seed and the name remain is the renewal the Parables saw.

cards.old_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His set-apart ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly* (1 Enoch 1:9). *The chariots of Elohim (God) are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: Yahuah (Lord) is among them, as in Sinai* (Psalm 68:17): the psalm's thousands are angels, the chariotry of the coming One. Enoch's *ten thousands of His set-apart ones* are another company: the seed of promise, gathered and coming with him into the land (Zechariah 14:5). The angels attend him; his saints come with him.
cards.new_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). *The chariots of Elohim (God) are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: Yahuah (the Lord) is among them, as in Sinai* (Psalm 68:17): the psalm's thousands are angels, the chariotry of the coming One. Enoch's ten thousands of holy ones are another company — the seed of promise, gathered and coming with him into the land (Zechariah 14:5). The angels attend him; his saints come with him.

cards.old_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His set-apart ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness* (1 Enoch 1:9). *Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still* (Psalm 76:8): the restored apocalyptic sees the same judgment come down from above — He comes with His set-apart ones to execute judgment upon all, the earth made still before the One who arises to judge.
cards.new_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). *Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still* (Psalm 76:8): the restored apocalyptic sees the same judgment come down from above — He comes with His holy ones to execute judgment upon all, the earth made still before the One who arises to judge.

cards.old_note: *And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years* (1 Enoch 18:14). The *host of the high ones that are on high* whom Yahuah will *punish* (Isaiah 24:21) are the stars of heaven who transgressed — and Yahuah *bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated*. The punishment of the high host is their binding in the prison of the abyss.
cards.new_note: *And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years.’* (1 Enoch 18:16). The *host of the high ones that are on high* whom Yahuah will *punish* (Isaiah 24:21) are the stars of heaven who transgressed — and Yahuah *bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated*. The punishment of the high host is their binding in the prison of the abyss.

cards.old_note: *And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years* (1 Enoch 21:7). *They shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited* (Isaiah 24:22) — exactly the sentence Enoch sees: *bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated*. The host is shut in the pit *till the time* of visitation; the prophet and the witness see one judgment.
cards.new_note: *And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years.’* (1 Enoch 18:16). *They shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited* (Isaiah 24:22) — exactly the sentence Enoch sees: *bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated*. The host is shut in the pit *till the time* of visitation; the prophet and the witness see one judgment.

cards.old_note: *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times* (1 Enoch 21:6). *Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high* (Isaiah 24:21) — the restored witness names that host: the stars that *transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God)*, the rebel powers above who *did not come forth at their appointed times*. The high ones on high are the transgressing host bound for judgment.
cards.new_note: *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.* (1 Enoch 18:15). *Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high* (Isaiah 24:21) — the restored witness names that host: the stars that *transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God)*, the rebel powers above who *did not come forth at their appointed times*. The high ones on high are the transgressing host bound for judgment.

cards.old_note: *And thus Yahuah (God) of Spirits named the Elect One, And seated him on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, And weigh their deeds in the balance* (1 Enoch 62:1). *Yahuah (LORD) reigneth, he is clothed with majesty... the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved* (Psalm 93:1): the restored witness shows the enthronement as the Father seating the Son — Yahuah of Spirits names the Elect One and seats him on the throne of His glory; the One who reigns clothed with majesty is the Formed Son enthroned by the Most High, never a co-equal self-seating.
cards.new_note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *Yahuah (The LORD) reigneth, he is clothed with majesty... the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved* (Psalm 93:1). The restored witness shows the reign as the Father placing the Son on the throne of glory to judge; the One who reigns is the One who seats, and the One seated is the Formed.

cards.old_note: *And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again... and how they do not leave their orbit... and they keep faith one with another: and in accordance with an oath they set and they rise* (1 Enoch 41:5). The sun and moon that *shall not smite thee by day... nor... by night* (Psalm 121:6) are not powers to dread but oath-bound servants of the Maker, keeping the courses he set. The Keeper rules the very lights, so they cannot harm the one he keeps.
cards.new_note: *And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.* (1 Enoch 41:5). The sun and moon that *shall not smite thee by day... nor... by night* (Psalm 121:6) are not powers to dread but oath-bound servants of the Maker, keeping the courses he set. The Keeper rules the very lights, so they cannot harm the one he keeps.

cards.old_note: *And they shall raise one voice and bless and glorify and extol and praise the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits... and shall all say with one voice: "Blessed is He, and may the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits be blessed for ever and ever"* (1 Enoch 61:11). The capstone's summons of *every thing that hath breath* is the host of heaven raising ONE voice — the same final, unanimous Hallelujah the Psalter ends on.
cards.new_note: *On that day shall raise one voice, and bless and glorify and exalt in the spirit of faith, and in the spirit of wisdom, and in the spirit of patience, and in the spirit of mercy, and in the spirit of judgement and of peace, and in the spirit of goodness, and shall all say with one voice: "Blessed is He, and may the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits be blessed for ever and ever."* (1 Enoch 61:11). The capstone's summons of *every thing that hath breath* is the host of heaven raising ONE voice — the same final, unanimous Hallelujah the Psalter ends on.

cards.old_note: *And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (God) of glory* (1 Enoch 39:12). The praise the capstone commands below is already sounding above — the four presences before the throne uttering the praise *every thing that hath breath* is now gathered into.
cards.new_note: *And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (Lord) of glory.* (1 Enoch 40:3). The praise the capstone commands below is already sounding above — the four presences before the throne uttering the praise *every thing that hath breath* is now gathered into.

cards.old_note: *But the middle one reached to heaven, like the throne of Yahuah (God), of stibium, and the top of the throne was of sapphire* (1 Enoch 14:15). Enoch is carried up and sees the throne of the Most High, a vision twin to Daniel's — *his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire* (Daniel 7:9). The same heavenly throne-room of the Ancient of Days, seen by Enoch before Daniel.
cards.new_note: *And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.* (1 Enoch 14:18). Enoch is carried up and sees the throne of the Most High, a vision twin to Daniel's — *his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire* (Daniel 7:9). The same heavenly throne-room of the Ancient of Days, seen by Enoch before Daniel.

cards.old_note: *That I have seen, and the light has shone upon me, And I have seen the holy ones of heaven, And I have beheld the books of life* (1 Enoch 104:2). The seer beholds the books of life and the light that shines on the righteous — the very glory of *they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament... as the stars for ever and ever* (Daniel 12:3). The wise whose names are in the books of life shine with the light of heaven.
cards.new_note: *Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.* (1 Enoch 104:2). *They that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament... as the stars for ever and ever* (Daniel 12:3). Enoch tells the righteous the same: they shall shine as the lights of heaven, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to them.

cards.old_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners* (1 Enoch 62:9). The pierced One *they shall look upon* (Zechariah 12:10) is the Son of Adam the restored witness sees revealed in the day — *this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen* — before whom the kings and the mighty are abased. The day of looking upon the pierced One is the day of the Son of Adam's appearing.
cards.new_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). The pierced One *they shall look upon* (Zechariah 12:10) is the Son of Adam the restored witness sees revealed in the day — *this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen* — before whom the kings and the mighty are abased. The day of looking upon the pierced One is the day of the Son of Adam's appearing.

cards.old_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His set-apart ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). This is the very line Jude quotes, and it answers *Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) shall come, and all the saints with thee* (14:5). The set-apart ones who come with him are the seed of promise, gathered out of all nations and coming with him into the land while the ungodly are judged — not angels, and not souls come down from heaven.
cards.new_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). This is the very line Jude quotes, and it answers *Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) shall come, and all the saints with thee* (14:5). The holy ones who come with him are the seed of promise, gathered out of all nations and coming with him into the land while the ungodly are judged — not angels, and not souls come down from heaven.

cards.old_note: *As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling* (1 Enoch 15:8). The library tells where these unclean spirits came from — the spirits of the giants, earth-bound, given over to the earth.
cards.new_note: *[As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]* (1 Enoch 15:10). The library tells where these unclean spirits came from — the spirits of the giants, earth-bound, given over to the earth.

cards.old_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble* (1 Enoch 15:9). The very work of the demons in the tombs — afflicting, destroying — and they know their judgement is coming.
cards.new_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The very work of the demons in the tombs — afflicting, destroying — and they know their judgement is coming.

cards.old_note: *from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement* (1 Enoch 15:11). This is why they cry *art thou come hither to torment us before the time?* — they know the appointed day of the great judgement, and they tremble that He is here.
cards.new_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). This is why they cry *art thou come hither to torment us before the time?* — they know the appointed day of the great judgement, and they tremble that He is here.

cards.old_note: *Wait ye in patience until sin has passed away, For their names shall be blotted out of the book of life, And out of the books of the holy ones* (1 Enoch 108:3). Malachi's spared jewels — *I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him* (Malachi 3:17) — stand against those whose *names shall be blotted out of the book of life*. The book of remembrance keeps the faithful; the wicked are blotted out.
cards.new_note: *And wait ye indeed till sin has passed away, for their names shall be blotted out of the book of life and out of the holy books, and their seed shall be destroyed for ever, and their spirits shall be slain, and they shall cry and make lamentation in a place that is a chaotic wilderness, and in the fire shall they burn; for there is no earth there.* (1 Enoch 108:3). Malachi's spared jewels — *I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him* (Malachi 3:17) — stand against those whose *names shall be blotted out of the book of life*. The book of remembrance keeps the faithful; the wicked are blotted out.

cards.old_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy... until the day of the consummation, the great judgement* (1 Enoch 15:11). The library tells where the unclean spirits came from — the souls of the dead giants, the offspring of the Watchers. These are the very devils the Son binds and casts out.
cards.new_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). The library tells where the unclean spirits came from — the souls of the dead giants, the offspring of the Watchers. These are the very devils the Son binds and casts out.

cards.old_note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not* (1 Enoch 62:7). The library's own vision of the Son of Adam seated to judge — born unto righteousness, the Head of Days behind him, rewarding every man.
cards.new_note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). The library's own vision of the Son of Adam seated to judge — born unto righteousness, the Head of Days behind him, rewarding every man.

cards.old_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:9). The *unclean spirits* the twelve are given power over are named here — the spirits gone out from the slain giants, the offspring of the Watchers. The library tells you what they are; the Son gives His sent ones authority over them.
cards.new_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The *unclean spirits* the twelve are given power over are named here — the spirits gone out from the slain giants, the offspring of the Watchers. The library tells you what they are; the Son gives His sent ones authority over them.

They destroy *until the day of the consummation* — but the Son, before that day, already hands their conquest to twelve men with nothing but a staff.
cards.new_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). They destroy *until the day of the consummation* — but the Son, before that day, already hands their conquest to twelve men with nothing but a staff.

cards.old_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble.* (1 Enoch 15:9). The library names the foul spirits the Son rebukes — the unclean spirits that *afflict* are the souls gone forth from the slain giants, born of the Watchers' rebellion.
cards.new_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The library names the foul spirits the Son rebukes — the unclean spirits that *afflict* are the souls gone forth from the slain giants, born of the Watchers' rebellion.

cards.old_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement.* (1 Enoch 15:11). These spirits *destroy until the day of the consummation* — but the Formed Son, with a word, charges this one to *come out of him, and enter no more*: a foretaste of the consummating judgement.
cards.new_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). These spirits *destroy until the day of the consummation* — but the Formed Son, with a word, charges this one to *come out of him, and enter no more*: a foretaste of the consummating judgement.

cards.old_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble...* (1 Enoch 15:9). The library names what the *spirit* that *teareth* the child is — the afflicting spirits proceeding from the giants, the Watcher-rebellion's aftermath.
cards.new_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The library names what the *spirit* that *teareth* the child is — the afflicting spirits proceeding from the giants, the Watcher-rebellion's aftermath.

cards.old_note: *...thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless...* (1 Enoch 15:11). These spirits destroy until the judgment; the Son rebukes one here as a foretaste of the consummation that ends them.
cards.new_note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). These spirits destroy until the judgment; the Son rebukes one here as a foretaste of the consummation that ends them.

cards.old_note: *And thus Yahuah (God) of Spirits named the Elect One, And seated him on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, And weigh their deeds in the balance.* (1 Enoch 62:1). The Elect One enthroned to judge is the same Son of Adam who shares his judgment-seat with the twelve over the tribes.
cards.new_note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Luke 22:30). The Elect One placed on the throne of glory to judge is the Son of Adam who shares that seat with the twelve.

cards.old_note: *And that Angel of Peace who went with me said to me: 'These are the secrets which thou hast seen.'* (1 Enoch 62:5). In the same vision the Elect One is *seated... on the throne of His glory* — the Son of Adam enthroned to judge, the hidden secret now confessed before the council.
cards.new_note: *And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.* (1 Enoch 62:5). *Hereafter shall the Son of Adam sit on the right hand of the power of Elohim (God)* (Luke 22:69). Enoch saw the faces of those who see that Son of Adam sitting on the throne of his glory — terror and pain. The council heard the claim; the vision shows them seeing it kept.

cards.old_note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits seated the Elect One on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge all the secret things... For he is the Chosen One before Yahuah (God) of Spirits... And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness... the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.* (1 Enoch 62:6-7). The Father seats the Son of Adam on the throne to judge — the Son enthroned BY the Head of Days, the same architecture as John 5:27: judgment given *because he is the Son of Adam.*
cards.new_note: *And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.* (1 Enoch 69:27). *And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam* (John 5:27). Enoch saw the sum of judgement given to the Son of Adam on the throne of his glory. The authority is given — by the Father — and it is given to the Son of Adam by that name.

cards.old_note: *And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens* (1 Enoch 1:4). This is Micah's *tread upon the high places of the earth* (1:3) word for deed — *the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth*. The descending One who treads is the same in the prophet and the witness; he appears in the strength of his might.
cards.new_note: *And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.* (1 Enoch 1:4). This is Micah's *tread upon the high places of the earth* (1:3) word for deed — *the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth*. The descending One who treads is the same in the prophet and the witness; he appears in the strength of his might.

cards.old_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble* (1 Enoch 15:9). The afflicting spirit that seized the man is exactly what Enoch described — and it knows its Judge. When the Holy One of Elohim commands, the bound offspring of the Watchers must obey; the sentence already gone forth against them stands.
cards.new_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The afflicting spirit that seized the man is exactly what Enoch described — and it knows its Judge. When the Holy One of Elohim commands, the bound offspring of the Watchers must obey; the sentence already gone forth against them stands.

cards.old_note: *As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling* (1 Enoch 15:8). Enoch names the origin of the unclean spirits: they are the disembodied spirits of the giants, the offspring of the fallen Watchers, loosed upon the earth. This is the *unclean devil* the Son confronts.
cards.new_note: *[As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]* (1 Enoch 15:10). Enoch names the origin of the unclean spirits: they are the disembodied spirits of the giants, the offspring of the fallen Watchers, loosed upon the earth. This is the *unclean devil* the Son confronts.

cards.old_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble* (1 Enoch 15:9). The library names the unclean spirits Yahusha casts out — the disembodied spirits of the fallen Watchers' giant offspring, the very strong man's armoury now overcome.
cards.new_note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The library names the unclean spirits Yahusha casts out — the disembodied spirits of the fallen Watchers' giant offspring, the very strong man's armoury now overcome.

cards.old_note: *Woe to you who devour the might of others, And live in wickedness and oppression... And tread upon the righteous with your might.* (1 Enoch 96:1). Enoch's woe names Job's strong man — *He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life* (Job 24:22). The same trampling power that makes men despair of their lives is the very thing heaven marks for woe.
cards.new_note: *Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink wine in large bowls, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.* (1 Enoch 96:5). Enoch's woe names Job's strong man — *He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life* (Job 24:22). The same trampling power that makes men despair of their lives is the very thing heaven marks for woe.

cards.old_note: *Woe to you who are mighty in unrighteousness! For your might shall be cut off.* (1 Enoch 96:2). Job's verdict and Enoch's are one word: the might is *cut off*. *They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low* (Job 24:24). The restored witness underwrites Job's hope — the mighty in unrighteousness do not keep their might.
cards.new_note: *Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.* (1 Enoch 96:8). *They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low* (Job 24:24). Enoch's woe to the mighty who oppress the righteous says the same: the day of their destruction is coming. The might does not keep.

cards.old_note: *I saw the treasuries of all the winds: I saw how He has ordered all creation by His wisdom, and how He has founded the world upon them. And I saw the cornerstone of the earth* (1 Enoch 18:1-2). Enoch is shown the very *corner stone* of Job 38:6 — the world founded by Wisdom, the pillars on which the earth is set.
cards.new_note: *I saw the treasuries of all the winds: I saw how He had furnished with them the whole creation and the firm foundations of the earth.* (1 Enoch 18:1). Enoch is shown the very *corner stone* of Job 38:6 — the world founded by Wisdom, the pillars on which the earth is set.

cards.old_note: *And through that oath the sea was created, and as its foundation He set for it the sand against the time of its anger, and it dare not pass beyond it from the creation of the world unto eternity* (1 Enoch 69:22). The sea *shut up... with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb* (Job 38:8) is bound by the same creating oath — the sand its appointed limit, which it dare not overpass.
cards.new_note: *And through it the earth was founded upon the water, And from the secret recesses of the mountains come beautiful waters, From the creation of the world and unto eternity.* (1 Enoch 69:17). The sea *shut up... with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb* (Job 38:8) is bound by the same creating oath — the sand its appointed limit, which it dare not overpass.

cards.old_note: *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times* (1 Enoch 18:13). The *ordinances of heaven* (Job 38:33) are commandment: even the stars are judged by whether they come forth at their *appointed times* — the fixed order no man can set, which Yahuah alone governs.
cards.new_note: *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.* (1 Enoch 18:15). The *ordinances of heaven* (Job 38:33) are commandment: even the stars are judged by whether they come forth at their *appointed times* — the fixed order no man can set, which Yahuah alone governs.

cards.old_note: The restored witness names the same abyss-monster the LORD reserves: *And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster whose name is Leviathan, dwelling in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters* (1 Enoch 60:7). Job's *Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook?* (Job 41:1) asks of a creature of the deep that man cannot reach — held in the abyss under Yahuah's (God's) hand alone.
cards.new_note: *And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster named Leviathan, to dwell in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters.* (1 Enoch 60:7). The restored witness names the same abyss-monster the LORD reserves:  (1 Enoch 60:7). Job's *Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook?* (Job 41:1) asks of a creature of the deep that man cannot reach — held in the abyss under Yahuah's (God's) hand alone.

cards.old_note: *But the middle one reached to heaven, like the throne of Yahuah (God), of stibium, and the top of the throne was of sapphire* (1 Enoch 14:15). Enoch is carried up and shown the throne of Yahuah reaching to heaven — the same enthroned Most High Micaiah beheld, *Yahuah (LORD) sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him* (1 Kings 22:19). The restored witness joins the prophets: Yahuah is enthroned in the heights, the heavenly council standing before the sapphire throne.
cards.new_note: *And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.* (1 Enoch 14:18). *I saw Yahuah (the LORD) sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him* (1 Kings 22:19). Enoch saw the same throne — lofty, crystal, cherubim about it, ten thousand times ten thousand before him (1 Enoch 14:22). The restored witness joins the prophets: Yahuah (Lord) is enthroned in the heights, the host attending.

cards.old_note: *And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood and clay, And those who worship impure spirits and demons, And all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them* (1 Enoch 99:7). Enoch puts idol-worship and demon-worship in one breath, just as the Song does — *to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up* (Deuteronomy 32:17) — *whom your fathers feared not*.
cards.new_note: *And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood and stone and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.* (1 Enoch 99:7). Enoch puts idol-worship and demon-worship in one breath, just as the Song does — *to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up* (Deuteronomy 32:17) — *whom your fathers feared not*.

cards.old_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His set-apart ones To execute judgement upon all...* (1 Enoch 1:9) The *ten thousands of saints* with whom Yahuah came (Deuteronomy 33:2) are Enoch's *ten thousands of His set-apart ones* — the same accompanying host, the verse Jude later quotes by name; the Formed One comes attended by the holy ones.
cards.new_note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). *He came with ten thousands of saints* (Deuteronomy 33:2). Enoch's ten thousands of holy ones are the same accompanying host — the verse Jude later quotes by name. The Formed One comes attended by the holy ones.

members.old: The enthronement of the Elect One — Yahuah of Spirits named him and seated him. The Messianic-enthronement the apostolic witness will articulate at the resurrection (Acts 13:33, Phil 2:9-11) is named here before the world began.
members.new: The enthronement of the Elect One — Yahuah of Spirits named him and seated him. The Messianic-enthronement the apostolic witness will articulate at the resurrection (Acts 13:33, Phil 2:9-11) is named here before the world began.

members.new: 1 Enoch 40:5 — *the voice of the Holy One ... in the heaven, and the voice of the Elect One ... from the throne of glory.* The doubled Father / Son voice the Hebrew library promises; Matt 3:17 enacts the Father side publicly.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:7 — the direct Father-voice naming the Son of Adam: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* The construction Matt 3:17 enacts at the Yarden (Jordan).
members.new: 1 Enoch 71:14 — the direct Father-voice naming the Son of Adam: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* The construction Matt 3:17 enacts at the Yarden (Jordan).

members.old: 1 Enoch 5:7 — *to the righteous and holy He will grant peace, and He will protect the elect, and compassion shall be upon them.* The Hebrew library's righteous-elect blessing register; the Beatitudes inherit the architecture.
members.new: *But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.* (1 Enoch 1:8). *Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 5:3). The blessing is not an entry fee; it is the Father's own word over those who are already his. Enoch heard the same word before the Beatitudes were spoken: peace, protection, mercy, belonging — pronounced over the elect, not offered to applicants.

members.old: 1 Enoch 58:3 — *the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life.* The Hebrew library's direct light-of-the-elect architecture; Matt 5:14's indicative *ye ARE the light* walks the same.
members.new: *And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy without number.* (1 Enoch 58:3). *Ye are the light of the world* (Matthew 5:14) — not *become*; *are.* Enoch says why: the righteous are set in the light of the sun and the elect in the light of eternal life. The light the disciples carry is the light they were placed in.

members.old: 1 Enoch 38:4 — *those that possess the earth shall no longer be strong and exalted ... for Yahuah (God) of Spirits has appeared upon the throne of His glory.* The throne-of-glory appearing; Matt 5:14's *city set on an hill* foreshadows the consummation-city.
members.new: 1 Enoch 38:4 — *those that possess the earth shall no longer be strong and exalted ... for Yahuah (God) of Spirits has appeared upon the throne of His glory.* The throne-of-glory appearing; Matt 5:14's *city set on an hill* foreshadows the consummation-city.

members.old: 1 Enoch 38:2 — *the righteous shall be victorious in the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* The name-glorifying architecture; Matt 5:16's *that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven* walks the same.
members.new: *And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.* (1 Enoch 38:2). *Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 5:16). Enoch saw the day the light appears on the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth — and the question that day asks of the sinners. The shining is the Father's doing; the glory goes to him.

members.old: 1 Enoch 82:13 — *woe to those who alter these things, And lead the sons of men astray, And cause them to transgress the commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* The dual-clause architecture — alter + cause-to-transgress — that Matt 5:19's *break* + *teach men so* walks directly.
members.new: *Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.* (1 Enoch 104:9). Enoch's charge to his children is the charge Matthew 5:19 makes to every teacher: do not alter the words of uprightness. *Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven.* To alter the words and to teach men so are one act; both are named here before the gospel names them.

members.old: 1 Enoch 95:2 — *Woe to you who alter the words of uprightness, And who write the words of unrighteousness and lying: They write their own judgment.* The sharpest woe-form of the diagnostic; the pulpit teaching the breaking of the commandments writes its own kingdom-status.
members.new: *And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.* (1 Enoch 104:10). Enoch knew the mystery before the pulpit practised it: sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness, and write books about it. *Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so* (Matthew 5:19) — the teaching is the perverting; the books are the sermons. The kingdom-status of such teachers was fixed long before the sermon was preached.

members.old: 1 Enoch 9:4 — *Yahuah (Lord) of lords, Elohim (God) of elohiym, King of kings ... the throne of Thy glory standeth unto all the generations of the world, and Thy Name is holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages.* The Hebrew library's angelic prayer-form; Matt 6:9's *hallowed be thy name* and 6:10's *thy kingdom come* walk the same prayer-architecture.
members.new: *And they said to Yahuah (Lord) of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim (God) of gods, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!* (1 Enoch 9:4). Enoch's angels pray what the disciples are taught to pray: the holy and blessed name, the throne of glory that stands to all generations, the King of kings. *Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come* (Matthew 6:9–10) is the same prayer in the mouth of the children.

members.old: 1 Enoch 84:2 — *Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (God), King ... And Thy throne is for ever and ever, And Thy name is holy and great for ever and ever.* Enoch's own prayer at the same architecture; Matt 6:9's *hallowed be thy name* walks the same holy-Name + eternal-throne register.
members.new: *‘Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (Lord), King, Great and mighty in Thy greatness, Yahuah (Lord) of the whole creation of the heaven, King of kings and Elohim (God) of the whole world. And Thy power and kingship and greatness abide for ever and ever, And throughout all generations Thy dominion; And all the heavens are Thy throne for ever, And the whole earth Thy footstool for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 84:2). *Hallowed be thy name* (Matthew 6:9). Enoch's own prayer blesses the King whose dominion is through all generations and whose throne is the heavens. The disciples are taught to pray what the patriarch prayed.

members.old: 1 Enoch 84:3 — *Thou hast made all things, And Thou hast power over all things ... And nothing can hide itself from Thee.* The kingdom-and-power register; Matt 6:10's *thy kingdom come, thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven* walks the same architecture.
members.new: *Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.* (1 Enoch 9:5). The One whose kingdom the disciples pray to come is the One who made all things and holds power over all things, from whom nothing hides. *Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven* (Matthew 6:10) asks nothing new; it asks that what is already true in heaven be seen on earth.

members.old: 1 Enoch 94:1 — *paths of righteousness ... paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed.* The Two-Ways teaching in the patriarch's wisdom-testimony; Matt 7:13's wide gate to destruction walks the same.
members.new: 1 Enoch 94:1 — *paths of righteousness ... paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed.* The Two-Ways teaching in the patriarch's wisdom-testimony; Matt 7:13's wide gate to destruction walks the same.

members.old: 1 Enoch 94:2 — *certain men of a generation ... shall not find mercy.* The Hebrew library's asymmetric few-walk-aright architecture; Matt 7:14's *few there be that find it* walks the same.
members.new: 1 Enoch 94:2 — *certain men of a generation ... shall not find mercy.* The Hebrew library's asymmetric few-walk-aright architecture; Matt 7:14's *few there be that find it* walks the same.

members.old: 1 Enoch 90:18 — *all the beasts and the birds and the wild animals were gathered, and they all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to praise Him.* The Animal Apocalypse's gathering-at-the-end vision; Matt 8:11 walks the King's inauguration of the gathering Enoch saw.
members.new: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *Many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Avraham (Abraham), and Yitschaq (Isaac), and Ya'aqov (Jacob), in the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 8:11). Enoch saw the sitting-down: all that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in the house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoicing because they had returned. The many from east and west are the dispersed of the house coming home — the scattered sheep, not a new flock.

members.old: 1 Enoch 46:2 — *concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was.* The figure named directly. Title-naming, NOT kaph-comparative (distinct from Dan 7:13 / Rev 1:13 / Rev 14:14); Matt 8:20's *the Son of Adam* walks the same named-title architecture. Red Line #12.
members.new: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). Enoch asks who *that Son of Adam* is — a figure named by title, standing beside the Head of Days. When Yahusha (Jesus) says *the Son of Adam hath not where to lay his head* (Matthew 8:20) he takes that title for himself: the named one of the Parables, now with no bed on the earth he came to.

members.old: 1 Enoch 15:9 — *the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth.* The spirits-from-the-giants demon-origin architecture; Matt 8:28's demoniacs walk the same.
members.new: 1 Enoch 15:11 — *the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth.* The spirits-from-the-giants demon-origin architecture; Matt 8:28's demoniacs walk the same.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:7 — *this is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him.* The Son of Adam's righteousness-abides-eternally architecture; Matt 9:6's authority to forgive sins is the present-tense exercise of the righteousness that abides over him.
members.new: 1 Enoch 71:14 — *this is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him.* The Son of Adam's righteousness-abides-eternally architecture; Matt 9:6's authority to forgive sins is the present-tense exercise of the righteousness that abides over him.

members.old: 1 Enoch 90:16 — *the shepherds who had not fed the sheep were judged, and cast into the same fiery abyss with the beasts.* The Animal Apocalypse's shepherds-judged architecture; Matt 9:36's scattered-shepherdless multitudes have the same diagnostic operative at the King's arrival.
members.new: *And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). The shepherds who were set over the sheep and destroyed more than they were bidden end here, judged and cast into the fiery abyss. When Yahusha (Jesus) saw the multitudes *as sheep having no shepherd* (Matthew 9:36), he was looking at the flock those shepherds had left; the vision had already recorded their sentence.

members.old: 1 Enoch 90:17 — *a new house was built greater and loftier than the first, and the Lord of the sheep brought all the sheep into that new house.* The restoration-architecture immediately following the shepherds-judgment; the new-house-substance Yahusha (Jesus) is inaugurating at Matt 9:36.
members.new: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.* (1 Enoch 90:29). The shepherdless sheep of Matthew 9:36 are not left shepherdless. Enoch saw the Lord of the sheep bring a new house, greater and loftier than the first, with all the sheep within it. The compassion that moved him at the sight of the scattered flock is the compassion that builds the house.

members.old: 1 Enoch 90:18 — *all the beasts and the birds and the wild animals were gathered, and they all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to praise Him.* The full-gathering-and-fear-of-the-Lord-of-the-sheep at the end of the restoration-arc; Matt 9:36's present-tense seeing of the scattered multitudes is the Shepherd's arrival at the moment the gathering begins to be enacted in flesh.
members.new: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *When he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad* (Matthew 9:36). Enoch saw where the scattering ends: all that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in the house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoicing because they had returned.

members.old: 1 Enoch 103:3 — *your spirits have been found worthy of the lot of the righteous, And your names are written in the books of life before the Most High.* The wisdom-stream's books-of-life witness; the Red Line #11 names-written-before-the-foundation architecture anchor.
members.new: *I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.* (1 Enoch 104:1). *Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 10:32). Enoch swears to the righteous that their names are already written before the glory of the Great One. The Son confesses before the Father the ones whose names were written before they ever confessed.

members.old: 1 Enoch 103:8 — *their memorial shall be before the Most High, And their name shall not be blotted out.* The wisdom-stream's preservation-of-the-name witness; Matt 10:33's denial-warning names the inverse — the denier risks the blotting-out the Matt 7:23 dismissal-pattern enacts.
members.new: *And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.* (1 Enoch 103:4). *But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 10:33). Enoch's word to the righteous who die in righteousness is that their memorial does not perish before the Great One. The warning of Matthew 10:33 is the other side of that promise: a memorial can be kept, and a name can be blotted out (1 Enoch 108:3). The denier is not a tare who never had a name; he is wheat that did not endure.

members.old: 1 Enoch 5:7 — *to the righteous and holy He will grant peace, and He will protect the elect ... they shall be prospered ... the light of Elohim (God) shall shine unto them.* The wisdom-stream's direct elect-blessing Messianic-age substance; the inaugurated-foretaste lands at Matt 11:5's credentialing-signs.
members.new: *But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.* (1 Enoch 1:8). The answer sent to Yochanan (John) — *the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them* (Matthew 11:5) — is the peace, protection, mercy, and light Enoch saw promised to the righteous, now arriving in flesh.

members.old: 1 Enoch 10:17 — *all the righteous escape, and shall live until they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.* The wisdom-stream's latter-day-restoration architecture; the credentialing-signs at Matt 11:5 are the inaugurated-foretaste.
members.new: *And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.* (1 Enoch 10:17). Enoch saw the days when the righteous escape and complete their years in peace, the earth tilled in righteousness and cleansed of oppression (1 Enoch 10:17–22). The works Yahusha (Jesus) lists for Yochanan (John) at Matthew 11:5 are the first fruits of those days — the age Enoch saw, beginning.

members.old: 1 Enoch 95:7 — *woe to you, sinners, who persecute the righteous.* The wisdom-stream's direct woe-against-the-persecutors architecture; the Pharisaic-system's plot-to-destroy is the action that triggers the woe.
members.new: *Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.* (1 Enoch 95:7). *Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him* (Matthew 12:14). Enoch's woe already names them: sinners who persecute the righteous, and the heavy yoke that waits for them. The council against the Righteous One is the act the woe was written for.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:2 — *the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners.* The wisdom-stream's Elect-One-enthroned with the word-of-his-mouth as judgment-instrument; Matt 12:20c's *till he send forth judgment unto victory* names the same eschatological-architecture.
members.new: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). *Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles* (Matthew 12:18). Enoch saw the same: the spirit of righteousness poured out on the Elect One seated on the throne, and the word of his mouth bringing judgment. The servant of Isaiah and the Elect One of the Parables are one figure, and the Spirit upon him is the same Spirit.

members.old: 1 Enoch 65:11 — *they have witnessed those that have been guilty of the offence of their sin, and they have rejected its sentence ... there is no place of repentance for them.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the no-place-of-repentance architecture.
members.new: *And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.* (1 Enoch 65:11). *But the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Ghost) shall not be forgiven unto men* (Matthew 12:32). Enoch heard the sentence on those who showed what was hidden and became the damned: no place of repentance for ever. There is a sin that closes the door from the inside; the Pharisees who called the Spirit's work the work of Beelzebub stood at that door.

members.old: 1 Enoch 48:7 — *and the wisdom of the Lord of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wisdom-revealed-to-the-holy-and-righteous architecture; Matt 13:11's *it is given unto you* (Greek *dedotai*) names the same election-precedes-hearing substance per Red Line #11.
members.new: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). *Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given* (Matthew 13:11). Enoch says who the *you* are: the holy and righteous to whom the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits reveals him, who have hated this world of unrighteousness. The revealing follows the belonging; it does not create it.

members.old: 1 Enoch 19:1 — *the spirits of the watchers ... assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the spirits-of-the-watchers leading-mankind-astray; the wicked-one snatches the seed by leading-the-hearer-astray per Matt 13:19's operative-form.
members.new: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). *Then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart* (Matthew 13:19). Enoch names the spirits of the Watchers assuming many forms, leading mankind astray — the actor behind the catching-away. He is not a figure of speech; the restored library records his origin and his end.

members.old: 1 Enoch 10:9 — *proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy the children of the Watchers from amongst men.* The wisdom-stream names the children-of-the-watchers as a paternal-source-distinguishable-people; the King at Matt 13:38 names the operative-architecture of the children-of-the-wicked-one.
