members.new: *And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.* (1 Enoch 10:9). *The tares are the children of the wicked one* (Matthew 13:38). Enoch names them before the parable does: the children of the Watchers, a seed with a father of its own, distinguished from the line of Adam and marked for destruction. The tares are not bad wheat; they are another seed.

members.old: 1 Enoch 10:13 — *in those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the watchers' eschatological-judgment at the day of judgment; the King at Matt 13:42 names the operative-form of the casting-into-the-furnace-of-fire architecture.
members.new: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth* (Matthew 13:42). Enoch saw the abyss of fire and the prison appointed for the Watchers — the furnace the parable names, already mapped.

members.old: 1 Enoch 54:6 — *Mikha'el (Michael), and Gavri'el (Gabriel), and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for Matt 13:42's furnace-of-fire substance; the angels-as-reapers + burning-furnace + day-of-judgment all align across the wisdom-stream and the gospel.
members.new: *And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’* (1 Enoch 54:6). *The reapers are the angels* (Matthew 13:39), and here they are by name: Michael, Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, casting the hosts of Azazel into the burning furnace on the great day. The furnace of Matthew 13:42 has its angels, its day, and its reason — vengeance for leading astray those who dwell on the earth.

members.old: 1 Enoch 46:3 — *this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... and who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden.* The wisdom-stream identifies the Son-of-Adam as the Revealer-of-the-hidden-treasures; the King at Matt 13:34-35 fulfills the office at the parables-method register.
members.new: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *All these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables* (Matthew 13:34). Enoch had named the Son of Adam as the one who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden. The parables are that revealing — hidden things opened, by the one chosen to open them.

members.old: 1 Enoch 22:7 — the spirit-of-Hevel (Abel) crying-out-against-Qayin (Cain) as the seed-war's first-victim-crying-for-vindication. The wisdom-stream names the architecture-of-the-seed-war-from-Bereshit-4 with the first-righteous-victim crying for vindication; the King's wheat-and-tares architecture extends through the field-of-the-world.
members.new: *And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’* (1 Enoch 22:7). *The good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one* (Matthew 13:38). The seed war is older than the parable. Enoch is shown the spirit of Hevel (Abel), the first righteous blood, making its suit against the seed of Qayin (Cain) until that seed is gone from among the seed of men. Two seeds, from Genesis 4 to the harvest.

members.old: 1 Enoch 46:2 — *concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, and why he went with the Head of Days.* THE wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Son-of-Adam title the King uses of himself at Matt 16:13; the Parables-of-Enoch had carried the Son-of-Adam title as a heavenly-figure-named-beside-the-Head-of-Days centuries before the King's-incarnation.
members.new: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). *Whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?* (Matthew 16:13). The question uses the title Enoch asked about — *that Son of Adam,* the one who went with the Head of Days. The King asks whether men have recognized the figure the Parables named.

members.old: 1 Enoch 46:3 — *this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the Son-of-Adam's identity at the depth Kefa's (Peter's)-confession at Matt 16:16 articulates at the gospel-pivot — the Chosen-One in-whom-righteousness-dwells.
members.new: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *Thou art the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God)* (Matthew 16:16). Kefa (Peter) confesses what Enoch was told: the Son of Adam who has righteousness, whom Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has chosen, whose lot has the pre-eminence for ever. The confession at Caesarea Philippi is the angel's answer at 1 Enoch 46:3, spoken on earth.

members.old: 1 Enoch 49:2 — *he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness ... because the Elect One stands before Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the Elect-One-as-the-Standing-One-before-Yahuah-of-Spirits to whom the secrets-of-righteousness are committed; the King-as-the-Elect-One holds the secrets-of-righteousness; the King delegates the keys-of-the-kingdom-of-heaven to the apostolic-stewardship at Matt 16:19 from the master-position the wisdom-stream had named.
members.new: *For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.* (1 Enoch 49:2). *I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 16:19). The secrets of righteousness belong to the Elect One who stands before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits; the keys Kefa (Peter) receives are stewardship of what is his. The one who holds the secrets delegates their opening.

members.old: 1 Enoch 51:3 — *the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, and his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: for Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits hath given them to him and hath glorified him.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Elect-One-on-the-throne substance. The keys-of-the-house-of-David belong to the Elect-One; the keys-of-the-kingdom-of-heaven the King delegates at Matt 16:19 operate from the throne-position the wisdom-stream had named.
members.new: *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3). *I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 16:19). Enoch saw the Elect One seated on the Father's throne, his mouth pouring out the secrets of wisdom and counsel. The keys are given by the one who sits on that throne; the house of David's key (Isaiah 22:22) is on his shoulder before it is in Kefa's (Peter's) hand.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:7 — *the righteousness of the Elect One of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and elect.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the Son-of-Adam revealed-to-the-holy-and-elect substance — Kefa (Peter) at Matt 16:17 is one of the holy-and-elect to whom the Father reveals the substance; the revelation precedes the King's-delegation of the keys to the apostolic-stewardship at v.19.
members.new: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *Flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 16:17). The Father's naming of the Son of Adam at 1 Enoch 71:14 is the same revealing — the Head of Days declaring who he is. Kefa (Peter) receives on earth what Enoch heard in heaven, and the keys follow the revealing.

members.old: 1 Enoch 69:27 — *he sat on the throne of his glory, and the sum of judgment was given unto the Son of Adam.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the sum-of-judgment-given-unto-the-Son-of-Adam substance. The apostolic-stewardship's binding-and-loosing at Matt 16:19 operates downstream-of-and-in-accountability-to the Son-of-Adam's-own-sum-of-judgment; the apostolic-keys administer what-the-Master-of-the-House-has-given.
members.new: *And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.* (1 Enoch 69:27). *Whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven* (Matthew 16:19). The sum of judgement was given to the Son of Adam on the throne of his glory; what the apostles bind and loose is bound and loosed under that judgement, not beside it.

members.old: 1 Enoch 8:1 — *Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates ... and the metals of the earth and the art of working them ... and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* THE architectural-root of the *skandalon* (stumbling-block) substance the King's millstone-warning at Matt 18:6 lands-on — the wisdom-stream's articulation of the substance behind the seed-war: the watchers taught-the-children-of-men the substance that placed-the-stumbling-blocks across the way of the walker.
members.new: *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* (1 Enoch 8:1). *Whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck* (Matthew 18:6). The stumbling-blocks laid across the way of the little ones have a history: Azazel taught men the arts that became the snares. The millstone is the King's answer to the teacher of the snare.

members.old: 1 Enoch 22:11 — *These places have been made for them until the day of their judgement and until their consummation, till the consummation of their judgement is consummated for ever and ever upon the sinners.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the place-of-the-eternal-judgment substance — the architecture-of-judgment the King names at Matt 18:6 is *better* than the substance the millstone-and-the-sea would produce. The *consummation of their judgement* substance is destruction, NOT the inherited-Christian-eternal-conscious-torment doctrine read-back into the term.
members.new: *Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.* (1 Enoch 22:11). *It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea* (Matthew 18:6). Better than what? Than the place Enoch was shown — spirits set apart in great pain until the great day of judgement, and bound there. The sea is the lesser end.

members.old: 1 Enoch 40:9 — *This first is Michael, the merciful and long-suffering: and the second, who is set over all sickness and all wounds, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is Phanuel.* The four-presences-before-the-Father with direct-throne-access — the architectural-substance Matt 18:10's *in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father* names; the disciples' disposition-toward-the-little-ones is bounded by the architecture of the messengers' continuous-throne-access on the little-ones' behalf.
members.new: *And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’* (1 Enoch 40:9). *In heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 18:10). Enoch is given the names of the four who stand before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits — mercy, healing, power, and repentance unto hope. The little ones are watched over from the throne itself.

members.old: 1 Enoch 89:42 — *The Lord of the sheep took the staff of His wrath, and cast it upon the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth, and it covered them.* The wisdom-stream's Animal-Apocalypse articulation of the Lord-of-the-sheep's-acting-substance against the beasts-and-birds-that-devour — the carrying-forward of Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34's shepherd-substance into apocalyptic-vision-form; the same Lord-of-the-sheep at Matt 18:11 walks-in-flesh to *save that which was lost.*
members.new: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.* (1 Enoch 90:18). *For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost* (Matthew 18:11). The Lord of the sheep comes to the flock in person, staff in hand, and the beasts and birds that devoured them are swallowed by the earth. The saving of the lost is the Lord of the sheep arriving.

members.old: 1 Enoch 89:54 — *Enoch blessed the Lord of the sheep and said: "Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (God), Yahuah (the Lord) of the sheep."* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Lord-of-the-sheep-title substance — the wisdom-stream identifies the Lord-of-the-sheep with Yahuah by name; the same shepherd whose-*if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine* at Matt 18:12 names the personal-substance of the King-in-flesh.
members.new: *And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.* (1 Enoch 89:54). *If a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?* (Matthew 18:12). Enoch's vision names the owner of the flock: Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, whose house and tower the sheep forsook. The shepherd of the parable is not a hired man; he is the Lord of the sheep seeking his own.

members.old: 1 Enoch 90:18 — *I saw till all the beasts and the birds and the wild animals were gathered, and they all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to fall down upon his face and to worship him.* The consummation-rejoicing the Lord-of-the-sheep walks-toward — the wisdom-stream's articulation of the gathering-substance the King's Matt 18:13 *he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray* enacts at the historical-pivot. Both levels of the shepherd-parable (the assembly's-internal-little-ones AND the canon-wide lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) mission-scope per Red Line #7) derive from the same Lord-of-the-sheep architecture.
members.new: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *He rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray* (Matthew 18:13). Enoch saw that joy at the end: the Lord of the sheep rejoicing with great joy because all that had been dispersed had returned to his house. The parable's one sheep is the vision's whole flock.

members.old: 1 Enoch 94:3 — *woe to you who are rich! For you have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall you depart, Because you have not remembered Yahuah (God) of Spirits in the days of your riches.* THE direct Enochic verbal-anchor for the woe-against-trust-in-riches substance — the architecture the King names at Matt 19:23's *a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven*.
members.new: *Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.* (1 Enoch 94:8). *A rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 19:23). Enoch's woe says why: those who trust in riches depart from them, having not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of their wealth. The difficulty is not the money; it is the trust.

members.old: 1 Enoch 97:7 — *woe to you who acquire gold and silver in unrighteousness And say: "We have become rich with riches and have possessions; And we have acquired everything that we have desired."* The Enochic-substance of the rich-man's-self-congratulation — the architecture the rich-young-ruler-substance carried-out at his departure-sorrowful at Matt 19:22.
members.new: *Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.* (1 Enoch 97:7). *A rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 19:23). The young ruler's confidence — *all these things have I kept from my youth up* — is the sinner's confidence Enoch names: a remembrance that is evil against him, however secure the holdings look.

members.old: 1 Enoch 94:8 — *and now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.* The Enochic-substance of the rich-man's-internal-monologue presuming-on-his-resources — the substance the rich-fool parable at Luke 12:16-21 will-name explicitly; the substance that-cannot-fit-through-the-eye-of-the-needle at Matt 19:24.
members.new: *And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,* (1 Enoch 97:9). *It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God)* (Matthew 19:24). Enoch gives the rich man's own speech — silver gathered, granaries full, *let us do what we purposed.* That speech is the needle's eye closing.

members.old: 1 Enoch 100:6 — *the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their unrighteousness.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the *riches shall not be able to save them* substance — the architecture the King's-statement at Matt 19:26's *with men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible* lands; the Father's-substance softens the heart-the-possessions-hold per Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27's new-heart substance.
members.new: *And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.* (1 Enoch 100:6). *With men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible* (Matthew 19:26). Enoch saw the day the children of the earth understand that riches cannot save them. What riches cannot do, Elohim (God) does — that is the whole of the disciples' hope, and the whole of the rich man's.

members.old: 1 Enoch 39:1 — *the elect and holy children of the earth will behold the secrets of the heaven, and the kingdom of the Elect One shall be revealed to them.* The wisdom-stream articulation of the *eklektoi* (Greek *chosen*) substance the King names at Matt 20:16 — the elect hear because they ARE elect; the hearing reveals what was already true from the foundation of the world per Red Line #11's cause-and-effect-of-hearing.
members.new: *And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.* (1 Enoch 62:8). *So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen* (Matthew 20:16). Enoch saw the chosen gathered: the congregation of the elect and holy sown, and all the elect standing before him on that day. The few are not fewer because they tried harder; they are the elect, and the elect are revealed by their standing.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:9 — *this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and the strong from their thrones, and shall loosen the reins of the strong, and break the teeth of the sinners.* The eschatological-judgment-and-vindication of the Son-of-Adam — the same Son-of-Adam who-walks-the-substantial-ransom at the first-coming at Matt 20:28 will-walk the substantial-judgment at the second-coming; the kingdom-citizens'-substance of greatness-as-service the King names at vv.26-27 is the inverse-substance of the natural-kingdoms'-administration the eschatological-judgment will-overturn.
members.new: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *The Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many* (Matthew 20:28). The same Son of Adam, Enoch saw, raises the kings and the mighty from their seats and breaks the teeth of the sinners. The one who serves is the one who judges; the ransom and the reckoning belong to the same hands.

members.old: 1 Enoch 89:35 — *and the Lord of the sheep was silent, and the beasts and birds devoured the sheep, and the sheep were scattered.* The Animal-Apocalypse's articulation of the consequences-on-the-scattered-flock when the unfruitful-leadership-substance walks — in continuity with Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34's *woe be to the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel)* and Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 23's *woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep* + the King's-own-substance at John 10:11-16's *I am the good shepherd.* The unfruitful-leadership-substance produces-the-scattered-flock; the King-substance comes-to-gather.
members.new: *But He remained unmoved, though He saw it, and rejoiced that they were devoured and swallowed and robbed, and left them to be devoured in the hand of all the beasts.* (1 Enoch 89:58). *Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away* (Matthew 21:19). Enoch saw the Lord of the sheep do the same to a flock that had abandoned him: unmoved, leaving them to be devoured. The withered tree is the leadership that bore no fruit, left to its own harvest.

members.old: 1 Enoch 89:45 — *and the shepherds who had not fed the sheep were judged, and cast into the same fiery abyss with the beasts.* The Animal-Apocalypse's direct verbal-anchor for the leadership-judgment-substance the *he will miserably destroy those wicked men* at Matt 21:41 walks-into — in continuity with Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34 + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 23. The substance is the leadership-substance, NOT the people-of-Yashar'el (Israel) categorically.
members.new: *And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). *He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen* (Matthew 21:41). The husbandmen answer their own parable; Enoch's vision records the sentence they pronounced — the seventy shepherds judged, found guilty, and cast into the fiery abyss.

members.old: 1 Enoch 51:3 — *the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, and his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: for Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath given them to him and hath glorified him.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Elect-One-shall-sit-on-My-throne substance — the same substance Psalm 110:1 walks at *sit thou on my right hand* the King cites at Matt 22:44. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
members.new: *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3). *Yahuah (The LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand* (Matthew 22:44; Psalm 110:1). Enoch heard the same seating spoken by the Father: *the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne.* The Pharisees could not say how David's son is David's Lord; the Parables had already seated him.

members.old: 1 Enoch 61:8 — *the Head of Days placed the Elect One on the throne of His glory; and he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above.* The wisdom-stream articulation of the Head-of-Days-placing-the-Elect-One on-the-throne-of-His-glory — the Father placing-the-Son at-the-Father's-right-hand the same substance Psalm 110:1 walks at Matt 22:44; the substantive-subordination of the Son-to-the-Father at the eternal-Source-and-Expression level the framework's nature-of-God reading carries. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
members.new: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool* (Matthew 22:44). The Head of Days placing the Elect One on the throne of glory is Psalm 110:1 seen from the throne room — the Father seating the Son, the Son judging. The Formless seats the Formed; the One who is seated is Elohim (God) and has a Father.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:7 — *Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: this is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, and righteousness abides over him, and the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.* The wisdom-stream articulation of the Son-of-Adam-born-unto-righteousness substance — the Davidic-lineage AND the righteousness-of-the-Head-of-Days abiding-over-him from-the-foundation-of-the-world; the substance the Pharisaic-substance at Matt 22:45 cannot-resolve. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
members.new: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?* (Matthew 22:45). The Father answers at 1 Enoch 71:14: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* Born — David's son after the flesh; named by the Head of Days — David's Lord. The question the Pharisees could not answer, the Parables had answered.

members.old: 1 Enoch 22:7 — *This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the prison-of-the-angels substance — the framework's reading-context for the *damnation of Gehinnom (Gehenna)* substance the King names at Matt 23:33. NOT the inherited-Christian-Augustinian eternal-conscious-torture doctrine; the substance is the prison-of-the-angels-and-the-post-judgment-divisions per 1 Enoch 22 and the wheat-and-tares-substance of Matt 13:24-30. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the eschatology-architecture per the *Adam, the Sons of Adam, and the Tares* section of framework-deep.md.
members.new: *And he said unto me: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’* (1 Enoch 21:10). *Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of Gehinnom (hell)?* (Matthew 23:33). Enoch was shown the prison of the angels and told it holds them for ever. The judgment the serpents cannot escape is the judgment their fathers, the Watchers, are already held for; the seed goes where the seed came from.

members.old: 1 Enoch 22:14 — *This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the spirit-of-Hevel-(Abel)-makes-suit-against-Qayin (Cain) substance the King names at Matt 23:35 (*the blood of righteous Hevel (Abel)*). The wisdom-stream had-named the architecture of Hevel-(Abel)'s-blood-crying-from-the-ground (Bereshit (Genesis) 4:10) centuries before the gospel-pivot. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
members.new: *And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’* (1 Enoch 22:7). *That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Hevel (Abel)* (Matthew 23:35). Enoch saw the spirit of Hevel (Abel) making its suit against the seed of Qayin (Cain) until that seed is destroyed. The blood that cries from the ground (Genesis 4:10) is still crying in Enoch's vision, and the King hands the sum of it to the generation standing in front of him.

members.old: 1 Enoch 65:11 — *the Most High shall send His punishment upon the sinners and upon the fallen angels, and upon their children.* The substantial-three-category-judgment-architecture (sinners + Watchers + Nephilim corruption-of-the-flesh) the substantial-days-of-Noach (Noah) walked the substantial-flood-substance into — the substantial-pattern the substantial-Matt 24:38 *eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage* substantial-unawareness recapitulates.
members.new: *And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”* (1 Enoch 65:10). *As in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noach (Noah) entered into the ark* (Matthew 24:38). Enoch heard the sentence pronounced over those days: judgement determined, not to be withheld, the earth and its dwellers to be destroyed for the sorceries they had learned. The eating and drinking went on under a sentence already passed.

members.old: 1 Enoch 67:1 — *in those days the punishment of the fallen angels shall be consummated, and they shall be led off to the abyss of fire.* The consummation-of-the-punishment-substance ties Matt 24:39's *took them all away* (Greek *ēren hapantas*) to the substantial-judgment-substance — NOT the substantial-modern-Christian-pre-tribulation-rapture-rescue-substance. The substantial-flood took-the-substantial-wicked-and-the-Watcher-corruption-substance AWAY in-judgment.
members.new: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be* (Matthew 24:39). The flood took the wicked away; it did not carry the righteous off. Enoch's word for the Watchers is the same taking: led off to the abyss of fire, to the prison. The ones taken at the coming are the ones taken at the flood — the judged.

members.old: 1 Enoch 90:10 — *the sheep gathered together to that great horn, and they began to rejoice.* The Animal-Apocalypse-substance of the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant-of-Yashar'el (Israel) gathered-by-the-Lord-of-the-sheep to the substantial-great-horn — the substantial-substance the substantial-Messianic-substance walks-the-substantial-gathering-into. Threaded with 1 Enoch 90:17 in the cross-reference note: *the Lord of the sheep brought all the sheep into that new house* — the substantial *all the sheep* substance is the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes per Ezekiel 37:15-28 + the substantial-new-Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) per Revelation 21:1-3.
members.new: *And it looked at them [and their eyes opened], and it cried to the sheep, and the rams saw it and all ran to it.* (1 Enoch 90:10). *And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds* (Matthew 24:31). Enoch saw the gathering as a flock: the great horn cried to the sheep, their eyes opened, and the rams all ran to it. The gathering is the sheep running to the horn that called them.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:5 — *These are the secrets which thou hast seen; and these are the secrets of the Most High; and the books of the living were opened before him.* The wisdom-stream context for the throne-of-his-glory + secrets-of-the-Most-High + books-of-the-living-opened-before-him — the architecture the sheep-and-goats opening at Matt 25:31 walks-into directly; the Davidic-Messianic-throne per Psalm 110:1 + 2 Samuel 7:12-16 anchors the wisdom-stream-foretaste.
members.new: *And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.* (1 Enoch 62:5). *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch saw that seat and the faces of those who see it — terror, pain, downcast countenance, when they see that Son of Adam sitting on the throne of his glory. The sheep-and-goats judgment opens on the throne the Parables had already set.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:3 — *He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above ... And the Elect One, And the other powers on the earth and over the water.* The angelic-host-summoned-with-the-Elect-One substance — the substantial-substance Matt 25:31's *all the holy angels with him* walks, in continuity with Deuteronomy 33:2 + Daniel 7:10 + Zechariah 14:5 + Jude 14-15's preservation of the Enoch the seventh-from-Adam prophecy.
members.new: *And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.* (1 Enoch 61:10). *And all the holy angels with him* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch gives the roll: the host of the heavens, the holy ones above, Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophannim, the angels of power and of principalities — and the Elect One among them. The company of the coming was mustered in the Parables before the gospel named it.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:9 — *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, And the strong from their thrones.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the Son-of-Adam-raising-up-the-kings-and-mighty-from-their-thrones substance — the reversal-architecture the sheep-and-goats-judgment walks-out at Matt 25:32's gathering and separation, in continuity with Psalm 2:9 + Psalm 110:5-6 + Isaiah 24:21.
members.new: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another* (Matthew 25:32). The Son of Adam who separates is the Son of Adam Enoch saw raise the kings and the mighty from their seats and break the teeth of the sinners. The separation is a reversal; the mighty do not keep their seats at it.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:11 — *He shall humble the countenance of the strong, And shall abase the pride of the mighty.* The humbling-of-the-strong + abasing-of-the-pride-of-the-mighty substance + the darkness-as-dwelling at 62:12 — the substantial-outer-darkness of Matt 22:13 + 25:30 + the everlasting-fire of Matt 25:41. The fire was-substantively-prepared-FOR-the-devil-and-his-angels per Jude 6-7 + 2 Peter 2:4 + Revelation 20:10; the goats sent toward it are the unfruitful among the gathered, sifted before the reign.
members.new: *And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame. And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 46:6). *Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels* (Matthew 25:41). Enoch saw what that departure is for the strong: countenance put down, shame, darkness for a dwelling, worms for a bed, no hope of rising — because they did not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

members.old: 1 Enoch 63:7 — *In those days the kings and the mighty who possess the earth Shall be seized with great terror, And they shall pray and supplicate ... and they shall not be saved.* The kings-and-mighty-seized-with-great-terror + prayer-and-supplication-too-late substance — the substantial-substance the goats walk-into at *Lord, when saw we thee* of Matt 25:44; the substantial-recognition-coming-too-late; the substantial-cutoff is substantial; the substantial-Universalist-substance is explicitly-ruled-out.
members.new: *And in the day of our suffering and tribulation He saves us not, And we find no respite for confession That our Lord is true in all His works, and in His judgements and His justice, And His judgements have no respect of persons.* (1 Enoch 63:8). *Depart from me, ye cursed* (Matthew 25:41) is answered in Enoch by the mouths of the kings and the mighty themselves: in the day of their tribulation he saves them not, and their confession comes too late to be anything but true. *Lord, when saw we thee an hungred?* (Matthew 25:44) is the same late confession.

members.old: 1 Enoch 46:2 — *I asked the angel ... concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-walking-with-the-Head-of-Days substance — the named-figure-standing-beside-the-Father at the heavenly-throne-vision register. The substantial-King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) at Matt 26:64 identifies-himself-as-the-Son-of-Adam-the-Parables-had-named-the-substance-for centuries before.
members.new: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* (Matthew 26:64). The bound man before the council names himself with Enoch's title — *that Son of Adam* who went with the Head of Days. The council thought it was judging him; he was telling them who would judge.

members.old: 1 Enoch 63:3 — *all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth shall fall down on their faces before him and worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam.* The kings-and-the-mighty-falling-down-on-their-faces-before-the-Son-of-Adam-on-the-day-of-judgement substance — in continuity with Isaiah 45:23 + Philippians 2:10-11's every-knee-shall-bow-substance. The substantial-acknowledgement-of-Lordship-substance does-NOT-walk-into-categorical-Universalism; the substantial-day-of-judgement-substance follows (1 Enoch 63:4-6, 9).
members.new: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power* (Matthew 26:64). Enoch saw what the council will see: all the kings and the mighty falling on their faces before that Son of Adam, petitioning him for mercy. The men who condemned him will kneel to him.

members.old: 1 Enoch 63:1 — *in those days shall the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who possess the earth be summoned, and they shall be made to stand before the Elect One on that day of judgement.* THE verbal-anchor for the kings-and-the-mighty summoned-before-the-Elect-One architecture — the present-tense morning-council at Matt 27:1 (the corrupted-Sanhedrin-leadership + Pontius-Pilate + Hordos-Antipas counsel-against-the-Anointed per Tehillim (Psalm) 2:2 + Acts 4:25-28) is the architectural-inverse of the eschatological-summons.
members.new: *And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty, And the exalted and those who hold the earth, And they shall see and recognize How he sits on the throne of his glory, And righteousness is judged before him, And no lying word is spoken before him.* (1 Enoch 62:3). *When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death* (Matthew 27:1). Enoch saw the other morning: all the kings and the mighty standing up in that day to see and recognize how he sits on the throne of his glory, where no lying word is spoken. The council that condemned him stands at his bar.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:3 — *He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophanim... and the Elect One.* The wisdom-stream names the Elect-One-summoned-with-the-host-of-the-heavens architecture — the King at Matt 27:42 COULD-have-summoned-twelve-legions-of-angels per Matt 26:53; he walks-the-cross-substantively per the Father's-purpose. The mockers cannot-see the Elect-One's-credential is NOT the come-down-from-the-cross they demand.
members.new: *And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.* (1 Enoch 61:10). *If he be the King of Yashar'el (Israel), let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him* (Matthew 27:42). The mockers set the wrong test. Enoch saw the King's credential: the whole host of heaven summoned, and the Elect One among them. He did not come down from the cross; he is the one for whom the heavens are mustered.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:7 — *this is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, and righteousness abides over him, and the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.* THE direct verbal-anchor: the wisdom-stream named the Son-of-Adam's-being-not-forsaken centuries before. The King's-prayer at Matt 27:46 (*Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani*) is the Suffering-Servant-praying-Tehillim (Psalm) 22 (which walks AS A WHOLE from apparent-forsakenness in vv.1-21 INTO vindication in vv.22-31), NOT the Trinity-co-equal-person-being-forsaken reading the inherited-Christian-collapse walks per Red Line #10's nature-of-God reading.
members.new: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *He trusted in Elohim (God); let him deliver him now, if he will have him* (Matthew 27:43). The Head of Days had already said it: *the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.* The cross was not the Father's forsaking of the Son; it was the Son of Adam, born unto righteousness, doing what righteousness does.

members.old: 1 Enoch 63:3 — *all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth shall fall down on their faces before him and worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, and shall petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* The eschatological-reversal architecture — the kings-and-the-mighty who-presently-mock at the cross shall-eventually fall-down-on-their-faces and worship the Son-of-Adam per Philippians 2:10-11. Read against Red Line #11's post-harvest-sifting: the eschatological-bowing is universal-acknowledgment, NOT universal-salvation.
members.new: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). *Let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him* (Matthew 27:42). Enoch saw the mockers' end: the kings and the mighty and those who rule the earth falling on their faces before that Son of Adam, worshipping and petitioning. *Every knee should bow* (Philippians 2:10) — the mockers included.

members.old: 1 Enoch 61:8 — *and the Head of Days placed the Elect One on the throne of His glory; and he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, and weigh their deeds in the balance.* The Head-of-Days-placed-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance — the Father-Son relational-architecture per the Formless-Source / Formed-Expression grid (the Head-of-Days is the Father; the Elect-One is the Son). The judging-and-weighing-of-deeds substance is the post-harvest-sifting per Matt 7:21-23 + Matt 25:31-46.
members.new: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch saw the placing — Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits setting the Elect One on the throne of glory to judge and to weigh deeds in the balance. The Father is the giver; the Son is seated; the power is the power to judge.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:6 — *and Yahuah (God) of Spirits seated the Elect One on the throne of His glory, and he shall judge all the secret things, and no one shall be able to utter a lying word in his presence.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Father-of-Spirits-seated-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance — the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Daniel 7:13-14 dominion-and-glory-and-a-kingdom substance the King walks at Matt 28:18 + Psalm 110:1's right-hand-of-the-Father substance the apostle-Sha'ul (Paul) walks at Ephesians 1:20-22. Per Red Line #12, the Son-of-Adam-architecture: the named-Standard at 1 Enoch 46-71 (NOT the kaph-comparative case).
members.new: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch saw the giving: the Elect One seated on the throne of glory, the spirit of righteousness poured out on him, the word of his mouth slaying the sinners. The power was given by the Father; the Son wields it.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:9 — *and this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and the strong from their thrones, and shall loosen the reins of the strong, and break the teeth of the sinners.* The Son-of-Adam-raising-up-and-putting-down-the-kings-and-the-mighty substance — the categorical-dominion-substance heaven-and-earth-substantively-comprehensively. The substance Revelation 6:15-17 + 19:11-21 + Daniel 2:44 walk-out at the eschatological-substance the King's-all-power-at-Matt 28:18 enables.
members.new: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch's Son of Adam raises the kings and the mighty from their seats and breaks the teeth of the sinners. That is what all power looks like when it is used.

members.old: 1 Enoch 15:6-7 — *the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth.* The unclean spirit at Mark 1:24 is one of the watchers' bound offspring; it recognizes the Holy One because it was there at the rebellion.
members.new: 1 Enoch 15:8-7 — *the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth.* The unclean spirit at Mark 1:24 is one of the watchers' bound offspring; it recognizes the Holy One because it was there at the rebellion.

members.old: 1 Enoch 15:11 — *thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement.* The demon's *art thou come to destroy us?* (Mark 1:24) knows its judgement-day is fixed in the one standing before it.
members.new: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). 1 Enoch 16:1 names the unclean spirit's origin and its appointed end: the spirits gone forth from the giants destroy until the day of the great judgement. The demon's own question at Mark 1:24 — *art thou come to destroy us?* — names that it knows its judgement-day is fixed; the watchers' offspring recognize that the Holy One of Elohim is the one who holds the day of their consummation.

members.old: 1 Enoch 16:1, 4 — *Say to them therefore: "You have no peace."* The demon's *Let us alone* (Mark 1:24) is the no-peace condition speaking; the Holy One's coming is the disturbance of a peace never granted.
members.new: 1 Enoch 16:4, 4 — *Say to them therefore: "You have no peace."* The demon's *Let us alone* (Mark 1:24) is the no-peace condition speaking; the Holy One's coming is the disturbance of a peace never granted.

members.old: 1 Enoch 19:1 — *here shall they stand, till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged.* At Mark 3:11 the unclean spirits fall down and cry *Thou art the Son of Elohim (God)* — recognizing the Judge before whom they must one day stand.
members.new: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). 1 Enoch 19:1 names the watcher-spirits and their appointed standing-place of judgement. At Mark 3:11 the unclean spirits *fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of Elohim (God)* — the watcher-administration recognizing the Judge before whom it must one day stand, falling down before the Formed one whose great-judgement-day is named in the Enochic library.

members.old: 1 Enoch 15:8 — *as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.* The earth-bound multitude the Hebrew library locates; *Legion: for we are many* (Mark 5:9) is the gospel's word for the same class.
members.new: 1 Enoch 15:10 — *as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.* The earth-bound multitude the Hebrew library locates; *Legion: for we are many* (Mark 5:9) is the gospel's word for the same class.

members.old: 1 Enoch 15:9 — *the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth.* The torment of the man among the tombs — crying, cutting himself with stones — is the work the Hebrew library attributes to the spirits of the giants.
members.new: 1 Enoch 15:11 — *the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth.* The torment of the man among the tombs — crying, cutting himself with stones — is the work the Hebrew library attributes to the spirits of the giants.

members.old: 1 Enoch 15:11 — the spirits *destroy without incurring judgement... until the day of the consummation, the great judgement.* The drowning in the sea is the King displacing their administration of the eastern territory, not their final judgement, which waits for the day appointed.
members.new: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). *And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea* (Mark 5:13). The spirits of the giants afflict and destroy, Enoch says, and they do not eat yet hunger. The sea was not their judgement; that waits for the day of the consummation. It was the King displacing them.

members.old: 1 Enoch 16:1 — *And from the beginning thus have I been shown concerning you, and written concerning you.* The unclean spirit the King commands out (Mark 5:8) is no faceless force; the Hebrew library had recorded its lineage and its sentence — *You have no peace* (1 Enoch 16:4).
members.new: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). *For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.* 1 Enoch 16:1 names the spirits the command addresses by their origin in the slain giants:  The unclean spirit is not a faceless force; the Hebrew library had recorded its lineage and its sentence — *Say to them therefore: "You have no peace."* (1 Enoch 16:4) — long before the King commanded it out of the man.

members.old: 1 Enoch 19:1 — the spirits *lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, here shall they stand, till the day of the great judgement.* The man restored *in his right mind* (Mark 5:15) is the leading-astray undone in one man, a sign of the judgement reserved for the spirits themselves.
members.new: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). *And see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid* (Mark 5:15). The man restored is the reversal, in one life, of what Enoch says these spirits do — defile mankind and lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods. Their day of judgement is fixed; the Gadarene was given his back early.

members.old: 1 Enoch 27:1-3 — the accursed valley beside the holy mountain, the Ge-Hinnom topography the word *hell* (Gehenna) draws its name from; Mark 9:43's *cut it off ... than having two hands to go into hell* walks the same place-of-judgment architecture.
members.new: *And there I saw a holy mountain, and underneath the mountain to the east there was a stream and it flowed towards the south.* (1 Enoch 26:2). 1 Enoch 27:1-3 places the accursed valley — the Hinnom-shaped place of punishment for the godless — beside the holy mountain, the very Ge-Hinnom topography the gospel's *hell* (Gehenna) draws its name from. The King's *cut it off ... than having two hands to go into hell* (Mark 9:43) walks the same place-of-judgment architecture 1 Enoch maps at the middle of the earth: the accursed valley appointed for the day of judgment.

members.old: 1 Enoch 22:11 — *these places have been made for them until the day of their judgement ... till the great judgement comes upon them.* The framework-honest two-compartment holding of the dead behind the gospel's *hell* (Gehenna); Mark 9:48 names the place 1 Enoch had already mapped, not the inherited eternal-torment caricature.
members.new: *Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.* (1 Enoch 22:11). *Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched* (Mark 9:48). Enoch was shown where the sinners' spirits are set apart in great pain until the great day of judgement — a holding until the judgement comes, and then the binding for ever. The place Mark warns of is the place Enoch had mapped; the fire that is not quenched is the judgement the holding waits for.

members.old: 1 Enoch 46:4 — *this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats.* The judging-reversal of the enthroned Son of Adam; Mark 14:62's *coming in the clouds of heaven* binds the enthronement to the judgment of those who condemn him.
members.new: 1 Enoch 46:4 — *this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats.* The judging-reversal of the enthroned Son of Adam; Mark 14:62's *coming in the clouds of heaven* binds the enthronement to the judgment of those who condemn him.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:1 — *Yahuah (God) of Spirits named the Elect One, and seated him on the throne of His glory.* The seating named directly; Mark 14:62's *sitting on the right hand of power* walks the same enthronement on the throne of glory.
members.new: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *Sitting on the right hand of power* (Mark 14:62). Enoch saw the placing: Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits set the Elect One on the throne of glory to judge. The bound man names his seat before the court that thinks it is judging him.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:7 — *this is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness... and the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.* The righteous Son of Adam whom the Head of Days never forsakes; Mark 14:62's *I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power* names the same figure enthroned at the right hand.
members.new: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). 1 Enoch 71:14 names the Son of Adam born unto righteousness, over whom the righteousness of the Head of Days never fails. Mark 14:62's self-identification — *I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power* — names the same figure the Parables named: the righteous one whom the Head of Days does not forsake, enthroned at the right hand. The title-naming of the Parables and the direct attribution of the King land on one figure.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:9 — *this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and the strong from their thrones.* The kings-and-mighty-cast-down reversal named again; Mark 14:62's enthroned-and-coming Son of Adam is the figure who raises the very court that condemns him from its seat.
members.new: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). *Ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* (Mark 14:62). Enoch saw the seeing: the kings and the mighty falling on their faces before that Son of Adam, petitioning for mercy. The court that condemned him will see him, exactly as he said.

members.old: 1 Enoch 40:2 — *I saw four presences, different from those that stand... for the angel that went with me made known to me their names.* The Hebrew library's standing-before-the-throne presences; Gabriel names himself one of them at Luke 1:19.
members.new: 1 Enoch 40:2 — *I saw four presences, different from those that stand... for the angel that went with me made known to me their names.* The Hebrew library's standing-before-the-throne presences; Gabriel names himself one of them at Luke 1:19.

members.old: 1 Enoch 40:9 — *the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel.* The Hebrew library names Gabriel by name among the four presences before Yahuah (God) of Spirits; Luke 1:19's *I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of Elohim (God)* names the same angel in the same office. (Phanuel of the same verse threads into Luke 2:36, Anna the daughter of Phanuel.)
members.new: 1 Enoch 40:9 — *the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel.* The Hebrew library names Gabriel by name among the four presences before Yahuah (God) of Spirits; Luke 1:19's *I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of Elohim (God)* names the same angel in the same office. (Phanuel of the same verse threads into Luke 2:36, Anna the daughter of Phanuel.)

members.old: 1 Enoch 40:1 — *I saw thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads, and an infinite number of people, standing before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* The innumerable host before the throne; Luke 2:13's *multitude of the heavenly host praising Elohim (God)* is the same host, descended over the shepherds.
members.new: *And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:1). *Suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising Elohim (God)* (Luke 2:13). Enoch saw that host where it stands — thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. At the birth of the Son the host that stands before the throne came down to the fields.

members.old: 1 Enoch 39:12 — *I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (God) of glory.* The praise before the throne; Luke 2:14's *Glory to Elohim (God) in the highest* is the same heavenly-praise register sounded on earth.
members.new: 1 Enoch 40:3 — *I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (God) of glory.* The praise before the throne; Luke 2:14's *Glory to Elohim (God) in the highest* is the same heavenly-praise register sounded on earth.

members.old: 1 Enoch 39:13 — *the first voice blesses Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever.* The host blessing the Most High for ever; Luke 2:14's glory-in-the-highest is the same blessing, now over Bethlehem.
members.new: 1 Enoch 40:4 — *the first voice blesses Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever.* The host blessing the Most High for ever; Luke 2:14's glory-in-the-highest is the same blessing, now over Bethlehem.

members.old: 1 Enoch 85:3 — *behold a bull came forth from the earth, and that bull was white; and after it came forth a heifer, and along with this (heifer) two young bulls, one of them black and the other red.* The Adamic toledot in vision-form — white bull (Adam), heifer (Eve), black and red bulls (Cain, Abel); Luke 3:38 closes its backward genealogy on the same Adam, the son of Elohim.
members.new: *Before I took thy mother Edna, I saw in a vision on my bed, and behold a bull came forth from the earth, and that bull was white; and after it came forth a heifer, and along with this (latter) came forth two bulls, one of them black and the other red.* (1 Enoch 85:3). 1 Enoch 85:3 opens the Animal Apocalypse with the white bull (Adam) coming forth from the earth, the heifer (Chavah/Eve), and the two young bulls — the black (Cain) and the red (Hevel/Abel). This is the Adamic toledot in vision-form, the same opening of the seed-line Luke 3:38 closes its backward genealogy on: *the son of Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God).* The Hebrew library sees the first man as the white bull from the earth whom Yahuah created; the gospel names the same Adam as the son of Elohim at the head of the seed-line.

members.old: 1 Enoch 85:8 — *another white bull... from Him proceeded many white bulls, and they resembled him... one following the other.* The Sethite seed-line as the white bulls one-following-another; Luke 3:36-38 traces that same line backward to Adam.
members.new: 1 Enoch 85:9 — *another white bull... from Him proceeded many white bulls, and they resembled him... one following the other.* The Sethite seed-line as the white bulls one-following-another; Luke 3:36-38 traces that same line backward to Adam.

members.old: 1 Enoch 60:8 — *the seventh from Adam, the first man whom Yahuah (God) of Spirits created.* Adam named the first-created man, Enoch (Chanok) the seventh from him; Luke 3:37 runs the genealogy through Enoch in the same seventh-from-Adam count Jude 1:14 carries, landing on Adam the son of Elohim.
members.new: 1 Enoch 60:8 — *the seventh from Adam, the first man whom Yahuah (God) of Spirits created.* Adam named the first-created man, Enoch (Chanok) the seventh from him; Luke 3:37 runs the genealogy through Enoch in the same seventh-from-Adam count Jude 1:14 carries, landing on Adam the son of Elohim.

members.old: 1 Enoch 15:8 — *as for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.* The earth-dwelling demon-origin; Luke 8:29's unclean spirit that drove the man into the wilderness is an earthbound spirit of the order 1 Enoch names.
members.new: 1 Enoch 15:10 — *as for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.* The earth-dwelling demon-origin; Luke 8:29's unclean spirit that drove the man into the wilderness is an earthbound spirit of the order 1 Enoch names.

members.old: 1 Enoch 16:1 — *and from the beginning thus have I been shown concerning you, and written concerning you.* The written-from-the-beginning verdict; Luke 8:28's demoniac cries *thou Son of Elohim (God) most high ... torment me not* — recognizing the One who holds the recorded sentence.
members.new: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). *What have I to do with thee, Yahusha (Jesus), thou Son of Elohim (God) most high? I beseech thee, torment me not* (Luke 8:28). The spirits know the day of the consummation is appointed for them; Enoch records that they destroy only until it. The demoniac's cry is the fear of a sentence already written.

members.old: 1 Enoch 15:11 — *thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated.* The appointed-consummation the spirits dread; Luke 8:31's Legion *besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep* — the confinement appointed against the day of judgment.
members.new: 1 Enoch 16:1 — *thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated.* The appointed-consummation the spirits dread; Luke 8:31's Legion *besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep* — the confinement appointed against the day of judgment.

members.old: 1 Enoch 6:6 — *they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Yered (Jared) on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.* The watcher-descent by their own oath; Luke 10:18's *I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven* names the same fall the wisdom-stream traced to Yered's (Jared's) day.
members.new: *And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.* (1 Enoch 6:6). *I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven* (Luke 10:18). Enoch records the first fall — two hundred who descended on Hermon in the days of Jared and bound themselves by oath. The seventy returning with the devils subject to them (Luke 10:17) were undoing, territory by territory, what began on that mountain.

members.old: 1 Enoch 22:9 — *there was in it four hollow places, deep and wide and very smooth.* Enoch shown the compartmented holding-places of the dead; Luke 16:22's carrying of Lazaros into Avraham's (Abraham's) bosom while the rich man is held elsewhere walks the same architecture.
members.new: *And he answered me and said unto me: ‘These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And such a division has been made for the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright spring of water.* (1 Enoch 22:9). Enoch is shown the holding-places of the dead — distinct compartments hewn in the great mountain. Luke 16:22's carrying of Lazaros *by the angels into Avraham's (Abraham's) bosom* while the rich man is *buried* and lifts his eyes in another place walks the same architecture the Hebrew library named: the dead are held in separated compartments pending the judgment, not annihilated into nothing and not dispatched to a final eternal destination.

members.old: 1 Enoch 22:10 — *the spirits of the souls of the dead should assemble therein.* The conscious-souls-assembled register against soul-sleep; Luke 16:23's rich man lifting his eyes and seeing across the gulf assumes exactly this gathered-and-aware architecture.
members.new: *And such has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgement has not been executed on them in their lifetime.* (1 Enoch 22:10). The conscious-souls-of-the-dead-assembled register against the inherited soul-sleep misread. Luke 16:23's rich man *in hell (hadēs) lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Avraham (Abraham) afar off, and Lazaros in his bosom* assumes exactly this architecture — the spirits of the dead are gathered, aware, and identifiable, held in the hollow places the Hebrew library named.

members.old: 1 Enoch 22:11 — *these places have been made for them until the day of their judgement and until their appointed period.* The holding-places are TEMPORAL; the framework's key against both soul-sleep and eternal-conscious-torment-as-final-destination. Luke 16:26's *great gulf fixed* names the same compartments held until the great judgment.
members.new: *And these places have been made to receive them till the day of their judgement and till their appointed period [till the period appointed], till the great judgement (comes) upon them.’* (1 Enoch 22:4). *Between us and you there is a great gulf fixed* (Luke 16:26). Enoch saw the fixing: the hollow places made to receive the dead until the day of their judgement, divided one from another. Sheol is real and the dead are aware in it — and it is a holding until the appointed period, not the final destination.

members.old: 1 Enoch 90:3 — *that great horn cried aloud to the sheep, and the sheep began to gather together to it.* The animal-apocalypse gathering of the dispersed sheep; Luke 19:10's seek-and-save-the-lost names the same shepherd-gathers-the-scattered architecture in the King's own voice.
members.new: *And it looked at them [and their eyes opened], and it cried to the sheep, and the rams saw it and all ran to it.* (1 Enoch 90:10). *For the Son of Adam is come to seek and to save that which was lost* (Luke 19:10). Enoch saw the seeking as a horn crying to the sheep, their eyes opening, and all of them running to it. The lost are the house of Yashar'el (Israel) scattered among the nations; the seeking is the call that brings the sheep running home — not a new flock gathered from the nations.

members.old: 1 Enoch 39:4 — *there mine eyes saw their dwellings with His righteous angels, and their resting-places with the holy.* The resting-places of the righteous among the holy angels; Luke 20:36's *equal unto the angels* is the children of the resurrection sharing the dwellings of the holy ones.
members.new: *And there I saw another vision, the dwelling-places of the holy, And the resting-places of the righteous.* (1 Enoch 39:4). The Hebrew library names the dwellings of the righteous WITH the holy angels — the resting-places of the elect among the holy ones of heaven. *They are equal unto the angels; and are the children of Elohim (God), being the children of the resurrection* (Luke 20:36): the equal-unto-the-angels register the King names against the Sadducees' deny-the-resurrection is the same dwelling-with-the-righteous-angels Enoch saw — the children of the resurrection sharing the resting-places of the holy ones, no longer dying, no longer given in marriage, equal unto the angels.

members.old: 1 Enoch 39:5 — *the voice of the Holy One shall be heard in the heaven, and the voice of the Elect One shall be heard from the throne of glory.* The heavenly-register the children of the resurrection enter; Luke 20:36's no-more-dying immortality is the heavenly-life among the angels where the Elect One reigns.
members.new: *Here mine eyes saw their dwellings with His righteous angels, And their resting-places with the holy. And they petitioned and interceded and prayed for the children of men, And righteousness flowed before them as water, And mercy like dew upon the earth: Thus it is amongst them for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 39:5). *Equal unto the angels; and are the children of Elohim (God), being the children of the resurrection* (Luke 20:36). Enoch saw their dwellings with the righteous angels and their resting-places with the holy. The children of the resurrection dwell where Enoch saw them dwell.

members.old: 1 Enoch 104:4 — *the righteous shall be victorious in the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits: And He will cause His light to appear on them, And He will make peace for them.* The resurrection-life of the righteous made-victorious and lighted; Luke 20:35-36's worthy-to-obtain-that-world register is this raised-into-the-angelic-register life.
members.new: *Be hopeful, and cast not away your hope; for ye shall have great joy as the angels of heaven.* (1 Enoch 104:4). *Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels* (Luke 20:36). Enoch tells the righteous to hope, *for ye shall have great joy as the angels of heaven.* The equality with angels is joy without end, promised before the Sadducees asked their question.

members.old: 1 Enoch 22:9 — *there was in it four hollow places, deep and wide and very smooth.* The chambers-of-the-souls-of-the-dead architecture; Luke 23:43's paradise is the righteous chamber of these hollow places where the King and the thief go this-day.
members.new: *And he answered me and said unto me: ‘These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And such a division has been made for the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright spring of water.* (1 Enoch 22:9). *To day shalt thou be with me in paradise* (Luke 23:43). Enoch was shown the hollow places where the spirits of the dead are received — deep, wide, divided. The paradise promised to the thief that day is the righteous division of those places, where the bright spring of water is, until the day of judgement.

members.old: 1 Enoch 22:11 — *these places have been made for them until the day of their judgement and until their appointed period, till the great judgement comes upon them.* The until-the-judgement holding-period; Luke 23:43's this-day paradise is the holding-register of the righteous in the hours after the cross, before the great judgement and the ascension-relocation.
members.new: *And these places have been made to receive them till the day of their judgement and till their appointed period [till the period appointed], till the great judgement (comes) upon them.’* (1 Enoch 22:4). *To day shalt thou be with me in paradise* (Luke 23:43). Enoch was shown the places made to receive the dead until the day of their judgement. The paradise promised to the thief that day is the righteous division of those places, held until the great judgement — not the final state, but the keeping until it.

members.old: 1 Enoch 42:2 — *Wisdom went forth to make her dwelling among the children of men, but she found no dwelling-place.* The one sent to dwell among men finds no place; John 1:11's *he came unto his own, and his own received him not.*
members.new: *Wisdom went forth to make her dwelling among the children of men, And found no dwelling-place: Wisdom returned to her place, And took her seat among the angels.* (1 Enoch 42:2). *He came unto his own, and his own received him not* (John 1:11). Enoch saw Wisdom go out to make her dwelling among the children of men and find no place. The Word came to his own and found no room; the rejection was foreseen before the Word was made flesh.
