members.old: 1 Enoch 61:8 — *and the Head of Days placed the Elect One on the throne of His glory; And he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, And weigh their deeds in the balance.* The Head of Days seats the figure on the throne of glory to judge; John 5:27's *and hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam* walks the same enthroned-to-judge architecture.
members.new: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam* (John 5:27). Enoch saw the giving: the Elect One placed on the throne of glory to judge and to weigh deeds in the balance. The authority John names is the seat Enoch saw filled.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:2 (with 62:7, *this is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness*) — *and when he shall lift up his face To judge their secret ways by the word of the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* The Son of Adam seated to judge the secret ways of all; John 5:27 names the same figure given judgment *because he is the Son of Adam.*
members.new: *And when he shall lift up his countenance To judge their secret ways according to the word of the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And their path according to the way of the righteous judgement of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, Then shall they all with one voice speak and bless, And glorify and extol and sanctify the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 61:9). *And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam* (John 5:27). Enoch saw him lift up his countenance to judge their secret ways, and the whole host bless the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for it. The authority is given by the Father; the judging is the Son's; the praise returns to the Father.

members.new: 1 Enoch 1:9 — *He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all* the coming Jude quoted — the One taken up returns, and the holy ones with him are the seed of promise gathered to him.

members.new: 1 Enoch 8:2 — *Semjâzâ taught enchantments, and root-cuttings … Barâqîjâl taught astrology* the watcher-source of the divining art Paul commands out (Acts 16:16,18).

members.old: *My spirit was carried off and it ascended into the heavens* (1 Enoch 71:1) — the taking shown from within, among *the holy sons of Elohim* (Hebrews 11:5).
members.new: *And it came to pass after this that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heavens: And I saw the holy sons of Elohim (God). They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white [and their raiment], And their faces shone like snow.* (1 Enoch 71:1). *By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death... because Elohim (God) had translated him* (Hebrews 11:5). The Torah says only that Elohim (God) took him; Enoch tells the taking from the inside — *my spirit was translated and it ascended into the heavens.* The man who pleased Elohim (God) was brought up among the holy sons of Elohim (God), translated rather than buried.

members.old: *He translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens* (1 Enoch 71:5) — the very word Hebrews uses, *translated* (Hebrews 11:5).
members.new: *He translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens* (1 Enoch 71:5) — the very word Hebrews uses, *translated* (Hebrews 11:5).

members.old: 1 Enoch 14:15 — *like the throne of Yahuah (God), of stibium, and the top of the throne was of sapphire* the throne-and-fire theophany Enoch saw; the fire that clothes the One with *eyes... as a flame of fire* (Revelation 1:13-14).
members.new: *And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.* (1 Enoch 14:18). The throne Enoch saw — crystal, wheels like the sun, cherubim, fire streaming from beneath it (1 Enoch 14:18–22) — is the throne-and-fire presence John is brought into when he sees the Formed One whose *eyes were as a flame of fire* and whose *feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace* (Revelation 1:14–15). John falls as dead, as Enoch fell on his face.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:7 — *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness... the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not* seated on the throne of glory; the slain-yet-living One *alive for evermore... have the keys of hell and of death* (Revelation 1:18).
members.new: 1 Enoch 71:14 — *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness... the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not* seated on the throne of glory; the slain-yet-living One *alive for evermore... have the keys of hell and of death* (Revelation 1:18).

members.old: 1 Enoch 24:11 — *its fruit shall be for life to the elect; it shall be transplanted to the holy place* the restored library says plainly the tree's fruit is given to the elect, as the letter promises the overcomer (Revelation 2:7).
members.new: *Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of Yahuah (Lord), the Eternal King.* (1 Enoch 25:5). The restored library says plainly what the letter promises: the fruit of the tree *shall be for food to the elect,* and the tree transplanted to the holy place. *To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God)* (Revelation 2:7). The same elect, the same tree, the same gift.

members.old: 1 Enoch 14:15 — *like the throne of Yahuah (God), of stibium, and the top of the throne was of sapphire* the sapphire throne reaching to heaven Enoch saw, the same precious-stone throne of *he that sat* (Revelation 4:3).
members.new: *And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.* (1 Enoch 14:18). *And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone* (Revelation 4:3). Enoch saw the lofty throne of crystal with wheels like the shining sun and the cherubim about it, and the Great Glory seated on it (1 Enoch 14:20). The throne of precious stone was seen before the door in heaven opened to John.

members.old: 1 Enoch 14:18 — *I saw a place which had no firmament of the heaven above* the lofty throne-room Enoch reached in his ascent, the heaven into which a door opens and John is caught up (Revelation 4:1-2).
members.new: 1 Enoch 18:12 — *I saw a place which had no firmament of the heaven above* the lofty throne-room Enoch reached in his ascent, the heaven into which a door opens and John is caught up (Revelation 4:1-2).

members.old: 1 Enoch 71:8 — *I saw the hidden things in heaven* Enoch translated to the heaven of heavens and the crystal throne-house of living fire, the throne-room of *him that liveth for ever and ever* (Revelation 4:9).
members.new: *And I saw angels who could not be counted, A thousand thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand, Encircling that house. And Michael, and Raphael, and Gabriel, and Phanuel, And the holy angels who are above the heavens, Go in and out of that house.* (1 Enoch 71:8). *Him that liveth for ever and ever* (Revelation 4:9) sits in a house Enoch saw: a structure built of crystals with tongues of living fire between them (1 Enoch 71:5), encircled by angels beyond counting. It is the throne-room John enters.

members.old: 1 Enoch 39:13 — *the first voice blesses Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever* praise *for ever and ever,* the note of those who worship *him that liveth for ever and ever* (Revelation 4:9).
members.new: *The first voice blesses Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 40:4). The praise Enoch heard rises *for ever and ever* — the very note John's four living creatures sound, who *rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy* (Revelation 4:8). One worship before one throne.

members.old: 1 Enoch 39:11 — *I saw the four presences which surround the throne of glory, and they praise Yahuah (God) of Spirits* the four about the throne whose ceaseless praise Enoch saw, John's four beasts crying *Holy, holy, holy* day and night (Revelation 4:8).
members.new: *And on the four sides of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.* (1 Enoch 40:2). Enoch saw the four John sees: four presences on the four sides of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, whose praises he heard (1 Enoch 40:3). John's *four beasts* who *rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy* (Revelation 4:8) are the same four about the same throne.

members.old: 1 Enoch 71:5 — *I saw there a structure built of crystals, And between those crystals tongues of living fire* the crystal throne-house Enoch beheld in the heaven of heavens, the same crystal expanse as John's sea of glass like crystal (Revelation 4:6).
members.new: *And he translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens, And I saw there as it were a structure built of crystals, And between those crystals tongues of living fire.* (1 Enoch 71:5). Enoch saw the throne-room floored and walled with crystal — *a structure built of crystals* — the same clear, shining expanse John names *a sea of glass like unto crystal* (Revelation 4:6). The crystal pavement of the throne-house the seers of Yashar'el (Israel) beheld is the crystal sea before the throne, the clear floor of the heavenly sanctuary.

members.old: 1 Enoch 40:1 — *thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads... standing before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* the numberless host before the throne of glory, of which the enthroned elders are a part (Revelation 4:10).
members.new: *And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:1). *The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne* (Revelation 4:10). Enoch saw the multitude beyond number standing before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. The elders who cast their crowns belong to that numberless worship.

members.old: 1 Enoch 60:1 — *a thousand thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand* the host of the Most High before the throne of glory where the Head of Days sits, the angels and righteous standing around Him (Revelation 4:10).
members.new: 1 Enoch 60:1 — *a thousand thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand* the host of the Most High before the throne of glory where the Head of Days sits, the angels and righteous standing around Him (Revelation 4:10).

members.old: 1 Enoch 40:1 — *thousands of thousands and myriads of myriads... standing before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* the Hebrew library's innumerable court before the throne, whose voices bless both Yahuah (God) of Spirits and the Elect One beside him (Revelation 5:11).
members.new: *And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:1). *Ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands* (Revelation 5:11) — John's count is Enoch's count, word for word. Enoch heard that host bless Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits and bless the Elect One beside him (1 Enoch 40:4–5); John hears them cry *Worthy is the Lamb that was slain* (Revelation 5:12). The Father and the Lamb, praised together by the myriads.

members.new: 1 Enoch 46:4 — *this Son of Adam... Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats* the enthroned Elect One before whom the mighty fall, the worshipped Son distinct from Yahuah (God) of Spirits who seated him (Revelation 5:13).

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:6 — *Yahuah (God) of Spirits seated the Elect One on the throne of His glory* the Father enthroning the chosen Son, the worthy Lamb who receives power and glory because the Father has set him there (Revelation 5:12).
members.new: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing* (Revelation 5:12). The dignity the Lamb receives is the seat Enoch saw given: the Elect One placed on the throne of glory by Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, to judge. The Lamb receives; the Father gives.

members.old: 1 Enoch 99:3 — *raise your prayers as a memorial... before the angels* the prayers laid as a memorial before the Most High, the very pattern of the incense-offering (Revelation 8:4).
members.new: *In those days make ready, ye righteous, to raise your prayers as a memorial, And place them as a testimony before the angels, That they may place the sin of the sinners for a memorial before the El Elyon (Most High).* (1 Enoch 99:3). Enoch bids the righteous *raise your prayers as a memorial... before the angels* — and in Revelation an angel does exactly that, offering the incense *with the prayers of all saints* so that they *ascended up before Elohim (God)* (Revelation 8:4). The prayers are a memorial laid before the Most High, and the same fire-bearing angel who carries them up then casts the fire of the altar to the earth (8:5): the memorial of the righteous becomes the judgment on the sinners.

Enoch was told who is bound in that place: stars of heaven that transgressed the commandment, bound till their ten thousand years are consummated. The pit has prisoners before it has a key.

members.old: 1 Enoch 81:1 — *Observe, Enoch, these heavenly tablets, And read what is written thereon, And understand every single fact* the appointed things written on high and shown to the seer; the mystery read where it is written (Revelation 10:7).
members.new: *And he said unto me: ‘Observe, Enoch, these heavenly tablets, And read what is written thereon, And mark every individual fact.’* (1 Enoch 81:1). *The mystery of Elohim (God) should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets* (Revelation 10:7). Enoch is set before the heavenly tablets and told to read what is written there and mark every fact. The mystery is what stands written in heaven; the prophets read it and declare it, and the seventh trumpet brings it to pass.

members.old: 1 Enoch 81:2 — *I observed everything on the heavenly tablets, And read everything which was written... And understood everything* the seer reads and understands the heavenly book; what is written there comes to pass (Revelation 10:7).
members.new: *And I observed the heavenly tablets, and read everything which was written (thereon) and understood everything, and read the book of all the deeds of mankind, and of all the children of flesh that shall be upon the earth to the remotest generations.* (1 Enoch 81:2). *The mystery of Elohim (God) should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets* (Revelation 10:7). Enoch read the heavenly tablets and the book of all the deeds of mankind to the remotest generations. The prophet does not invent the mystery; he reads it where it is already written.

members.old: 1 Enoch 90:17 — *a new house was built greater and loftier than the first, and the Lord of the sheep brought all the sheep into that new house* the measured worshippers are the regathered sheep, the restoration of all Yashar'el (Israel) (Revelation 11:1).
members.new: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.* (1 Enoch 90:29). The restored library saw the end of the measuring — not the old house propped up but *a new house... greater and loftier than the first*, into which the Lord of the sheep gathers all his flock. So the angel's reed to *measure the temple of Elohim (God), and the altar, and them that worship therein* (Revelation 11:1) marks off the house being built for the regathered: the worshippers numbered now are the sheep brought home into the greater house, the restoration of all Yashar'el (Israel).

members.new: *And I saw till a throne was erected in the pleasant land, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep sat Himself thereon, and the other took the sealed books and opened those books before Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep.* (1 Enoch 90:20). *Whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world* (Revelation 13:8). Enoch saw the books opened before the Lord of the sheep on his throne, and elsewhere *the books of the living were opened before Him* (1 Enoch 47:3). The worshippers of the beast are not in that book; the names in it were written before the beast rose.

members.old: 1 Enoch 108:3 — *their names shall be blotted out of the book of life, And out of the books of the holy ones* the book of life and the blotting-out; names are blotted out, never added — the beast's worshippers are not found written there (Revelation 13:8).
members.new: *And wait ye indeed till sin has passed away, for their names shall be blotted out of the book of life and out of the holy books, and their seed shall be destroyed for ever, and their spirits shall be slain, and they shall cry and make lamentation in a place that is a chaotic wilderness, and in the fire shall they burn; for there is no earth there.* (1 Enoch 108:3). *Whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb* (Revelation 13:8). Enoch knows the book and the blotting: *their names shall be blotted out of the book of life.* The names were written before the foundation of the world; the beast's worshippers are not among them, and the wheat that falls away is blotted out. No name is added after.

members.old: 1 Enoch 90:14 — *the Lord of the sheep cast them all into a fiery abyss* the end appointed for the beasts; the false prophet's fire is not the fire that has the last word (Revelation 13:15).
members.new: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.* (1 Enoch 90:18). *As many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed* (Revelation 13:15). Enoch saw the end of every beast and bird that devoured the sheep: the Lord of the sheep came with the staff of his wrath and the earth swallowed them. The beast and the false prophet go into the fire (Revelation 19:20); the beasts of the vision go into the earth. The fire the false prophet calls down is not the fire that has the last word.

members.old: 1 Enoch 24:11 — *its fruit shall be for life to the elect; it shall be transplanted to the holy place* the transplanting now accomplished, the tree given to the righteous for food (Revelation 22:2,14).
members.new: *Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of Yahuah (Lord), the Eternal King.* (1 Enoch 25:5). Enoch was shown the tree of life transplanted to the holy place, its fruit for food to the elect. John sees the transplanting done — the tree *in the midst of the street* of the city, *and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations* (Revelation 22:2). The fruit reserved for the elect is theirs; the leaves reach the nations through them.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:1 — *And thus Yahuah (God) of Spirits named the Elect One, And seated him on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, And weigh their deeds in the balance.* The Elect One enthroned to judge shares his seat with the twelve over the tribes.
members.new: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Luke 22:30). The Elect One placed on the throne of glory to judge is the Son of Adam who shares that seat with the twelve.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:5 — *And that Angel of Peace who went with me said to me: 'These are the secrets which thou hast seen.'* In the same vision the Elect One, the Son of Adam, is seated on the throne of glory to judge — the hidden secret now confessed before the council.
members.new: *And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.* (1 Enoch 62:5). *Hereafter shall the Son of Adam sit on the right hand of the power of Elohim (God)* (Luke 22:69). Enoch saw the faces of those who see that Son of Adam sitting on the throne of his glory — terror and pain. The council heard the claim; the vision shows them seeing it kept.

members.old: 1 Enoch 62:6-7 — *Yahuah (God) of Spirits seated the Elect One on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge... This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* The Father seats the Son of Adam to judge — exactly John 5:27.
members.new: 1 Enoch 69:27-7 — *Yahuah (God) of Spirits seated the Elect One on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge... This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* The Father seats the Son of Adam to judge — exactly John 5:27.

members.old: *Woe to you who devour the might of others... And tread upon the righteous with your might* (1 Enoch 96:1) — heaven marks for woe the trampling power of Job's mighty man (24:22).
members.new: *Woe to you who devour the might of others... And tread upon the righteous with your might* (1 Enoch 96:5) — heaven marks for woe the trampling power of Job's mighty man (24:22).

members.old: *Woe to you who are mighty in unrighteousness! For your might shall be cut off* (1 Enoch 96:2) — Enoch and Job speak one verdict: the might is *cut off*, matching *gone and brought low* (24:24).
members.new: *Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.* (1 Enoch 96:8). *They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low* (Job 24:24). Enoch's woe to the mighty who oppress the righteous says the same: the day of their destruction is coming. The might does not keep.

members.new: *And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster named Leviathan, to dwell in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters.* (1 Enoch 60:7). The restored witness names the same abyss-monster the LORD reserves:  (1 Enoch 60:7). Job's *Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook?* (Job 41:1) asks of a creature of the deep that man cannot reach — held in the abyss under Yahuah's (God's) hand alone.
